The content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Institutes of Health.

detail.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1s) have emerged as an effective treatment for obesity and may reduce other addictive behaviors. We estimate the impact of Medicaid coverage of GLP-1s for weight management on prescription drug use and healthcare utilization related to behavioral health treatments, using variation in the timing of state Medicaid coverage. Coverage led to large increases in GLP-1 prescriptions and spending, but we find no evidence of changes in medications or treatment utilization for nicotine, alcohol, or opioid use disorders. We find declines in prescriptions for mental health medications. At the aggregate level, however, we find no evidence of increases in total Medicaid pharmaceutical spending, but suggestive evidence that coverage increased total Medicaid expenditures. These findings suggest that expanded GLP-1 coverage substantially increased access to obesity treatment, with limited evidence of broader spillover effects on behavioral health care.

AI.tldr: 研究GLP-1受体激动剂（减肥药）纳入Medicaid报销范围对处方药使用和 behavioral health 治疗利用的影响，发现虽然增加了GLP-1处方量，但未显著影响成瘾行为治疗（尼古丁、酒精、阿片类药物），仅减少了精神健康药物处方。
AI.research_question: Medicaid覆盖GLP-1减肥药物对处方药使用和精神健康/成瘾治疗利用有何影响？
AI.motivation: GLP-1药物在减肥领域效果显著，且可能减少其他成瘾行为，但缺乏在Medicaid这一重要公共医保计划中覆盖政策的实际效果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 药物覆盖政策的溢出效应理论；GLP-1受体激动剂对成瘾行为潜在干预机制。
AI.method: 利用各州Medicaid覆盖GLP-1减肥药物的时间差异，采用双重差分或事件研究法等准实验方法分析处方药使用和医疗利用数据。
AI.findings: 1）GLP-1处方量和支出大幅增加；2）对尼古丁、酒精、阿片类药物使用障碍的治疗用药和就诊无显著变化；3）精神健康药物处方减少；4）总Medicaid药品支出未显著增加，但总支出可能有上升趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 为GLP-1药物覆盖政策对行为健康溢出效应提供了实证证据，挑战了GLP-1可广泛减少成瘾行为的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Medicaid和医疗政策制定者提供了GLP-1覆盖决策的实证依据，提示需关注精神健康药物处方减少的潜在影响。

title: Salvaging Innovation From Extinction
affiliations: California Western School of Law

detail.title: Salvaging Innovation From Extinction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.

detail.abstract:
Environmental decline has widespread and devastating consequences. Its effect on scientific research remains an underexplored negative externality and provides an additional reason to take protective action. The natural world has already inspired life-saving therapeutics, such as Taxol and GLP-1 drugs, but mass extinction threatens to eliminate countless potential candidates for new therapeutics before scientists can even identify them. While mitigating environmental harm ex ante is an ideal approach, collective action problems have hindered its implementation. Innovation policy should therefore advance existing efforts by prioritizing research, conservation, and information preservation related to these natural resources. 

This Article sets forth a framework focused on three goals: simplification, safeguarding, and scrutiny. To promote simplification, it proposes that the patent office establish an expedited examination program for applications that build upon natural products or support their conservation. With regard to safeguarding, it considers how the patent office could also help preserve valuable information related to such inventions by requiring applicants to make a good faith disclosure of traditional knowledge upon which they substantially rely as a condition of participating in the expedited examination program. For the last goal of scrutiny, it recommends that regulators continually evaluate the effects of these incentives on both innovation and environmental loss. While accelerating natural products research may have adverse environmental effects, such as by encouraging greater use of energy-intensive AI, the potential benefits may outweigh these risks given the possibility that future life-enhancing treatments could be lost forever. A practical approach to innovation policy will complement global efforts to address environmental decline by preserving opportunities for discovery and information before they disappear.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨环境衰退对科学研究的负面影响，并提出通过专利政策改革（简化、保护、审查三目标框架）激励基于自然资源的研究与保护，以在生物多样性丧失前保留潜在的治疗药物发现机会。
AI.research_question: 如何通过创新政策（尤其是专利制度）应对环境衰退对自然产品研究的负面外部性，在保护生物多样性的同时促进潜在的疗法发现？
AI.motivation: 环境衰退（如物种灭绝）可能导致大量潜在治疗药物（如紫杉醇、GLP-1药物）在科学家发现之前消失，而集体行动难题使得事前环境保护难以充分实施，因此需要创新政策作为补充。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负外部性理论（环境衰退对科研的负外部性）、集体行动理论、创新政策与知识产权制度设计。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，提出三目标政策框架（简化、保护、审查）。
AI.findings: 提出了三个政策目标：（1）简化——专利局为基于自然产品或其保护的申请设立快速审查程序；（2）保护——要求参与快速审查的申请人善意披露所依赖的传统知识；（3）审查——监管机构持续评估激励措施对创新和环境的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将环境衰退识别为科研领域的未被充分探索的负外部性，并将环境外部性理论与创新政策（专利制度）相联系，拓展了知识产权法与环境法的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专利局和监管机构提供了可操作的政策工具（快速审查、传统知识披露要求、效果评估机制），以在生物多样性丧失前加速自然产品研究并保存相关知识信息。

title: National Report on Early-Stage Entrepreneurship in the United States: 2025
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

detail.title: National Report on Early-Stage Entrepreneurship in the United States: 2025
detail.abstract: This paper tracks four indicators that capture early-stage entrepreneurship activity in the United States: Rate of new entrepreneurs, Opportunity share of new entrepreneurs, Startup early job creation, and Startup early survival rate. These indicators collectively inform the Kauffman Early-Stage Entrepreneurship (KESE) Index, a summary index of entrepreneurial activity. The rate of new entrepreneurs in 2025 was 0.36 percent (i.e. 360 out of 100,000 adults created a new business each month). The rate of new entrepreneurs increased in 2025 and remained higher than pre-pandemic levels. The opportunity share of new entrepreneurs increased to 83.3 percent in 2025 from its low of 69.8 percent in 2020, but remained lower than its prepandemic level of 86.9 percent in 2019. Startup early job creation in 2025 was 5.3 jobs per 1,000 people remaining at the same level as the previous year. Startup job creation dropped in the pandemic but is now above pre-pandemic levels. The startup early survival rate was 77.9 percent in 2025, which is slightly lower than the previous year and lower than pre-pandemic levels. The KESE Index increased in 2025 from the previous year and returned to levels found just prior to the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 本文追踪了美国早期创业活动的四个关键指标，并构建了考夫曼早期创业指数（KESE Index）。2025年数据显示，新创业者比率回升至0.36%，高于疫情前水平；机会型创业占比达83.3%，较2020年低点大幅回升但仍低于疫情前；初创企业早期就业创造保持为5.3个岗位/千人，高于疫情前；早期生存率77.9%，略有下降。KESE指数在2025年回升至疫情前水平。
AI.research_question: 追踪和衡量美国早期创业活动的动态变化，特别是后疫情时代的恢复情况。
AI.motivation: 创业活动是经济活力的重要来源，需要系统性的指标来监测其长期趋势和短期波动，尤其需要评估疫情对创业生态的冲击及后续恢复情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业活动指标体系理论：通过多维度指标（新创业者比率、机会型创业占比、初创就业创造、早期生存率）综合衡量早期创业活跃度。
AI.method: 基于四个关键指标的追踪与统计分析，构建合成指数（KESE Index）进行综合评估。
AI.findings: 2025年新创业者比率0.36%（高于疫情前）；机会型创业占比83.3%（较2020年低点69.8%回升，但仍低于2019年86.9%）；初创就业创造5.3个岗位/千人（高于疫情前）；早期生存率77.9%（略有下降且低于疫情前）；KESE指数回升至疫情前水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了系统性追踪早期创业活动的指标体系框架，验证了多维度指标综合评估创业生态的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了美国创业活动的实时监测数据；揭示了疫情对创业活动的差异化影响（数量恢复但质量和可持续性仍面临挑战）。

title: Publikacja / Publication Digital Transformation -the "Design for All" Approach: European Accessibility for the Disabled
affiliations: University of Silesia in Katowice

detail.title: Publikacja / Publication Digital Transformation -the "Design for All" Approach: European Accessibility for the Disabled
detail.abstract: Both the UN and the European Commission have been strengthening their regulations concerning the accessibility of products and services by persons with disabilities. Although this is not a new topic, the new regulations are designed to be more binding and to reduce remaining inequity between persons with and without disabilities. Although the topic of accessibility is increasingly better understood and discussed in terms of online systems, it applies just as much to more established technologies such as ATMs or the telephone and even to live human interactions. rat said, the new regulations do robustly address the online space. In addition, the COVID 19 pandemic has, (because so many societal interactions have moved online), drawn even greater attention to existing barriers. The purpose of this study was to outline the framework of legal regulations referring to this problem and to show and analyse the broader context of the changes that are expected once the European Accessibility Act takes epect in 2025.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理了联合国和欧盟关于残障人士产品和服务可及性的新法规框架，重点分析了《欧洲可及性法案》2025年生效后带来的变革背景，以及新冠疫情对线上可及性问题的加剧影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟和联合国关于残障人士可及性的新法规框架是什么？《欧洲可及性法案》2025年生效后预期带来哪些变革？
AI.motivation: 尽管可及性议题日益受到关注，但残障人士与非残障人士之间仍存在不平等，且新冠疫情使大量社会互动转向线上，暴露了更多现有障碍。新法规旨在更具约束力地减少这种不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律规制框架（联合国与欧盟的可及性法规）、社会公平理论、残障权利理论
AI.method: 法律文献分析、法规框架梳理、背景分析
AI.findings: 新法规（特别是《欧洲可及性法案》）对线上空间和传统技术（如ATM、电话）及人际互动均提出可及性要求；新冠疫情暴露并加剧了现有可及性障碍；2025年法案生效将带来重大变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了可及性领域的最新法律规制框架，为理解欧盟与联合国在残障权益方面的法规演进提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和组织提供了2025年《欧洲可及性法案》生效前的合规指引，帮助其理解需要调整的技术和社会互动领域。

title: GDP and the Limits of Macroeconomic Measurement in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: GDP and the Limits of Macroeconomic Measurement in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
Purpose: This article examines how the diffusion of artificial intelligence is widening a long running gap between what GDP records and what economies now produce, and what this implies for the macroeconomic measurement framework on which policy still depends.

Design/methodology/approach: The argument is conceptual. It rests on a synthesis of three established literatures and a reading of recent empirical evidence on AI diffusion through that lens.

Findings: AI enlarges this gap through two channels. The first is the spread of free digital goods that users value highly but rarely pay for, with unrecorded consumer surplus from generative AI now estimated in the tens of billions of dollars annually. The second is the distance between the heavy investment now flowing into AI and the modest productivity the statistics so far record, a lag familiar from earlier general-purpose technologies.

 Originality/value:The article develops an integrated framework that connects three literatures usually examined separately: the welfare critique of GDP, data economics, and the diffusion of general-purpose technologies. Through this framework, artificial intelligence emerges as a contemporary stress test of macroeconomic measurement, revealing a growing divergence between GDP and the value the economy actually produces.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能的扩散如何加剧了GDP记录与经济实际产出之间的长期差距，以及这对宏观经济测量框架的影响。
AI.research_question: 人工智能的扩散如何扩大GDP记录与经济实际产出之间的差距，以及这对宏观经济测量框架意味着什么？
AI.motivation: GDP作为核心经济指标，其与真实经济价值之间的差距正因AI扩散而持续扩大，但现有测量框架仍依赖传统GDP统计，可能导致政策误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了三条通常被分开研究的文献脉络：GDP的福利批判、数据经济学、以及通用目的技术的扩散理论。
AI.method: 概念性论证，基于对三条既有文献的综合梳理以及通过该视角对AI扩散近期实证证据的解读。
AI.findings: AI通过两个渠道扩大差距：1）免费数字产品普及，用户获得高价值但极少付费，生成式AI带来的未记录消费者剩余已达数百亿美元；2）AI领域巨额投资与统计数据显示的温和生产力增长之间存在落差，这与早期通用目的技术的滞后模式类似。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了一个整合框架，将GDP福利批判、数据经济学和通用目的技术扩散三条通常独立讨论的文献联系起来，将AI定位为宏观经济测量的当代压力测试。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了GDP与真实经济价值之间日益扩大的背离，提示政策制定者需反思和更新宏观经济测量框架。

title: A Public-Data Review-Priority Framework for Medicaid Residential Care Oversight: Evidence from Washington State Adult Family Homes

detail.title: A Public-Data Review-Priority Framework for Medicaid Residential Care Oversight: Evidence from Washington State Adult Family Homes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests or conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used exclusively publicly available, de-identified administrative and geospatial data. No human subjects research, protected health information (PHI), or individual-level patient data was involved. Institutional review board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: Adult family homes (AFHs) and Medicaid-funded home and community-based services (HCBS) face well-documented program-integrity challenges; oversight architectures built for centralized institutions struggle to monitor dispersed, lower-visibility residential networks that remain reliant on reactive post-payment claims audits.

Objective: This study tests whether public administrative records can support a public-data review-priority framework spanning operator concentration, enforcement intensity, and complaint load, assessed before claims-level investigation.

Methods: A 20-indicator review-priority typology, derived from Minnesota's public Medicaid enforcement record, was applied to a three-county Washington AFH pilot (n=3,457 facilities in King, Pierce, and Spokane counties) using state licensing rosters, the Residential Care Services enforcement portal, Census denominators, and shared-contact clustering.

Results: Public data cannot identify billing irregularities, but it supports mapping structural review-priority indicators: 72 multi-license shared-contact clusters covering 164 facilities (4.7% of the pilot universe) and 165 facilities (4.8%) with at least one public enforcement action, with county-level enforcement rates ranging from 3.8% in Spokane to 5.8% in Pierce. The primary contribution is a public-data review-priority layer that specifies, indicator by indicator, what can and cannot be observed before claims access; operator concentration is the most novel public-data signal identified.

Conclusion: Public licensing and enforcement records can reveal where closer administrative review may be warranted; only internal agency claims data can confirm whether a billing anomaly occurred. The study proposes a two-phase model: public-data review prioritization (Phase 1, tested here) followed by claims-informed validation using internal agency data (Phase 2, proposed but not executed), intended to improve review-prioritization efficiency without displacing due process.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用明尼苏达州和华盛顿州的三县试点数据，构建了一个基于公共行政记录（许可、执法、投诉）的审查优先级框架，用于识别成人家庭护理机构（AFH）中可能存在的项目完整性问题。研究发现，公共数据虽无法识别账单异常，但能通过运营商集中度、执法强度、投诉量等20个指标，在未接触内部理赔数据前先行划分审查优先级——其中运营商集中度是最具创新性的信号。
AI.research_question: 公共行政记录能否在理赔层面调查之前，支持构建一个覆盖运营商集中度、执法强度和投诉负荷的审查优先级框架？
AI.motivation: 成人家庭护理机构（AFH）和医疗补助资助的居家社区服务（HCBS）面临严重的项目完整性挑战，但传统的监督架构是为集中式机构设计的，难以有效监管分散、低可见性的居住网络，且过度依赖被动的事后理赔审计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 项目完整性（program integrity）监督、基于风险的审查优先级（risk-based review prioritization）、公共行政记录作为监督工具的有效性边界。
AI.method: 从明尼苏达州的公共医疗补助执法记录中提炼出包含20个指标的审查优先级类型学，将其应用于华盛顿州三县（King、Pierce、Spokane）的3457家AFH设施试点，数据来源包括州许可名册、Residential Care Services执法门户、人口普查数据以及共享联系人的聚类分析。
AI.findings: 公共数据无法识别账单违规，但可绘制结构性审查优先级指标：识别出72个多许可共享联系人集群（涵盖164家设施，占4.7%），165家设施（4.8%）至少有一项公共执法行动，县级执法率从Spokane的3.8%到Pierce的5.8%不等。运营商集中度是最具创新性的公共数据信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个两阶段审查模型（第一阶段：公共数据优先级划分；第二阶段：内部理赔数据验证），清晰地界定了公共数据在项目完整性监督中的能力边界——可以识别"哪里值得查"，但不能确认"是否真的有问题"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了一种低成本、可扩展的公共数据审查优先级工具，在不取代正当程序的前提下提升审查效率；运营商集中度指标可帮助监管者发现通过多个许可证分散运营、实质上承担系统性风险的实体。

title: Who Gains and Who Loses from Wind Power? Employment, Displacement, and Spatial Spillovers in Northeastern Brazil
affiliations: Depart of Economics, University of Sao Paulo, Federal University of Paraiba (UFPB), University of São Paulo (USP) - Department of Economics, Federal University of Paraiba (UFPB) - Economics and Federal University of Paraíba

detail.title: Who Gains and Who Loses from Wind Power? Employment, Displacement, and Spatial Spillovers in Northeastern Brazil
detail.abstract: Wind power deployment is often framed as a source of regional job creation, but its local economic incidence may be sectorally uneven and spatially dispersed. This paper estimates the effects of wind farm expansion on formal labor markets in Northeastern Brazil from 2004 to 2019. Using an annual panel of 1,478 municipalities and a spatial difference-in-differences design, we estimate direct effects on host municipalities and spillover effects on nearby municipalities across industry, commerce and services, and agriculture. The results indicate a pattern of sectoral reallocation rather than broad-based employment growth. Host municipalities experience large short-run gains in industrial employment and establishment counts, while agricultural employment declines, with the strongest evidence in the short run and persistent negative point estimates at longer horizons. Neighboring municipalities also exhibit negative labor market spillovers, especially in industrial wages and wage bills and in short-run agricultural employment and wage bills. Exploratory analyses suggest more negative point estimates in inland municipalities and among low-skilled agricultural workers, although these results are based on smaller effective samples. The findings show that wind farms operate not only as energy-capacity investments, but also as spatially targeted infrastructure shocks with uneven distributive effects across sectors, workers, and municipalities. They also underscore the importance of accounting for spatial spillovers when designing quasi-experimental evaluations of renewable energy infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究巴西东北部风电场扩张对正式劳动力市场的影响，发现风电场带来工业就业短期增长，但导致农业就业下降，并对邻近地区产生负面溢出效应，呈现部门间再分配而非全面就业增长的模式。
AI.research_question: 风电场扩张如何影响巴西东北部地区的正式劳动力市场？其影响在不同部门（工业、商业服务业、农业）和空间维度（本地 vs. 邻近地区）上如何分布？
AI.motivation: 风电开发常被宣传为区域就业创造的来源，但其地方经济影响可能在部门间不均、在空间上分散。现有研究对风电的劳动市场影响的部门异质性和空间溢出效应关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间双重差分法（Spatial Difference-in-Differences）；劳动力部门间再分配理论；基础设施冲击的空间溢出效应理论。
AI.method: 使用2004-2019年巴西东北部1,478个城市的年度面板数据，采用空间双重差分设计，估计风电场对本地城市（直接效应）和邻近城市（溢出效应）在工业、商业服务业和农业三个部门的就业、企业数量、工资等指标的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 风电场所在城市工业就业和企业数量在短期内大幅增长，但农业就业下降；长期来看农业就业的负面点估计持续存在。(2) 邻近城市出现负面劳动力市场溢出，尤其是工业工资和工资总额下降，以及短期农业就业和工资总额下降。(3) 探索性分析表明，内陆城市和低技能农业工人受到的负面点估计更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示风电场不仅是能源容量投资，更是空间定向的基础设施冲击，产生部门间和空间上不均等的分配效应；强调在设计可再生能源基础设施的准实验评估时需考虑空间溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风电政策的区域经济影响评估提供实证依据，提示政策制定者关注风电场带来的劳动力部门再分配和空间溢出负面效应，特别是在农业部门和邻近地区的就业与工资损失。

title: Energy Price Volatility and Industrial Competitiveness: A Cross-Regional Analysis of Automotive Gas Oil Dynamics and Manufacturing Sector Performance in Asia and Africa​
affiliations: Usmanu Danfodiyo University, Sokoto State University, Sokoto and Xi'an

detail.title: Energy Price Volatility and Industrial Competitiveness: A Cross-Regional Analysis of Automotive Gas Oil Dynamics and Manufacturing Sector Performance in Asia and Africa​
detail.abstract: AbstractThis study examines the impact of Automotive Gas Oil (diesel) prices on manufacturing sector performance in 16 Asian and African economies (1991–2024). Using a Cross‑Sectionally Augmented Autoregressive Distributed Lag (CS‑ARDL) framework that accounts for cross‑sectional dependence and slope heterogeneity, we find that a 1% increase in diesel prices reduces manufacturing value added by 0.25% in the pooled sample. However, this average conceals profound heterogeneity. For African oil‑importing countries, the long‑run elasticity is –0.28 (p<0.05) – a significant cost‑push effect. In contrast, Asian economies show no statistically significant effect (energy decoupling), and African oil‑exporting countries also exhibit a null effect because higher global oil prices generate fiscal revenues that offset domestic cost increases. Subgroup CS‑ARDL estimations confirm these opposing forces, resolving a Simpson’s paradox in the pooled African sample. Exchange rate depreciation and regulatory quality improve manufacturing performance in the long run but entail short‑run J‑curve adjustment costs. Inflation is detrimental. Policy implications are clear: African oil‑importers need strategic fuel reserves, targeted subsidies, and grid investment; African oil‑exporters must implement institutional reforms to channel resource rents into productive manufacturing; Asia should sustain its energy diversification trajectory. The findings demonstrate that fossil fuel price shocks affect industrial competitiveness in context‑specific ways, and that resource revenue management is critical for avoiding de‑industrialization in oil‑exporting developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1991-2024年16个亚非经济体的数据，采用CS-ARDL模型研究柴油价格对制造业的影响。结果显示：柴油价格上涨1%使制造业增加值下降0.25%，但这一效应在非洲石油进口国（弹性-0.28）显著，在亚洲（能源脱钩）和非洲石油出口国（财政抵消效应）则不显著。研究还发现汇率贬值和监管质量长期有利但短期有J曲线调整成本，通货膨胀有害。
AI.research_question: 柴油（Automotive Gas Oil）价格如何影响亚洲和非洲经济体的制造业绩效？这种影响在不同类型的国家（石油进口国 vs 出口国，亚洲 vs 非洲）之间是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 化石燃料价格冲击对工业竞争力的影响存在争议，现有研究缺乏针对柴油这一关键生产投入品的跨国比较分析，尤其缺乏区分亚洲与非洲不同资源禀赋国家的异质性研究。同时，在非洲样本中存在辛普森悖论（石油进口国和出口国的效应相互抵消），需要更精细的实证方法加以解析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本推动效应理论（柴油价格上涨提高生产成本，降低制造业附加值）；财政收入抵消效应（石油出口国从高油价中获益，抵消国内成本上升）；能源脱钩假说（亚洲经济体通过能源结构多样化降低对柴油的依赖）；J曲线调整成本理论（汇率贬值和监管改革长期有利但短期有调整成本）。
AI.method: 采用Cross‑Sectionally Augmented Autoregressive Distributed Lag（CS-ARDL）框架，该模型能够处理截面依赖性和斜率异质性。研究覆盖1991-2024年16个亚洲和非洲经济体，进行分组子样本CS-ARDL估计以揭示异质性效应。
AI.findings: 1）全样本中柴油价格每上涨1%，制造业增加值下降0.25%；2）非洲石油进口国长期弹性为-0.28（p<0.05），成本推动效应显著；3）亚洲经济体无显著效应（能源脱钩）；4）非洲石油出口国无显著效应（高油价带来的财政收入抵消国内成本增加）；5）汇率贬值和监管质量长期改善制造业绩效，但短期存在J曲线调整成本；6）通货膨胀对制造业有害。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了化石燃料价格冲击对制造业影响的异质性机制，明确了“成本推动效应”与“财政收入抵消效应”两种对立力量的存在，并通过子样本分析解决了非洲样本中的辛普森悖论。丰富了能源经济学与产业经济学交叉领域的理论理解，特别是对资源型经济体去工业化问题的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同类型的国家提供了差异化政策建议：非洲石油进口国应建立战略燃料储备、实施定向补贴和电网投资；非洲石油出口国需进行制度性改革以将资源租金转化为生产性制造业投资；亚洲国家应继续推进能源多样化。研究还指出汇率政策和监管改革需考虑短期调整成本，通胀控制对制造业保护至关重要。

title: What Is the Optimal Funding Rate? Contract Design for Perpetual Futures

detail.title: What Is the Optimal Funding Rate? Contract Design for Perpetual Futures
detail.abstract: What funding rule should a perpetual futures contract post? This paper makes the rule a design object: tracking intensity, clamp width, and settlement interval chosen against a welfare ledger in which funding rents finance the arbitrage sector. Tracking has an interior optimum in closed form: faster tracking compresses the bubble but taxes the holding clientele, and beyond a fold it kills the rents and strands the market in the desert. The prevailing contract sits at the capacity peak, a volume maximizer's choice, not the planner's. Settlement frequency is neutral absent margin frictions. A finite clamp is optimal once runs exist.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了永续合约的融资费率规则设计，发现追踪速度存在内部最优，当前市场合约处于容量峰值而非社会最优，结算频率在无摩擦时中性，存在挤兑风险时最优设置有限夹子。
AI.research_question: 永续合约应该采用什么样的融资费率规则？
AI.motivation: 永续合约是加密货币市场最重要的衍生品之一，但其融资费率规则的设计缺乏理论基础，需要从福利经济学角度进行优化设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利经济学模型，将融资租金分配给套利部门作为福利账本，考虑追踪强度、夹子宽度和结算间隔三个设计参数。
AI.method: 理论模型推导，闭式解分析。
AI.findings: 追踪速度存在内部最优：过快追踪压缩泡沫但对持有客户征税，超过临界点会消灭租金导致市场消失；当前合约处于容量峰值（交易量最大化）而非社会计划者最优；无保证金摩擦时结算频率中性；存在挤兑风险时有限夹子最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将永续合约的融资规则作为设计对象进行福利分析，揭示了市场最优与社会最优的偏离，提出了追踪速度的闭式解和夹子设计的挤兑理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为永续合约的规则设计提供了理论指导，指出了当前市场合约的次优性，为交易所和监管机构优化合约设计提供了方向。

title: Federal Research Funding and STEM Education
affiliations: , World Bank and University of British Columbia, Sauder School of Business

detail.title: Federal Research Funding and STEM Education
detail.abstract: This paper examines how federal science and engineering research funding - although intended to advance research - affects degree production and programs offered in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Using data from 1971-2016, the study implements a triple-difference design that exploits variation across colleges, time, and fields of study. The findings show that federal grants generate 27.4 percent of doctorates and 14.7 percent of undergraduate science, technology, engineering, and mathematics degrees, as well as 6.3 percent of doctoral programs and 3.7 percent of undergraduate programs in STEM annually across 200 U.S. research universities. The impacts are concentrated in biology and engineering, aligning with the priorities of major funders such as the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Science Foundation, and the Department of Defense. These findings suggest that research grants to universities may generate a "double dividend," simultaneously expanding the supply of skilled labor in targeted fields while also advancing scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1971-2016年美国200所研究型大学的数据，采用三重差分法，发现联邦科研经费不仅推动科学发现，还显著增加了STEM领域的学位产出（博士27.4%，本科14.7%）和项目设置（博士6.3%，本科3.7%），产生"双重红利"效应。
AI.research_question: 联邦科学与工程研究经费如何影响美国大学STEM领域的学位产出和项目设置？
AI.motivation: 联邦科研经费通常被视为推动科学发现的工具，但其对STEM人才培养（学位生产和项目供给）的溢出效应尚不明确，了解这一影响有助于全面评估科研投入的社会回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论；科研经费溢出效应；高等教育的供给与需求框架。
AI.method: 三重差分法（triple-difference design），利用学院、时间、学科三个维度的变异进行识别；数据覆盖1971-2016年美国200所研究型大学。
AI.findings: 联邦科研经费每年贡献了STEM领域27.4%的博士毕业生、14.7%的本科毕业生，以及6.3%的博士项目和3.7%的本科项目；效应集中在生物学和工程学领域，与主要资助机构（卫生与公众服务部、国家科学基金会、国防部）的优先方向一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了科研经费的"双重红利"假说，即研究资助同时促进科学发现和人才培养，拓展了对科研投入社会回报的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估联邦科研经费的综合效益提供量化依据，表明科研资助具有人才培养的溢出效应，可作为STEM劳动力供给的政策杠杆。

title: Russian Influence and Belarusian Economic Liberalization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Russian Influence and Belarusian Economic Liberalization
detail.abstract: Belarus's deep economic dependence on Russia, spanning energy, trade, and military equipment, has long granted the Kremlin significant leverage over Belarusian internal affairs. This paper argues that proposed privatization of Belarus's state-owned enterprises would dramatically amplify Russian influence by enabling Russian investors, who already account for nearly half of all foreign direct investment in Belarus, to acquire commanding positions in the Belarusian economy. To preserve sovereignty, this paper recommends against privatization, instead proposing reforms to support private sector growth while reducing preferential treatment of state-owned enterprises.

AI.tldr: 白俄罗斯对俄罗斯在经济上深度依赖，本文认为私有化将加剧俄罗斯影响力，建议不私有化而通过改革支持私营部门发展以维护主权。
AI.research_question: 白俄罗斯国有企业私有化是否会进一步放大俄罗斯对其的影响力？
AI.motivation: 白俄罗斯在能源、贸易和军事装备上高度依赖俄罗斯，私有化可能让俄罗斯投资者掌控白俄经济命脉，威胁其主权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济依赖与主权关系理论；外国直接投资与政治影响力的关联理论
AI.method: 定性政策分析，基于现有经济依存数据和外资结构论证
AI.findings: 俄罗斯已占白俄罗斯外国直接投资近一半，私有化将使俄罗斯投资者获得白俄国有企业的控制地位，显著放大俄罗斯影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了"经济依赖-主权威胁"框架在转型经济体中的应用，揭示了私有化作为政治影响力传导机制的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为白俄罗斯及其他依赖型经济体提供政策建议：应避免对关键国有企业进行私有化，转而通过减少国企优待、扶持私营部门来维护经济主权。

title: Transparency Log Standard: AI Refusal Logic and GPAI Systemic Risk Compliance

detail.title: Transparency Log Standard: AI Refusal Logic and GPAI Systemic Risk Compliance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or professional affiliation with any platform operator, API vendor, or organisation evaluated or referenced in this report. The author is the sole owner and Director of Research of Ontological Engineering Pty Ltd, the publishing entity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work does not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring ethics approval. All example records and identifiers presented (e.g., Appendix A.2) are synthetic and do not represent real individuals or transactions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This technical specification defines a standardized architecture for the deployment of machine-readable, cryptographically anchored Transparency Logs for General Purpose AI (GPAI) and Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) deployments. Designed to assist platform operators in demonstrating verifiable alignment with accountability frameworks - such as Article 12 of the EU AI Act and consumer protection guidelines - this specification establishes common data representations, structural demarcation criteria for operational telemetry, and clear constraints for trade secret exemptions. Implementing organisations utilise this specification to eliminate core transparency failure modes, including silent governance drift and evidentiary asymmetry, by creating an immutable, audit-ready data lineage trail.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了一种用于通用人工智能（GPAI）和模型即服务（MaaS）部署的可加密验证透明度日志标准化架构，旨在帮助平台运营商展示对欧盟AI法案第12条等问责框架的可验证合规性。
AI.research_question: 如何为GPAI和MaaS部署设计标准化的、机器可读且加密锚定的透明度日志架构，以实现可验证的问责合规？
AI.motivation: 解决AI部署中存在的核心透明度失败模式（如治理静默漂移、证据不对称），帮助平台运营商满足欧盟AI法案等监管框架的问责要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 透明度日志、加密锚定、可审计数据溯源、问责框架（欧盟AI法案第12条）
AI.method: 技术规范设计，定义通用数据表示、操作遥测的结构化划分标准以及商业秘密豁免的明确约束。
AI.findings: 通过建立不可变、可审计的数据溯源链，可消除核心透明度失败模式（治理静默漂移和证据不对称）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI透明度与问责性提供了标准化的技术实现框架，将监管要求转化为可操作的技术规范。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实施组织提供了即用的标准化架构，帮助平台运营商在实际部署中满足欧盟AI法案等法规的透明度与审计要求。

title: Maps on Developing Iranian Intermediate EFL Learners' Reading
affiliations: and Hakim Sabzevari University

detail.title: Maps on Developing Iranian Intermediate EFL Learners' Reading
detail.abstract: The study aims to investigate the influence of image-based and text-based concept maps on the reading comprehension abilities of Iranian Intermediate EFL learners. A total of 90 learners participated in the study, consisting of 55 females and 35 males, all between the ages of 18 and 32. Participants were selected from intact classes at three English language schools in Sabzevar, Iran. This research was organized as a quasi-experimental study, in which the participants were segmented into two experimental groups and one control group. The intervention lasted for five weeks, with two sessions each week, each session running for one hour and thirty minutes. The outcomes from the assessments were analyzed using an independent sample ttest and ANOVA test, revealing that the image-based concept map instructional approach improved learners' reading comprehension. In terms of cognitive understanding and creativity, students who utilized image-based concept mapping outperformed their peers in the text-based mapping group. Additionally, the findings indicated that the image-based concept map teaching strategy could assist students in obtaining a more profound understanding of reading materials. Teachers might consider integrating visual mapping techniques to encourage deeper comprehension and facilitate more meaningful learning experiences, which could ultimately lead to better academic performance in language learning contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于图像的概念图和基于文本的概念图对伊朗中级英语学习者阅读理解能力的影响。实验结果显示，基于图像的概念图教学法显著提升了学习者的阅读理解表现，并在认知理解和创造力方面优于文本组。
AI.research_question: 图像型与文本型概念图对伊朗中级英语学习者阅读理解能力的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 探究不同类型的概念图（图像型与文本型）在语言学习环境中对阅读理解能力的实际教学效果，为EFL教学提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念图理论、双编码理论（Dual Coding Theory）、阅读 comprehension 认知理论
AI.method: 准实验设计，包含两个实验组（图像概念图组、文本概念图组）和一个对照组，干预持续5周（每周2次，每次90分钟），采用独立样本t检验和ANOVA分析数据。
AI.findings: 图像型概念图教学法显著提升了学习者的阅读理解能力；图像组在认知理解和创造力方面优于文本组；图像型概念图有助于学生更深入地理解阅读材料。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了双编码理论在EFL阅读理解教学中的应用价值，丰富了概念图教学策略在二语习得领域的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议教师整合视觉映射技术以促进深度理解和有意义学习，从而提升语言学习中的学业表现。

title: The Hypercomputational Ontology of AI Economic: Embodying the Real World, Human Mind, and the Limits of Turing Machines
affiliations: and Tsinghua University

detail.title: The Hypercomputational Ontology of AI Economic: Embodying the Real World, Human Mind, and the Limits of Turing Machines
detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified theoretical framework for AI economics integrating computability theory, non-equilibrium thermodynamics, endogenous growth theory, and the philosophy of mind. We resolve the half-century debate between computationalism and anti-computationalism by showing that human brains and physical reality are inherently hypercomputational systems with continuous nonlinear dynamics, capable of solving problems undecidable or intractable for any Turing machine. We introduce the hypercomputational ontological manifold M and dissipative projection operator Pdrop, demonstrating that data is not neutral bits but a topological collapse of continuous hypercomputational dynamics onto discrete symbolic spaces. Modern AI’s success stems not from a breakthrough in Turing computation, but from its ability to compress and approximate hypercomputational solutions encoded in low-entropy data from human minds and physical environments—a process we term extensional alignment. We show that deep reinforcement learning’s strong performance on NP-hard and continuous control problems constitutes a computational outsourcing mechanism: rather than solving problems internally, AI agents delegate computation to the physical environment as an online hypercomputational oracle. We then build a three-tier nested endogenous growth model where growth is driven by AI’s absorption of hypercomputational data, not pure computational power alone. Our model yields three counterintuitive, testable predictions: (1) Pure Turing synthetic data has diminishing marginal value and leads to semiotic collapse via entropy growth in isolated Markov chains; (2) Long-run AI economy growth is bounded by new hypercomputational information from human innovation and physical exploration, not Moore’s Law; (3) Non-algorithmic creative and experimental human labor remains irreplaceable as the ultimate source of economic value. These findings carry profound implications for AI policy, labor economics, and the future of economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个融合超计算理论、非平衡热力学、内生增长理论与心灵哲学的AI经济学统一理论框架。核心论点是：人脑和物理现实本质上是超计算系统，AI的成功源于对超计算数据的压缩与近似（外延对齐），而非图灵计算的突破。基于此，文章提出了一个三层嵌套内生增长模型，并给出了三个反直觉预测：纯合成数据边际价值递减、AI经济长期增长受限于人类创新而非摩尔定律、非算法性人类劳动不可替代。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的理论框架，以解释AI的经济增长机制，并解决计算主义与反计算主义之间长达半个世纪的争论？
AI.motivation: 现有的AI经济学理论缺乏对AI本质计算能力的深刻理解，未能区分图灵计算与超计算之间的根本差异，从而无法准确解释AI的经济增长动力与局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 超计算本体论流形（M）与耗散投影算子（Pdrop）框架，结合非平衡热力学、内生增长理论及心灵哲学。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学建模，构建三层嵌套内生增长模型。
AI.findings: （1）纯图灵合成数据边际价值递减，会导致"符号学坍缩"；（2）AI经济的长期增长受限于来自人类创新和物理探索的新超计算信息，而非摩尔定律；（3）非算法性的创造性和实验性人类劳动不可替代，是经济价值的最终源泉。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将超计算理论系统引入AI经济学，提出"外延对齐"和"计算外包机制"等新概念，统一了计算主义与反计算主义之争。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI政策制定、劳动经济学和经济增长预测提供了理论基础，揭示了AI时代人类劳动的不可替代价值，以及合成数据策略的局限性。

title: Scalar Naturalism: A Formal Thermodynamic and Institutional Treatise on Polycentric Biomimetics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Scalar Naturalism: A Formal Thermodynamic and Institutional Treatise on Polycentric Biomimetics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or personal conflicts of interest to disclose regarding this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded and received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Scalar Naturalism establishes that the historical dichotomy between capitalism and communism is an artifact of scalar blindness-an epistemological error structurally identical to the wave-particle duality conflict in quantum mechanics prior to formal probabilistic resolution By mapping economic modalities as scale-dependent expressions of multi-level selection (MLS), this treatise provides a unified mathematical and thermodynamic formalization of political economy We define a quasi-functorial mapping between biological and economic categories, tighten the Price equation using discounted Total Factor Productivity (TFP), and mathematically derive how central planning annihilates the evolutionary covariance gradient Using cooperative game theory, Williamsonian transaction cost economics, and the physics of far-from-equilibrium dissipative structures, we demonstrate that macroeconomic efficiency is maximized when macro-level competition is sustained by micro-level cooperative units We define the mathematical boundaries of the firm, the structural compression of agency costs, the resolution of internal capital dynamics, and the mechanism of institutional apoptosis, offering a rigorous formal blueprint for polycentric biomimetic design

AI.tldr: 本文提出"标量自然主义"框架，论证资本主义与共产主义的二分法是标量盲视（类似量子力学中波粒二象性）的认识论谬误。通过多层级选择理论、Price方程与热力学形式化，证明宏观经济效率在微观合作单元支撑宏观竞争时达到最优，并据此设计多中心仿生制度蓝图。
AI.research_question: 资本主义与共产主义的对立是否源于标量层次混淆？如何统一形式化政治经济学以超越这一二分法？
AI.motivation: 传统政治经济学将资本主义与共产主义视为不可调和的对立，作者认为这是忽视了经济现象在不同尺度下的表现差异，类似于量子力学中波粒二象性的认知困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标量自然主义、多层级选择理论（MLS）、Price方程、热力学、准函子映射（生物-经济范畴）、折现全要素生产率（TFP）、合作博弈论、威廉姆森交易成本经济学、非平衡耗散结构物理学、机构凋亡机制。
AI.method: 数学形式化推导：建立生物与经济范畴之间的准函子映射；通过折现TFP收紧Price方程；数学推导中央计划如何消除演化协方差梯度；运用合作博弈论与交易成本经济学分析企业边界与代理成本。
AI.findings: 宏观经济效率在"宏观竞争由微观合作单元支撑"时最大化；中央计划在数学上消除演化协方差梯度，破坏有效选择；定义了企业数学边界、代理成本的结构压缩、内部资本动态的解析、以及机构凋亡机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将标量视角引入政治经济学，消解资本主义/共产主义的二元对立；建立生物演化经济学与热力学政治经济学的统一形式化框架；为多中心治理提供严格数学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多中心仿生制度设计提供形式化蓝图；指导企业边界设定、内部资本市场配置、以及机构退出（凋亡）的制度设计。

title: Credit Lines With(out) Deposits
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business and Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business

detail.title: Credit Lines With(out) Deposits
detail.abstract: Classic theories of commitment financing establish a synergy between making credit lines and taking deposits. We empirically document that private credit lenders are increasingly providing commitment financing to their portfolio companies despite not using deposit financing. The utilization rates and maturities of their credit commitments are comparable to those of banks, and borrowers draw upon them in stressful times. We show that private credit lenders provide this liquidity using a combination of credit lines from banks, uncalled capital commitments, fund advisor support, and fund equity inflows. Although credit lines from banks are ultimately deposit-backed, our findings indicate that private credit lenders are able to substitute, at least in part, alternative funding sources for bank deposit-backed financing.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了私募信贷机构在不依赖存款融资的情况下，通过替代性资金来源（如银行贷款、未催缴资本承诺等）向其投资组合公司提供承诺融资，挑战了传统理论中信用额度与存款融资必须协同作用的观点。
AI.research_question: 私募信贷机构如何在不使用存款融资的情况下，为其投资组合公司提供承诺融资？
AI.motivation: 传统承诺融资理论认为发放信用额度与吸收存款之间存在协同效应，但现实中私募信贷机构越来越多地提供承诺融资却不依赖存款，这一现象需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 承诺融资理论；金融机构流动性供给理论；替代性融资来源理论
AI.method: 实证分析，利用私募信贷机构及其投资组合公司数据进行定量研究
AI.findings: 1）私募信贷机构的信用承诺使用率和期限与银行相当；2）借款人在压力时期会提取这些信用承诺；3）私募信贷机构通过银行贷款、未催缴资本承诺、基金顾问支持和基金股权流入的组合提供流动性；4）尽管银行贷款最终依赖存款，但私募信贷机构能在部分程度上替代存款支持融资。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统承诺融资理论中信用额度与存款融资必须协同的核心假设，揭示了替代性融资来源在流动性供给中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管者和市场参与者理解非银行金融机构的流动性供给机制提供了实证依据，有助于评估私募信贷市场系统性风险。

title: Five Facts About Stablecoins
affiliations: , Circle Internet Financial, Cornell University - Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management and

detail.title: Five Facts About Stablecoins
detail.abstract: We document five facts about payment stablecoins using granular blockchain data from 2020 to 2025. First, stablecoins are functioning as a transaction currency: their onchain transaction volume now exceeds Bitcoin's despite a far smaller outstanding supply, their velocity has risen sharply, and their transaction-size distribution has shifted toward small-value transfers. Second, we develop a Bayesian refinement of the standard visitor-share attribution methodology that uses transaction-timing data to help geolocate individual wallets. This approach shows that stablecoin activity is distributed broadly across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, but that standard methods substantially overstate the cross-regional share of flows. Third, we estimate a structural model of cash management on stablecoin transaction data and find that the typical stablecoin wallet operates on quantitative terms comparable to traditional cash holdings in terms of wallet replenishment opportunities and estimated transaction costs. Fourth, stablecoins are becoming the settlement currency for a rapidly expanding onchain credit market in which lending terms are enforced by rule-based smart contracts rather than by intermediary discretion; balance-sheet accounting disciplined by reserve and currency data indicates that stablecoins' growth reallocates rather than destroys credit. Fifth, stablecoins support programmable, machine-initiated payments: smart contracts participate in roughly a third of stablecoin transactions and over two-thirds of transfer volume on Ethereum, and early agentic-payment protocols such as x402 demonstrate machine-to-machine commerce at sub-cent transaction sizes. Together, these facts suggest that stablecoins are behaving as tokenized money. We discuss implications for traditional financial markets and the design of regulatory frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2020-2025年的区块链数据，从五个事实维度系统性地证明了支付型稳定币正在发挥代币化货币的功能，包括作为交易货币、地理分布广泛、现金管理行为与传统货币相当、成为链上信贷市场结算货币、以及支持可编程机器支付，并讨论了其对传统金融市场和监管框架的启示。
AI.research_question: 支付型稳定币是否以及如何在实践中发挥代币化货币的功能？
AI.motivation: 尽管稳定币市场规模快速增长，但对其实际经济功能（尤其是作为交易媒介）的系统性实证证据不足，亟需从链上数据出发检验稳定币是否真正扮演货币角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币职能理论（交易媒介、计价单位、价值储藏）、现金管理模型、贝叶斯地理归因方法、信贷市场结构理论。
AI.method: 颗粒化区块链数据分析（2020-2025）；贝叶斯改进的访客份额地理归因法；结构性现金管理模型估计；资产负债表与储备数据会计分析；智能合约参与度统计与案例研究。
AI.findings: (1) 稳定币交易量超过比特币、流转速率上升、交易规模向小额转移；(2) 稳定币活动广泛分布但标准方法高估跨境流动份额；(3) 典型钱包的现金管理行为与传统现金持有定量可比；(4) 稳定币成为链上信贷市场结算货币，其增长重新分配而非摧毁信贷；(5) 智能合约参与约三分之一的稳定币交易，早期机器支付协议实现亚美分级别交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"稳定币即代币化货币"提供了系统性实证证据；发展了基于交易时间数据的贝叶斯地理归因方法论；将传统现金管理模型扩展应用于加密资产钱包行为分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计稳定币监管框架提供实证基础；揭示稳定币对传统金融市场（支付系统、信贷市场）的潜在影响；展示机器对机器（M2M）支付的新范式。

title: Institutional Determinants of Procurement Performance in Kenyan County Governments: A Principal-Agent and Institutional Theory Perspective

detail.title: Institutional Determinants of Procurement Performance in Kenyan County Governments: A Principal-Agent and Institutional Theory Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. No financial or personal relationships with organisations or individuals that could inappropriately influence this work exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved a survey of adult professional employees of Lamu County Government, Kenya, in their official capacity. Formal ethics review board clearance was not required as no sensitive personal data were collected. All participants provided informed consent prior to participation. Participation was voluntary and responses were anonymous. The study was conducted in accordance with ethical research principles and the legal requirements of Kenya.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no dedicated external funding. The author is supported by the Chinese Government Scholarship Programme (CSC) administered through the Institute of South-South Cooperation and Development (ISSCAD), National School of Development, Peking University, Beijing, China.

detail.abstract: Kenya's devolution of procurement authority to 47 county governments has generated a paradox: a comprehensive legal and institutional architecture for procurement ethics coexists with persistent documented failures of procurement performance. This paper advances a theoretical explanation by integrating institutional theory's three-pillar framework with principal-agent theory's account of information asymmetry and moral hazard. Drawing on primary survey evidence from Lamu County Government (n = 53) and national audit records, the study argues that procurement governance failures are not primarily attributable to the absence of formal rules-the regulatory pillar is well-developed-but to the underdevelopment of normative and cultural-cognitive compliance mechanisms, combined with nested principal-agent structures that attenuate accountability at the staff level. The Lamu case illustrates this concretely: staff exhibit high self-reported ethical adoption, yet the county's audit record documents persistent irregularities-a gap jointly explained as decoupling between formal compliance and actual conduct. The paper develops a three-pillar institutional reform typology, proposes a five-priority research agenda for multi-county comparative scholarship, and derives policy implications for Kenya's national procurement reform architecture under the PPADA 2015 regime.

AI.tldr: 本文整合制度理论的三支柱框架与委托代理理论，解释肯尼亚采购权力下放后出现的悖论——完善的法律制度与持续的采购绩效失败并存，并以拉穆郡的实证数据揭示规范性和文化-认知合规机制薄弱及嵌套式委托代理结构是核心原因。
AI.research_question: 为何肯尼亚在拥有完善的采购伦理法律和制度架构的情况下，县级政府的采购绩效仍持续失败？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚将采购权下放至47个郡政府后，出现了"完善法律架构与持续采购失败"并存的悖论，现有研究未能提供充分的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论的三支柱框架（规制性、规范性、文化-认知支柱）与委托代理理论（信息不对称与道德风险）的整合。
AI.method: 拉穆郡政府的一手调查数据（n=53）与国家审计记录相结合。
AI.findings: 采购治理失败的主要原因并非正式规则缺失（规制支柱已完善），而是规范性和文化-认知合规机制发展不足，以及嵌套式委托代理结构削弱了基层员工层面的问责。员工自评伦理采纳度高，但审计记录显示持续违规，二者脱节表明正式合规与实际行为分离。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合制度理论与委托代理理论，提出"三支柱改革类型学"解释采购治理中正式制度与实际行动的脱钩现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五优先级的跨郡比较研究议程，并为肯尼亚PPADA 2015框架下的国家采购改革架构提供政策启示。

title: Vector of Needs: Economic Narratives and Market Comovement
affiliations: Independent and Simon Fraser University

detail.title: Vector of Needs: Economic Narratives and Market Comovement

declarations.funderStatement: Bégin wishes to acknowledge the financial support of the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada and Simon Fraser University.

detail.abstract: Narrative economics argues that stories move asset prices, yet most empirical work flattens complex narratives into simple positive or negative sentiment or broad topics. To address this, we introduce the vector of needs (VoN), a five-dimensional framework that measures the specific human motives a story activates: security, status, control, empathy, and transcendence. We operationalize this framework by applying natural language processing to 4.5 million US news headlines from 2007 to 2022. We then apply the VoN to analyze the cross-sectional structure of market risk. While the VIX measures the level of risk investors expect, the VoN reveals how that risk is distributed across assets. We find that narrative composition significantly predicts future market comovement. Status narratives concentrate comovement, drawing assets together, while transcendence narratives decouple industry returns. Conditional on the VIX and standard predictors, our narrative factors forecast next month's correlation structure out of sample, adding 6.8% incremental R^2 for factor concentration and 6.4% for average pairwise correlation. Ultimately, we demonstrate that different psychological states in the public sphere produce distinctly different shapes of financial risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"需求向量"(VoN)框架，通过五个心理维度（安全、地位、控制、共情、超越）量化新闻叙事内容，发现叙事构成显著影响股市的横截面风险结构，尤其是地位叙事增强市场联动，超越叙事则促进行业解耦。
AI.research_question: 新闻叙事的内容维度如何影响股市的横截面风险结构（即市场联动性）？
AI.motivation: 现有叙事经济学研究大多将复杂叙事简化为正面/负面情绪或宽泛主题，忽视了叙事内容中更细致的心理动机维度。作者希望更精确地捕捉"故事"影响资产价格的具体机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事经济学（Narrative Economics）、需求向量（Vector of Needs, VoN）五维框架（安全、地位、控制、共情、超越）、行为金融学中的心理动机理论。
AI.method: 运用自然语言处理（NLP）对2007-2022年间450万条美国新闻标题进行VoN维度打分，构建叙事因子，再通过回归分析检验叙事因子对市场联动性（如因子集中度、平均成对相关性）的预测能力，并与VIX等传统指标对比。
AI.findings: 叙事构成显著预测未来市场联动性：地位叙事增强资产集中联动，超越叙事降低行业间相关性。在控制VIX和标准预测变量后，叙事因子对因子集中度的样本外增量R²为6.8%，对平均成对相关性的增量R²为6.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将叙事经济学从粗粒度情绪分析推进到精细的心理维度分析，揭示了不同心理动机驱动的叙事会塑造"不同形状"的金融风险，拓展了对市场风险结构的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和风险管理机构提供了一种新的叙事监控工具，帮助预测市场联动性变化，进而优化投资组合分散化策略和风险对冲决策。

title: Parliamentary Journalism in Contemporary Parliaments: New Media, Political Agendas and News Coverage in the Hellenic Parliament
affiliations: , Hellenic OCR Team, Democritus University of Thrace and Parliamentary Journalist

detail.title: Parliamentary Journalism in Contemporary Parliaments: New Media, Political Agendas and News Coverage in the Hellenic Parliament

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have influenced or be perceived to have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used anonymous survey data from parliamentary journalists. Formal ethics approval was not required. Participation was voluntary and based on informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The rapid advancement of new media has fundamentally transformed the practice of parliamentary journalism. Digital platforms have reshaped how political information is produced, distributed, and consumed. This working paper examines the impact of new media technology on parliamentary journalism, focusing on changes in news gathering, audience engagement, and the relationship between journalists, political actors, and the public. By analysing existing literature and contemporary case examples, the study highlights the democratic potential of new media and the risks they pose to journalistic credibility and ethical standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨新媒体技术如何改变议会新闻的采编、受众互动以及记者、政治人物与公众之间的关系，既看到新媒体的民主潜力，也指出其对新闻可信度和伦理标准带来的风险。
AI.research_question: 新媒体技术如何影响议会新闻的新闻采集、受众参与以及记者、政治行动者与公众之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 新媒体的快速发展从根本上改变了议会新闻的实践方式，数字平台重塑了政治信息的产生、分发和消费模式，因此有必要系统审视这些变化及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主潜力理论、新闻可信度与伦理标准理论
AI.method: 文献综述与当代案例分析方法
AI.findings: 新媒体技术既为议会新闻带来了民主参与的新机遇（如更广泛的受众互动），也带来了新闻可信度下降和伦理标准受损的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了新媒体对议会新闻业的多维影响，平衡地呈现了民主潜力与伦理风险的理论张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新闻从业者、政策制定者和媒体机构应对新媒体环境下的挑战提供了参考框架。

title: Frontier Markets
affiliations: , Independent, , ,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Frontier Markets
detail.abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了前沿市场（FM）地位如何成为低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板，分析了影响LICs获得或失去FM地位的关键因素，发现稳健的宏观经济基本面、良好治理、灵活汇率、充足外汇储备、低公共债务和赤字水平是关键推动因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素决定了前沿市场（FM）地位？低收入国家（LICs）如何获得或失去这一地位？什么因素能降低FM主权利差对全球金融条件变化的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 自2008年全球金融危机以来，前沿市场投资吸引力显著上升，但近期一系列全球冲击（如新冠疫情）暴露了这些国家的持续脆弱性。目前对FM地位决定因素的系统性理解仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前沿市场地位的决定因素理论；主权利差对全球金融条件敏感性的影响因素理论。
AI.method: 采用动态国家样本，对FM地位的决定因素进行实证分析，考察LICs获得和失去FM地位的影响因素。
AI.findings: 1）稳健的宏观经济基本面和良好治理是成为FM的关键；2）灵活汇率、充足官方储备缓冲、较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融条件变化敏感性的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对前沿市场地位决定因素的理论理解；揭示了LICs向EMs过渡的动态机制；系统识别了降低FM外部金融脆弱性的关键变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入国家政策制定者提供了明确路径：加强宏观经济基本面、改善治理、保持汇率灵活性、积累外汇储备、控制财政赤字和债务水平，以提升FM地位并增强金融韧性。

title: Pricing Reform Progress
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department

detail.title: Pricing Reform Progress
detail.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了卡塔尔主权信贷利差的影响因素，发现整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度有助于收紧外部主权信贷利差，投资者将财政纪律视为整体改革和经济多元化的一部分，广泛改革还能增强主权信贷利差对外部冲击的韧性。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响卡塔尔的外部主权信贷利差？投资者如何评估卡塔尔的改革进程？
AI.motivation: 理解主权信贷利差的决定因素，为卡塔尔第三国家发展战略下的财政和货币政策改革提供实证支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权信贷利差理论、改革信号理论、宏观经济政策可信度理论。
AI.method: 计量经济学实证分析，研究整体改革、财政支出纪律、货币政策可信度与主权信贷利差之间的关系。
AI.findings: 整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信贷利差收紧相关；投资者将财政纪律视为整体改革和经济多元化的一部分；广泛的改革进步增强了主权信贷利差对外部冲击的韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了改革信号在主权信贷市场中的作用，将财政纪律与整体改革框架联系起来，丰富了新兴市场主权信贷利差决定因素的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卡塔尔及类似经济体在第三国家发展战略下推行整体性财政与货币政策改革提供了实证依据，说明改革有助于降低融资成本并增强抗风险能力。

title: Beyond Remittances: A Productivity-Led, AI-Augmented Strategy for Raising Nepal's Long-Term Growth to 5–6 Percent
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond Remittances: A Productivity-Led, AI-Augmented Strategy for Raising Nepal's Long-Term Growth to 5–6 Percent

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, clinical trials, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author. Computational assistance from AI tools was used for calculations and drafting support, with all analysis and conclusions reviewed and validated by the author.

detail.abstract:
Nepal is about to cross an important threshold - in November 2026, it's officially set to leave its "Least Developed Country" status behind. That sounds like progress, and in some ways it is. But the economy has real problems that don't disappear with a new label.

The biggest one is that Nepal runs largely on money sent home by its citizens working abroad. Remittances keep households afloat and fuel consumer spending, but they don't build an economy. The country produces relatively little, has barely industrialized, and has no strong engine of growth beyond people buying things with money earned elsewhere.

So what would actually change that? This paper tries to answer that question seriously, using an economic model built around Nepal's specific conditions rather than generic development theory. Three paths are laid out and compared: carrying on as things are, making moderate reforms, and pairing those reforms with targeted use of AI.

The findings aren't surprising, but they're worth stating clearly. Remittances can sustain growth in the short run, but getting to a consistent 5–6% annual growth rate requires harder work — better use of capital, stronger institutions, real digital infrastructure, actually developing the hydropower resources Nepal sits on top of, more productive farming, and faster movement of goods at the border.

On AI specifically, the paper stays grounded. It looks at concrete use cases — crop advisory tools, energy demand forecasting, customs automation, Nepali-language technology — and is honest that none of it works without the policy groundwork being laid first. AI isn't a shortcut. Used well, it amplifies reforms that are already happening. Used in isolation, it doesn't do much.

The broader argument is simple: Nepal has a real opportunity to build something more durable than a remittance-dependent economy, but it won't happen on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文利用一个基于尼泊尔特定条件的经济模型，分析了该国在2026年脱离最不发达国家地位后的发展路径。研究发现，侨汇可以支撑短期增长，但实现5-6%的持续年增长率需要更深入的改革，包括改善资本利用、加强制度建设、发展数字基础设施、开发水电资源、提升农业生产力以及提高边境贸易效率。人工智能可以放大已有改革的效果，但不能替代基础性政策建设。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔在脱离最不发达国家地位后，如何实现从侨汇依赖型经济向可持续增长模式的转型？人工智能在其中能发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔将于2026年11月正式脱离最不发达国家地位，但其经济高度依赖侨汇，缺乏工业化和内生增长动力。现有发展理论未必适用于尼泊尔的具体国情，因此需要基于其特定条件构建经济模型，探索可行的发展路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于尼泊尔特定条件的经济增长模型，比较了三种发展路径：（1）维持现状；（2）适度改革；（3）改革结合人工智能的针对性应用。
AI.method: 构建了一个反映尼泊尔具体条件的经济模型，对三种发展路径进行模拟和比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）侨汇可以在短期内支撑经济增长，但无法实现5-6%的持续年增长率；（2）实现长期增长需要改善资本利用、加强制度建设、发展数字基础设施、开发水电资源、提升农业生产力、提高边境贸易效率；（3）人工智能在作物咨询、能源需求预测、海关自动化和本地语言技术等具体应用场景中有价值，但前提是基础性政策改革已经到位；（4）AI不是捷径，而是现有改革的放大器。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小型开放经济体（特别是侨汇依赖型国家）的转型提供了基于具体国情的建模分析，揭示了人工智能与发展政策之间的互补关系，而非替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔及其他类似国家提供了清晰的政策路径选择：单纯的侨汇经济不可持续，需要系统性改革；AI应用应嵌入已有改革框架，而非单独推行。

title: Scaling Representative Deliberation: The Two-Sided Loop — A Governance Design Concept to Balance Legitimacy and Competence
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Scaling Representative Deliberation: The Two-Sided Loop — A Governance Design Concept to Balance Legitimacy and Competence
detail.abstract: How can a whole population make high-stakes decisions together efficiently, with low bias, and with enough throughput to be practical? Every institution for collective decision-making is built on a fault line between legitimacy, the sense that a decision is rightfully ours because we shaped it, and competence, the question of whether the decision is any good. Systems force a trade between the two because they ask a single mechanism to deliver both. This paper proposes a standing institution that refuses that bargain. It draws legitimacy from who is in the room-a large, stratified, openly nominated citizen pool filtered only for reasoning quality-and competence from how the room is filtered and tested: random rotating panels, mandatory cost accounting, and three blind independent judging passes whose between-pass agreement functions as a replication test. Drafting is pooled and made competitive on exactly the same terms as judging, so agenda-setting power is dissolved as far as voting power; we call this symmetry the two-sided loop. The aim is not to manufacture perfect statute but to approximate, as closely as today's technology allows, the sovereign ideal that all who are governed should have a say, while minimizing bias, keeping throughput pragmatic, and remaining genuinely implementable. We situate the design against sortition, epistemic and deliberative democracy, multi-body lottocratic proposals, mechanism design, replication, and cryptographic governance. We then give a formal analysis of the replication component, proving an identifiability result: three blind passes are an unbiased detector of panel-level noise but are provably blind to bias carried by the pool itself, with pool-level capture inheriting exactly the same blind spot. The two genuinely novel moves are the symmetric randomized two-sided loop and the use of inter-panel variance as a first-class confidence output; the further contribution is a synthesis that modern encryption, automation, random generation, and digital identity make implementable now rather than only in theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"双面环"（two-sided loop）的常设集体决策制度，通过大规模分层公民池、随机轮换小组、强制成本核算和三重盲审复制检验来同时实现合法性与能力，并证明三重盲审是面板级噪声的无偏检测器，但对池级偏差存在盲区。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个让全体人口高效、低偏见、高吞吐量地做出高风险集体决策的常设制度？
AI.motivation: 现有集体决策制度在合法性（决策因由我们塑造而感到正当）和能力（决策质量好坏）之间存在根本性冲突，单一机制无法同时提供两者，需要一种拒绝这种权衡的新制度设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抽选制（sortition）、认知民主与协商民主（epistemic and deliberative democracy）、多体抽选提案（multi-body lottocratic proposals）、机制设计（mechanism design）、复制检验（replication）、密码学治理（cryptographic governance）。
AI.method: 制度设计+形式化分析（formal analysis），对复制检验（三重盲审）组件进行数学证明，得出可识别性结果（identifiability result）。
AI.findings: (1) 三重盲审是面板级噪声的无偏检测器，但对池级偏差（pool-level capture）存在与生俱来的盲区；(2) 对称随机化双面环和面板间方差作为置信度输出是两个真正的创新点；(3) 现代加密、自动化、随机生成和数字身份使该制度在当下即可实施。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出对称随机化双面环（symmetric randomized two-sided loop），将议程设置权消解为与投票权相同的地位；(2) 证明了三重盲审复制检验的可识别性边界——能检测面板级噪声但无法检出池级偏差；(3) 将面板间方差作为第一类置信度输出引入集体决策领域。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了一个可立即实施的常设集体决策制度方案，平衡了合法性、能力与吞吐量；(2) 明确指出了制度对系统性捕获（pool-level capture）的盲区，为实际应用中的风险管控提供预警；(3) 整合现代技术（加密、自动化、数字身份）使理论设计落地成为可能。

title: The Decline of the Jute Industry in India

detail.title: The Decline of the Jute Industry in India
detail.abstract: This paper traces the structural unravelling of India's jute industry from 1921 onward-a decline that was not inevitable, but engineered. Centred on the Hooghly belt of Bengal, the study examines how the Indian Jute Mills Association (IJMA), a British-controlled cartel, worked hand-in-glove with the colonial state to squeeze every last advantage from an industry while shutting out Indian ownership, workers' rights, and long-term investment. Through production records, labour histories, colonial inquiry reports, and Bengali oral sources, the paper maps four cascading crises: the 1921 policy reversal that ended wartime stability; the Great Depression of 1929; the raw material catastrophe created by Partition in 1947; and the slow erosion by synthetic fibres. The argument is simple but uncomfortable: jute's decline was not a market accident. It was the cumulative result of deliberate choices-choices made by people who never bore their consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了印度黄麻行业自1921年起的结构性瓦解——这场衰落并非不可避免，而是被精心策划的。研究聚焦孟加拉胡格利地带，剖析了英国控制的卡特尔——印度黄麻厂协会（IJMA）如何与殖民政府勾结，从该行业中榨取最后一点利益，同时将印度人所有权、工人权益和长期投资排除在外。通过生产记录、劳工史、殖民调查报告和孟加拉口述资料，论文描绘了四重危机：1921年结束战时稳定的政策逆转、1929年大萧条、1947年印巴分治造成的原材料灾难，以及合成纤维的缓慢侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 印度黄麻行业的衰落是市场自然演变的结果，还是殖民权力结构有意设计与操纵的产物？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于后殖民时期产业衰落的传统解释——即将其归因于经济转型、技术过时或全球化竞争——揭示殖民时期制度安排的延续性如何系统性地预先决定了某些产业的崩溃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民政治经济学、制度性种族排斥理论、卡特尔与殖民国家共谋理论、结构性依赖与去工业化理论
AI.method: 混合方法：定量生产数据分析、劳工史档案研究、殖民调查报告审查、孟加拉语口述史料采集
AI.findings: 黄麻产业的衰落是四重危机的连锁效应：1921年政策逆转（结束战时稳定）、1929年大萧条、1947年印巴分治导致的原材料断裂、以及合成纤维的长期替代。每一步危机中，英国控制的IJMA和殖民政府的选择都优先考虑短期利润榨取而非产业长期健康，且决策者从未承担后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"人为非工业化"（engineered de-industrialization）概念，将产业衰落从"市场失败"重新定义为"制度性掠夺"，补充了殖民经济史中关于"主动去工业化"的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后殖民国家产业政策制定提供历史警示：若权力结构不均衡、决策者不承担后果，看似中性的市场力量可能成为系统性剥夺的工具；对当前全球供应链重组中的"去工业化"风险有借鉴意义。

title: Resilience by Design
affiliations: , , International Monetary Fund (IMF), ,  and Institute of Social and Political Sciences, Universidade de Lisboa

detail.title: Resilience by Design
detail.abstract: The changing global economic landscape is likely to expose the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENAP) and Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) regions to more frequent external shocks, putting a premium on resilient and flexible macroeconomic policy frameworks. By using empirical analysis and model-based scenarios, this paper highlights the important roles of policy frameworks in stabilizing MENAP and CCA economies against adverse global shocks. Two messages stand out from the analysis. First, as countries make progress toward diversifying their exports and deepening domestic financial markets, credible inflation-targeting monetary policy regimes that allow greater exchange rate flexibility could enable faster adjustment to adverse global shocks. Second, adopting strong fiscal rules could help better anchor long-term expectations, reduce risk premiums, and help support countercyclical fiscal responses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证分析和模型情景模拟，论证了中东、北非、巴基斯坦以及高加索和中亚地区在面对日益频繁的外部冲击时，建立可信的通货膨胀目标制货币政策（配合更灵活的汇率）和强有力的财政规则，能够有效稳定经济、加速调整并支持逆周期财政应对。
AI.research_question: 在全球经济格局变化导致外部冲击更加频繁的背景下，MENAP和CCA地区的宏观经济政策框架（货币政策和财政规则）如何帮助稳定经济并加速应对不利冲击？
AI.motivation: 全球经济的深刻变化使得新兴和发展中经济体面临更频繁的外部冲击，MENAP和CCA地区尤为脆弱，需要明确何种政策框架能够增强其经济韧性与灵活性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观稳定政策理论、通货膨胀目标制货币政策框架、汇率弹性调整机制、财政规则与预期锚定理论、逆周期财政政策理论。
AI.method: 实证分析（econometric analysis）与基于模型的情景模拟（model-based scenarios）。
AI.findings: 1) 随着出口多元化和国内金融市场深化，可信的通货膨胀目标制加更大汇率弹性可加速应对外部冲击的调整；2) 强有力的财政规则有助于锚定长期预期、降低风险溢价，并支持逆周期财政政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统验证了在出口多元化和金融市场深化的条件下，通胀目标制与汇率弹性组合对MENAP和CCA地区的稳定效应；拓展了财政规则在降低风险溢价和支持逆周期政策方面的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MENAP和CCA地区政策制定者提供了明确的政策框架建议：推动出口多元化与金融深化，采用可信的通胀目标制与浮动汇率安排，并建立强有力的财政规则以增强经济韧性。

title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
affiliations: ,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Policy Development and Review Department

detail.title: Should Oil Economies Worry About Oil Shocks’ Impact on the Banking System? The Case of Oman
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含银行部门内生信贷配给和主权财富基金稳定规则的DSGE模型，以阿曼为案例，研究油价冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。研究发现，流动性渠道在传导中占主导地位（贡献了超54%的非石油GDP方差和53%的信贷方差），并识别出一种“流动性缓冲陷阱”——银行在繁荣期因预防性动机持有超额流动性，从而抑制了生产性信贷。反事实制度分析表明，信贷深度、银行保守主义以及伊斯兰银行和sukuk市场的发展（愿景2040）增强了结构韧性。
AI.research_question: 油价冲击如何通过银行部门传导至石油依赖型经济体？具体而言，流动性渠道与偿付能力渠道在传导过程中各自发挥多大作用？
AI.motivation: 石油依赖型经济体（如阿曼）高度暴露于油价波动风险，银行部门作为经济核心中介，其稳定至关重要。然而，现有文献缺乏对油价冲击通过银行系统传导的结构化定量分析，尤其是区分流动性渠道与偿付能力渠道的相对重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: DSGE模型（动态随机一般均衡模型），包含：（1）集成的银行部门模块，引入内生信贷配给；（2）主权财富基金稳定规则；（3）两种传导渠道：偿付能力渠道（信用风险/不良贷款）与流动性渠道（顺周期的政府存款提取和主权债务发行）。
AI.method: （1）构建DSGE模型，校准至阿曼制度目标；（2）采用贝叶斯方法进行参数估计；（3）进行结构方差分解以量化各冲击的贡献；（4）开展反事实制度分析。
AI.findings: （1）油价冲击解释了超过54%的非石油GDP方差和53%的信贷方差；（2）银行资本冲击贡献低于0.1%，确认流动性渠道占主导；（3）识别出“流动性缓冲陷阱”——银行在繁荣期因预防性动机持有超额流动性，抑制生产性信贷；（4）信贷深度和银行保守主义保护长期物质资本形成；（5）伊斯兰银行和sukuk市场（愿景2040）进一步放大结构韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在DSGE框架中同时整合偿付能力渠道和流动性渠道，并定量确认流动性渠道在油价冲击传导中的主导地位；（2）提出“流动性缓冲陷阱”概念，丰富了预防性流动性需求理论；（3）为石油依赖型经济体的银行系统性风险传导机制提供了结构化的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为阿曼及类似石油依赖型经济体在油价波动下的宏观审慎政策制定提供依据；（2）揭示伊斯兰银行和sukuk市场发展（愿景2040）在增强金融韧性方面的积极作用；（3）建议政策制定者关注流动性渠道而非仅关注资本充足率，以防范油价冲击对银行系统的风险。

title: The Volatility Channel of the Deposit Franchise
affiliations: Prague University of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Volatility Channel of the Deposit Franchise
detail.abstract: Deposit market power creates a path-dependent channel for bank profitability, distinct from the familiar level channel. Because many banks reprice deposits asymmetrically, passing through rate increases more slowly than decreases, funding spreads are convex in the short rate, so expected net interest margins (NIM) depend on the volatility of the rate path, not only its level. We formalize this mechanism in a model with asymmetric deposit repricing and test its predictions using U.S. bank-quarter data from 1984-2025. The effect operates through funding costs rather than asset yields, concentrates in discretionary savings and money-market deposits, and is ordered cross-sectionally by repricing convexity. Deposit franchises therefore contain both static level rents and dynamic volatility exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了存款市场势力不仅通过利率水平影响银行盈利，还通过不对称的存款重新定价机制，使银行净息差对利率路径的波动性敏感，从而形成动态的波动性敞口渠道。
AI.research_question: 存款市场势力如何通过利率路径依赖渠道（而非仅通过利率水平渠道）影响银行盈利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为存款市场势力主要通过利率水平（静态利差）影响银行利润，但现实中银行对存款利率的调整存在不对称性（加息时上调慢、降息时下调快），这种不对称会如何影响银行净息差？现有文献对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不对称存款重新定价模型：银行对存款利率的调整存在凸性（加息时传递慢于降息），导致资金利差对短期利率呈凸性关系，从而净息差不仅取决于利率水平，还取决于利率路径的波动性。
AI.method: 构建理论模型形式化不对称存款重新定价机制，并使用1984-2025年美国银行-季度面板数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）存款市场势力通过利率路径依赖渠道影响银行盈利能力，该渠道独立于传统的水平渠道；（2）该效应通过资金成本端（而非资产收益端）发挥作用；（3）效应集中在可自由支配储蓄存款和货币市场存款中；（4）截面排序上，重新定价凸性越大的银行，该效应越显著。因此，存款特许经营权既包含静态水平租金，也包含动态波动性敞口。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次区分了存款市场势力的"水平渠道"和"路径依赖渠道"；（2）将存款利率调整的不对称性与银行净息差的凸性联系起来，拓展了银行盈利能力决定因素的理论框架；（3）揭示了存款特许经营权中的波动性风险敞口维度。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为银行管理层和投资者理解存款业务的风险-收益特征提供了新视角——存款市场势力不仅是静态的租金来源，还包含动态的利率波动性风险；（2）对监管机构而言，利率路径的波动性（而非仅利率水平）会影响银行体系盈利的稳定性；（3）为银行估值和风险管理中的利率风险度量提供了新的分析维度。

title:
The Self-Annulling Signal 
How Popularized Technical Patterns Invert into Liquidity Traps: A Microstructure Account of Signal Obsolescence by Diusion
affiliations: Independent Research

detail.title:
The Self-Annulling Signal 
How Popularized Technical Patterns Invert into Liquidity Traps: A Microstructure Account of Signal Obsolescence by Diusion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests in relation to the work reported here.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Classical technical analysis was codied in an era of human-intermediated order ow, in which chart patterns described the aggregate psychology of the participants who were themselves the market's price-forming mechanism. We argue that a structural change in that mechanism the transition to systematic, information-processing intermediaries that possess the entire technical canon inverts the function of any suciently popularized pattern. The argument rests on three established results of market microstructure: that informed participants prot by exploiting the camouage provided by uninformed order ow (Kyle, 1985); that price formation is the Bayesian updating of a market maker against a ow that mixes informed and uninformed trades (Glosten and Milgrom, 1985); and that large execution requires counterpart that does not exist spontaneously at scale, and must therefore be induced. We formalize a signal inversion result: when a decision rule becomes common knowledge among the uninformed, the location it marks ceases to be a place where the rule's followers are served and becomes a place where they are predictably aggregated precisely the counterpart an informed participant requires. A classical support level, in a mechanism that knows the rule, does not fail by chance; it fails by necessity, because its popularity converts it into a map of the prey. The result is a reexive obsolescence specic to widely diused signals, and it has a sharp methodological corollary: the only robust posture is to localize the structure that induces the trap rather than to predict the direction it resolves toward the latter being, we argue, the single variable in the system without recoverable cause. We delimit the claim honestly: it concerns popularized rules, not all technical information; it localizes, it does not predict; and any operational reading that itself diuses is subject to the very inversion it describes.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了一个结构性反转：当技术分析规则被广泛普及并成为非知情交易者的共同知识后，这些规则指示的位置会从“服务追随者”变成“聚集猎物”的陷阱，因为知情交易者可以利用这些可预测的订单流来执行大额交易。这一结论源于市场微观结构的三个经典结果，并具有重要的方法论推论：唯一稳健的立场是定位诱捕结构本身，而非预测方向。
AI.research_question: 当技术分析规则被广泛普及后，这些规则在市场中的功能是否会发生结构性反转？
AI.motivation: 经典技术分析形成于人工中介主导订单流的时代，而当代市场已转向系统性、信息处理型的中介机构，且这些中介掌握了整个技术分析体系。这种结构性变化可能使被广泛普及的技术模式功能发生反转。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kyle (1985) 知情交易者利用非知情订单流作为掩护；Glosten & Milgrom (1985) 做市商对混合订单流进行贝叶斯更新；大额执行需要诱导对手方。
AI.method: 理论形式化推导，基于市场微观结构经典模型推导信号反转结果。
AI.findings: 当一个决策规则成为非知情者的共同知识后，该规则标记的位置不再是服务追随者的地方，而是成为可预测的订单聚集地——恰是知情交易者所需的大额交易对手方。经典支撑位在知晓规则的机制中不是偶然失败，而是必然失败，因为其流行度将其转化为"猎物地图"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"反身性过时"（reflexive obsolescence）概念，解释了广泛传播信号的自我失效机制；形式化了信号反转结果，将技术分析的失效从经验观察提升为理论必然。
AI.practical_contributions: 方法论推论：唯一稳健的立场是定位诱导陷阱的结构本身，而非预测陷阱最终朝哪个方向突破——后者是系统中唯一无法恢复原因的变量。同时诚实地限定了结论范围：仅涉及被普及的规则，而非所有技术信息；定位而非预测；任何自身被传播的操作性解读也会受制于同样的反转。
