title: From River to Server: Hydrological Modelling of the Ganga for Sustainable AI Infrastructure!
affiliations: Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute and Gokhale Institute

detail.title: From River to Server: Hydrological Modelling of the Ganga for Sustainable AI Infrastructure!

contentType.other: Original unpublished manuscript submitted for first-time review/publication.

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, the paper has neither appeared nor been accepted for publication in a paper series, journal, or book.

detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure has significantly increased the demand for data centres, which require substantial quantities of freshwater for cooling and operational purposes. In a water-stressed country like India, balancing digital development with sustainable water-resource management has become a critical challenge. The River Ganga, one of India’s most important ecological, cultural, and economic lifelines, presents both an opportunity and a responsibility for sustainable infrastructure planning.

This study investigates the hydrological suitability of the Upper Ganga basin for the development of AI data centres by applying the Nash Cascade Model to analyze river-flow dynamics and long-term water availability. Using secondary discharge data obtained from the Central Water Commission of India, the river system is represented as a second-order cascade of linear reservoirs and examined through a state-space formulation involving phase portraits, slope fields, and eigenvalue stability analysis. The results demonstrate that the Nash system converges towards a stable equilibrium, indicating predictable and resilient flow behavior under varying initial conditions. The storage coefficient further provides insight into the basin’s ability to regulate flow fluctuations and maintain hydrological stability.

A multi-criteria suitability assessment identifies Prayagraj as the most favorable location for AI data centre development within the Ganga basin due to its high annual discharge, reliable dry-season flow supported by the Yamuna confluence, strong infrastructure accessibility, and manageable flood risk. The findings demonstrate that mathematically informed hydrological models can provide an effective framework for balancing technological expansion with environmental conservation. The study ultimately proposes a data-driven approach to data centre siting that aligns with sustainable water management and the broader objective of preserving the ecological integrity of the River Ganga.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过纳什级联模型分析上恒河盆地的水文适宜性，评估AI数据中心选址，发现Prayagraj是最佳地点，并提出数据驱动的可持续选址方法以平衡技术扩张与水资源保护。
AI.research_question: 如何在水资源紧张的印度恒河上游盆地中，评估并确定适宜开发AI数据中心的水文适宜性地点？
AI.motivation: 人工智能、云计算等数字基础设施的快速扩张大大增加了数据中心的淡水需求，在印度这样的水资源紧张国家，平衡数字发展与可持续水资源管理成为关键挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纳什级联模型（Nash Cascade Model）、状态空间分析（相图、斜率场、特征值稳定性分析）、多准则适宜性评估。
AI.method: 利用印度中央水务委员会的次级径流数据，将河流系统表示为二阶线性水库级联，通过状态空间公式进行相图、斜率场和特征值稳定性分析；结合多准则评估（年径流量、旱季流量、基础设施可达性、洪水风险）进行选址。
AI.findings: 纳什系统收敛于稳定均衡，表明水流行为具有可预测性和韧性；存储系数揭示了盆地调节流量波动的能力；Prayagraj因高年径流量、可靠的旱季流量（得益于亚穆纳河汇流）、良好的基础设施可达性和可控的洪水风险，被确定为最有利的数据中心选址地点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将纳什级联模型与状态空间稳定性分析方法相结合，为水文适宜性评估提供了数学驱动的理论框架，证明了数学水文模型可有效指导技术基础设施的可持续选址。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度恒河流域数据中心的可持续选址提供了数据驱动的决策框架，提出了可操作的多准则评估方法，有助于在数字扩张与恒河生态保护之间取得平衡。

title: From Compliance to Market Power: Producer Strategy, Structural Fingerprints, and the Limits of Reactive Positioning in Commodity Markets

detail.title: From Compliance to Market Power: Producer Strategy, Structural Fingerprints, and the Limits of Reactive Positioning in Commodity Markets
detail.abstract:
Why do commodity-exporting developing countries accept prices set by buyers, even when their production volumes dominate global supply? Incentive-based accounts attribute this to market access conditions, buyer capability requirements, and regulatory design. This paper proposes a structural explanation grounded in the Market Suffocation Hypothesis (MSH): producers remain price-takers because buyers retain abundant sourcing alternatives, and the structural conditions required to close those alternatives are absent in most commodity-exporting contexts.

The paper extends the MSH to its supply-side analogue and introduces the Producer Market Power Index (PMPI) — a four-component measurement instrument incorporating a buyer concentration modifier from Herfindahl-Hirschman Index calculations and a non-price measure of differentiation depth from WIPO Lex intellectual property data. Six structural fingerprints of successful producer market power are identified inductively from Ethiopian specialty coffee, Colombian palm oil, Vietnamese pangasius, and Costa Rican coffee, and cross-validated against documented failure cases. The paper formalises participation constraints for producer coalitions, drawing on the 2026 UAE exit from OPEC as a live case of coalition fracture under diverging individual time horizons — a dynamic with direct agricultural analogues in smallholder responses to biological asset cycles and climate stress.

A third entry path is identified alongside the compliance sequencing framework: where producers select or pivot to a product for which no low-quality substitute exists, the quality sink is absent by design rather than closed by enforcement. The central implication is that compliance investment and strategic market power are sequentially rational, not mutually exclusive — the infrastructure built for compliance creates the traceability, governance, and buyer relationship assets from which market power can subsequently be developed. The paper establishes a theory-building and diagnostic architecture for identifying when and how producing countries can pursue market power, and proposes an empirical programme for out-of-sample validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"市场窒息假说"的供给侧版本，解释大宗商品出口国为何接受买方定价，并构建了生产者市场势力指数（PMPI）来识别生产者获得市场势力的结构性条件，指出合规投资与战略市场势力是顺序理性关系而非相互排斥。
AI.research_question: 为什么大宗商品出口国的生产者在产量主导全球供应的情况下，仍然接受买方设定的价格？
AI.motivation: 现有激励导向的解释（市场准入条件、买方能力要求、监管设计）不足以解释生产者持续的价格接受行为，需要从结构性角度提供更根本的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场窒息假说（MSH）的供给侧扩展；生产者合作参与约束理论；合规排序框架；时间偏好差异导致的联盟破裂动态（以2026年阿联酋退出OPEC为案例）。
AI.method: 归纳法：从埃塞俄比亚精品咖啡、哥伦比亚棕榈油、越南巴沙鱼和哥斯达黎加咖啡四个成功案例中识别出六个结构性指纹，并与失败案例进行交叉验证；构建生产者市场势力指数（PMPI），包含买方集中度修正的Herfindahl-Hirschman指数和基于WIPO Lex知识产权数据的非价格差异化深度指标。
AI.findings: 识别出生产者获取市场势力的六个结构性指纹；发现合规投资与市场势力是顺序理性关系；提出第三条进入路径：生产者选择或转向不存在低质量替代品的产品，从而从设计上消除质量下沉问题；指出生产者联盟的参与约束受个体时间偏好差异影响，这在农业领域表现为小农对生物资产周期和气候压力的异质性反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场窒息假说扩展到供给侧；提出生产者市场势力指数（PMPI）作为测量工具；识别生产者市场势力的结构性指纹；建立合规投资与市场势力之间的顺序理性关系理论；识别生产者联盟破裂的动态机制（时间偏好差异）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大宗商品出口国提供了诊断工具（PMPI）和战略路径（合规后逐步建立市场势力），有助于发展中国家制定从价格接受者向价格制定者转型的政策与策略。

title: Auditing the Audit Trails: A Cryptographic Framework and a Compliance Survey of 185 Published Machine-Learning Papers in Quantitative Finance
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Auditing the Audit Trails: A Cryptographic Framework and a Compliance Survey of 185 Published Machine-Learning Papers in Quantitative Finance
detail.abstract: The U.S. Federal Reserve’s SR 11-7 (April 2011) and the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689, effective for high-risk systems on 2 August 2026) require firms deploying machine-learning models in regulated domains to maintain per-prediction audit trails: code state, data state, model state, compute environment, and the prediction itself, recorded with enough integrity protection that an external reviewer can verify any claim ex post. Existing open-source ML tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) targets experiment tracking or artifact versioning; none produces an SR 11-7-shaped audit trail with low-friction integration, vendor-neutral storage, and regulator-export capability out of the box. This paper makes two paired contributions. First, we introduce mr-audit, an open-source Python package that writes one immutable, hash-chained record per ML prediction, capturing git commit, library versions, input hash, model parameters, compute environment, random seed, and prediction value. Records form a linked hash chain via SHA-256; tampering with any record breaks the chain. The package ships with a replay engine, a driftdetection module (Kolmogorov-Smirnov plus Population Stability Index), and a regulator-export bundle. We compare mr-audit head-to-head against five existing tools on nine audit-trail capabilities and on three quantitative benchmarks (throughput, storage overhead, tamper-detection sensitivity). Second, we apply the same compliance rubric to a corpus of 185 published machine-learning papers in quantitative finance posted between 1952 and 2025 (drawn from the 119-paper survey corpus of Khan (2026b) and a 2024–2025 arXivq-fin extension constrained to papers with a discoverable code-repository link). For each paper, an automated pipeline locates the code link, clones the repository, and mechanically scores the six static compliance dimensions: code accessibility, data release, computational environment, random-seed documentation, input-data lineage, and model-state persistence. The static-six analysis followed a pre-specified plan (hypotheses and rubric fixed before the scoring step and deposited at OSF); we are explicit that this is a pre-specified plan, not a timestamp-enforced preregistration, and that the six manual-review dimensions deferred to a follow-up version will be genuinely pre-registered (timestamp-enforced) before any of their scoring begins. On the six automatable dimensions we find: a mean static-rubric score of 1.52 of 6 (full corpus, N = 185); a mean of 3.28 of 6 conditional on the paper carrying a discoverable code link (N = 80); 11 of 185 papers (5.9%) score the full 6 of 6 on the static rubric, all of them within the 80-paper code-link subset (13.8% of it); the temporal slope of compliance is +0.088 score units per year (in the pre-specified range [0.05, 0.20], statistically nonzero); and a 10% rot rate on discovered code URLs (21% if non-GitHub repositories are counted). Three papers (FinRL, FinGPT, Grinsztajn tabular-benchmark) achieve a perfect static score of 6 of 6; they are existence proofs that audit-grade publication is achievable but far from the field’s median. The six manual-review dimensions (bit-identical replay, per-prediction logging, drift monitoring, significance testing, multiple-comparison correction, out-of-sample protocol) require Tier-1 code execution or manual review and are deferred to v2.1 of this paper. The full per-paper scorecard, the scoring pipeline, and an audit-of-audit log are released publicly with the package. The package, the audit pipeline, the corpus, the per-paper scorecard, an audit script that re-derives every numerical claim in this paper from JSON outputs, and a 6,825-record demonstration log on the seven-model volatility-forecasting panel of Khan (2026f) are released at github.com/ayk5511/mr-audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源工具 mr-audit，用于生成符合美国 SR 11-7 和欧盟 AI Act 监管要求的 ML 预测审计追踪（不可变哈希链记录）。同时，对 185 篇量化金融论文进行合规性评分，平均仅 1.52/6 分，表明领域内审计级可复现性严重不足。
AI.research_question: 如何为受监管领域的机器学习模型构建满足 SR 11-7 和 EU AI Act 要求的逐预测审计追踪？现有量化金融论文的可审计合规程度如何？
AI.motivation: 现有开源 ML 工具（MLflow、W&B、DVC）仅支持实验追踪或工件版本管理，无法生成符合监管要求的审计追踪。同时，量化金融领域缺乏对已发表论文合规性的系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管合规框架（SR 11-7、EU AI Act）、哈希链完整性保护、Kolmogorov-Smirnov 检验与 Population Stability Index 漂移检测。
AI.method: 1）开发 mr-audit Python 包：每预测写入一条不可变哈希链记录（git提交、库版本、输入哈希、模型参数、环境、随机种子、预测值）；2）对 185 篇量化金融论文的六项静态合规维度进行自动化评分。
AI.findings: 185 篇论文静态合规平均分 1.52/6；有可发现代码链接的 80 篇平均分 3.28/6；仅 11 篇（5.9%）获得满分 6/6；合规性时间斜率 +0.088 分/年；代码 URL 腐烂率 10%（非 GitHub 仓库达 21%）。FinRL、FinGPT、Grinsztajn tabular-benchmark 三篇论文满分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将监管审计要求（SR 11-7、EU AI Act）系统操作化为可量化的 ML 合规评估指标；提出基于哈希链的逐预测审计记录理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布开源 mr-audit 包，提供低摩擦集成、供应商中立存储、监管导出功能；提供可复现的合规评分管道和完整评分卡；揭示量化金融领域可审计性严重不足的现状。

title: Which Impact Models Survive Price Diffusivity? Stress-testing the Structural Constraint of Bonart (2026) in Simulation and Public Data

detail.title: Which Impact Models Survive Price Diffusivity? Stress-testing the Structural Constraint of Bonart (2026) in Simulation and Public Data
detail.abstract: Bonart [2026] shows that requiring both realized and counterfactual prices to be diffusive forces the square-root law of market impact for information-neutral traders, and yields a falsifiable diagnostic: de-impacted prices under any valid impact model must themselves be diffusive. The paper names likely violators but does not test them; this paper runs the test. Implemented as a statistical battery and an exact analytic kernel check, the criterion fails every canonical model under realistic autocorrelated order flow, in two opposite directions: permanent linear impact leaves trending residuals, decaying kernels leave mean-reverting ones, and the critical aggregate calibration of the propagator cannot satisfy the individual-level constraint. A minimum-phase factorization yields a violation severity score and a canonical repair, in every case the pure surprise-response model. Empirically, 63 million Binance trades and synthetic metaorders built from public data reproduce the linear-to-square-root crossover on BTC and ETH, with rate scaling consistent with a square root in trade counts (day-cluster bootstrap b = 0.46 [0.43, 0.49] and 0.50 [0.45, 0.57]) and near-zero dependence on volume per execution. On thinner pairs the rate exponent drifts above one-half, and duration scaling deviates from the factorized prediction everywhere; both remain open.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证检验证明，所有标准市场冲击模型在自相关订单流下均无法通过“价格去冲击后仍为扩散过程”的诊断标准，唯一的例外是纯惊喜响应模型。基于6300万笔币安交易数据，实证支持了从线性到平方根定律的交叉现象。
AI.research_question: 标准市场冲击模型在自相关订单流下，能否通过“去冲击价格仍为扩散过程”的可证伪诊断标准？
AI.motivation: Bonart [2026]从理论上推导出信息中性交易者的市场冲击平方根定律，并提出了一个可证伪的诊断标准，但未进行实证检验。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统检验各种主流冲击模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场冲击平方根定律、传播子模型、最小相位分解、惊喜响应模型、扩散过程检验
AI.method: 统计检验电池与精确解析核检验；基于6300万笔币安交易数据和合成元订单的实证分析；最小相位分解构建违规严重性评分和标准修复方法。
AI.findings: 所有标准冲击模型均未通过诊断标准：永久线性冲击导致趋势残差，衰减核导致均值回归残差；传播子的总体验证无法满足个体层面约束。纯惊喜响应模型是唯一可行的修复方案。BTC和ETH上平方根指数约为0.46-0.50，交易量依赖性近乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统实证检验了Bonart提出的市场冲击可证伪诊断标准；2. 揭示了所有标准冲击模型的共同缺陷；3. 确立了纯惊喜响应模型作为唯一的理论修复方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为市场微观结构建模提供了有效的诊断工具；2. 为算法交易和最优执行策略设计提供了更准确的冲击模型；3. 揭示了不同流动性资产的冲击特征差异（薄交易对偏离平方根定律）。

title: Koopman-CMH: A Formal Treatment of Spectral Structure Persistence in Historical Dynamics

detail.title: Koopman-CMH: A Formal Treatment of Spectral Structure Persistence in Historical Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper proves the Koopman-A2 Correspondence (Theorem 1)-the formal result announced as Conjecture 1 of WP-2026-005-and conducts the first pre-registered empirical test of its substantive antecedent. Theorem 1 shows that shared ergodic-class membership implies shared leading Koopman spectrum, conditional on Axioms A2, A3, A4, and a forcing-homogeneity assumption that refines the antecedent stated in WP-2026-005. The empirical test applies a canonical Hankel-DMD estimator to a panel of eight Western European polities across two structurally stationary sub-windows (1820-1913, 1945-2020). The pre-registered binary criterion rejects Question 1 in both sub-windows: no eigenvalue beyond the invariant-measure cluster meets the persistence threshold. A post-hoc power analysis finds effectively zero power at the available effective sample size-the postwar effective sample size (Nₑff = 210) falls below the operator's parameter count-so the verdict constrains detectability, not existence. A credible test requires Nₑff ≈ 1,000. Two methodological results give the paper positive content. The invariant-measure mode is recovered with the directional attenuation Proposition 4.2 predicts, on the one mode whose true value the axiomatic structure fixes a priori. A Juglar-band correspondence recurs across the inter-war break but is not statistically distinguishable from noise (37% match rate in surrogate null panels). The paper recommends canonical Tu et al. (2014) DMD with Gavish-Donoho truncation as the default for macrohistorical panel data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Koopman-A2对应定理（定理1），并进行了首次预注册实证检验。定理表明共享遍历类成员意味着共享领先Koopman谱。实证检验发现，在1820-1913和1945-2020两个子窗口中，预注册的二元标准拒绝了问题1，即没有特征值达到持续阈值。事后功效分析表明有效样本量不足，可信检验需要Nₑff≈1000。论文还恢复了不变测度模态并发现了Juglar波段对应现象，但后者无法与噪声区分。
AI.research_question: 共享遍历类成员是否意味着共享领先Koopman谱？这一理论对应关系在宏观历史面板数据中是否可被经验验证？
AI.motivation: 验证WP-2026-005中提出的猜想1（Koopman-A2对应），填补Koopman算子理论在宏观历史时间序列分析中的实证空白，解决动态系统理论可检测性的样本量问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Koopman算子理论（Koopman谱分析）、遍历理论（遍历类成员）、A2-A4公理系统、Hankel-DMD（动态模态分解）估计量、Gavish-Donoho截断方法。
AI.method: 理论证明（定理1）+ 预注册实证检验。使用规范Hankel-DMD估计量，对八个西欧政体在1820-1913和1945-2020两个结构平稳子窗口进行面板数据分析。采用预注册二元标准进行检验，并辅以事后功效分析和替代空面板对照。
AI.findings: 两个子窗口中均无特征值达到持续阈值（拒绝问题1）。事后分析发现有效样本量（战后Nₑff=210）低于算子参数数量，检验约束的是可检测性而非存在性。可信检验需要Nₑff≈1000。不变测度模态被恢复，符合命题4.2的方向衰减预测。Juglar波段对应在两次世界大战的断裂中重现，但与噪声无法区分（替代空面板匹配率37%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了Koopman-A2对应定理（定理1），将共享遍历类成员与共享领先Koopman谱之间的条件关系形式化，细化了WP-2026-005中提出的前提假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 推荐将规范的Tu et al. (2014) DMD与Gavish-Donoho截断作为宏观历史面板数据的默认方法；揭示了宏观历史Koopman分析中样本量不足的严重局限，为未来研究设定了有效样本量基准（Nₑff≈1000）。

title: Beyond The Farm Gate: Addressing Labour and Human Right Issues Occurring Downstream in the Textiles and Apparel Value Chain
affiliations: , Queensland University of Technology, RMIT, Griffith University, Queensland University of Technology - Faculty of Law, Queensland University of Technology - Faculty of Law and University of Technology Sydney

detail.title: Beyond The Farm Gate: Addressing Labour and Human Right Issues Occurring Downstream in the Textiles and Apparel Value Chain
detail.abstract: Purpose-Our research seeks to understand how actors in the Australian cotton industry can address downstream labour and human rights risks in the textiles and apparel value chain. Design/methodology/approach-Taking the Australian cotton industry as the site of our action research project, we conducted a qualitative thematic analysis of 19 interviews, supplemented by industry engagement and desktop research. Findings-We identify seven opportunities for action by the Australian cotton industry to address downstream labour and human rights risks, which are articulated in the context of a strategic enforcement approach. Originality/value-The research focuses on opportunities for action to address downstream labour and human rights risks, thereby going beyond the traditional interventions by fashion brands and retailers that target upstream actors.

AI.tldr: 本研究以澳大利亚棉花产业为行动研究场域，通过19场访谈及行业参与，识别出该行业解决下游纺织服装价值链中劳工与人权风险的七个行动机会，并置于战略性执法框架下阐述。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚棉花产业如何应对下游纺织服装价值链中的劳工与人权风险？
AI.motivation: 传统干预多聚焦于时尚品牌和零售商对上游供应商的约束，而忽视了棉花等初级原料产业在下游风险治理中的角色与行动空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略性执法方法（strategic enforcement approach）
AI.method: 行动研究（action research），对19场访谈进行定性主题分析，辅以行业参与和桌面研究。
AI.findings: 识别出澳大利亚棉花产业可采取的七个行动机会，以应对下游纺织服装价值链中的劳工与人权风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将下游劳工与人权风险的治理主体从传统的品牌/零售商拓展至原材料产业（如棉花产业），拓宽了价值链治理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为棉花等初级产业提供了具体的行动框架，帮助其超越传统上游合规思维，主动介入下游风险治理。

title: The Unified AI Adoption Model
affiliations: Virginia Commonwealth University

detail.title: The Unified AI Adoption Model
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) implementation is often treated as a tool-selection problem, yet research on technology uptake, human-AI interaction, organizational change, and AI risk management suggests that outcomes depend on the relationship among people, workflows, governance, and institutional purpose. This article develops the Unified AI Adoption Model, a dual-level approach that integrates the Personal AI Adoption Framework (PAAF) and the Scalable AI Adoption Framework (SAAF). PAAF guides individuals through seven stages-Familiarize, Learn, Evaluate, Experiment, Protect, Ingrain, and Grow-while SAAF guides organizations through Discover, Fund, Plan, Experiment, Guardrail, Scale, and Govern. The article positions AI uptake as a coordinated learning and governance process rather than a onetime deployment. The analysis draws from technology acceptance theory, diffusion of innovations, AI literacy, cognitive offloading, human-AI collaboration, change management, and current U.S. federal AI guidance. A government-sector scenario involving a state human services agency illustrates how the model can support case-processing assistance while preserving human review, privacy, accessibility, transparency, and public trust. The article concludes with implications for practice and a research agenda for empirically testing AI maturity across individual and organizational levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一AI采纳模型（UAM），从个人（PAAF：熟悉、学习、评估、实验、保护、内化、成长七阶段）和组织（SAAF：发现、资助、规划、实验、护栏、规模化、治理七阶段）两个层面，将AI采纳定位为协调的学习与治理过程，而非一次性部署。
AI.research_question: 如何从个人和组织两个层面系统性地理解和实施AI采纳，使其超越工具选择问题，成为一个协调的学习与治理过程？
AI.motivation: AI实施常被简单视为工具选择问题，但实际效果取决于人员、工作流程、治理和制度目标之间的复杂关系，现有研究缺乏一个整合个人与组织层面的统一采纳模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受理论、创新扩散理论、AI素养、认知卸载、人机协作、变革管理以及美国联邦AI指南。
AI.method: 理论整合与模型构建，并通过政府部门的场景案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 提出了一个双层次的统一AI采纳模型（UAM），个人层面（PAAF）含7阶段，组织层面（SAAF）含7阶段；AI采纳应被视为协调的学习与治理过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了技术采纳、人机交互、组织变革和AI风险管理等多个理论流派，提出了个人与组织双层次的统一AI采纳模型框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府机构等组织提供了AI采纳的分阶段指导框架，帮助在推进AI应用的同时保障人工审查、隐私、可及性、透明度和公众信任。

title: Addendum: Operational Maturity in the Global Digital Asset Landscape (June 2026)
affiliations: Peking University School of Transnational Law

detail.title: Addendum: Operational Maturity in the Global Digital Asset Landscape (June 2026)
detail.abstract: This addendum provides a critical update to the 2025 research “Regulated: Cryptos, ICOs, Stablecoins, and AML/CFT in Different Global Financial Centres,” bridging the gap between the regulatory baseline and the maturing enforcement landscape of June 2026. As major jurisdictions transition from policy theory to operational enforcement, this update examines the active impact of the Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656) in Hong Kong, the formalization of the Financial Conduct Authority’s cryptoasset regime in the United Kingdom, and the federal alignment of New York’s regulatory framework under the GENIUS Act. The analysis identifies a global paradigm shift in compliance—moving from “policy design” to “demonstrable execution”—and emphasizes the increasing necessity for real-time reserve auditing, mandatory capital floors, and rigorous governance accountability for institutional market participants.

AI.tldr: 本文是2025年研究的补充更新（2026年6月），分析全球主要金融中心从加密货币政策设计转向执法执行阶段的范式转变，重点关注香港《稳定币条例》、英国FCA加密资产制度及美国GENIUS法案下纽约监管框架的联邦协调。研究指出合规范式已从"政策设计"转向"可证明的执行"，强调实时储备审计、强制性资本底线和机构治理问责的必要性。
AI.research_question: 在全球主要金融中心从加密货币政策制定转向执法执行阶段的过程中，不同司法管辖区的监管框架如何演变？合规范式发生了怎样的转变？
AI.motivation: 2025年研究建立了监管基线，但到2026年6月，主要司法管辖区已从政策理论转向操作性执法，需要弥合这一阶段性鸿沟，更新对实际执法环境的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管演化阶段理论（政策设计→执法执行）；合规范式转变理论（从形式合规到实质执行）。
AI.method: 多司法管辖区比较分析，对香港、英国、美国三地最新监管立法和执法实践进行系统性更新与对比。
AI.findings: 全球合规范式已发生根本性转变：从"政策设计"转向"可证明的执行"；三个关键监管要素日益紧迫：实时储备审计、强制性资本底线、严格的机构治理问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"政策设计→可证明的执行"的全球合规范式转变框架，为理解加密资产监管的阶段性演进提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密市场机构参与者提供明确合规方向：需强化实时审计能力、满足资本底线要求、提升治理问责水平；为监管者提供跨司法管辖区比较参考。

title: The Capital Realities of a Broken Frontier: Wage Trajectories, Statutory Blindspots, and The Structural Realignment of American Agriculture

detail.title: The Capital Realities of a Broken Frontier: Wage Trajectories, Statutory Blindspots, and The Structural Realignment of American Agriculture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The corresponding author is the founder of Moolaah Finance, a company developing precision livestock monitoring infrastructure for agricultural lending markets. This relationship is disclosed as a potential interest. The analysis presented in this working paper draws solely on publicly available federal data and independent third-party modeling. No proprietary Moolaah Finance technology or commercial claims are advanced in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by Moo Research Labs, Inc. using publicly available federal disclosures, regulatory filings, and independently published economic modeling. No grant funding, institutional support, or commercial sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: The intersection of federal immigration policy and agricultural labor markets has reached a structural impasse. This paper examines the empirical mechanics of H-2A guestworker compensation following the Department of Labor's October 2025 interim final rule, analyzes the elasticity of domestic labor supply in commercial agricultural operations, and identifies the statutory exclusion of year-round livestock and dairy enterprises from the H-2A visa framework. Drawing on primary federal disclosures from the U.S. Department of Labor, USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Federal Register, and independent modeling by the Economic Policy Institute, we deconstruct the multi-layered tensions fracturing the agricultural landscape. Our findings indicate that recent regulatory adjustments will reduce national employer labor expenditures by approximately $1.6 billion annually, relative to an estimated $7.2 billion H-2A wage bill, while domestic labor supply remains structurally inelastic, with only 182 domestic applicants for 415,000 advertised positions in fiscal year 2025. The H-2A program's seasonal architecture creates a critical policy blind spot for livestock operations requiring continuous labor, accelerating capital restructuring toward automated systems. These findings have implications for agricultural policy, labor economics, and the political economy of technology adoption in food production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年10月美国劳工部H-2A临时工法规调整的影响，发现新规每年将为雇主节省约16亿美元工资支出，同时国内劳动力供给仍高度缺乏弹性（41.5万个岗位仅182名国内申请人），并指出H-2A签证的季节性框架对需要全年劳动的畜牧企业造成了政策盲区，加速了资本向自动化系统重组。
AI.research_question: H-2A客籍工人补偿机制的实证机制如何运作？商业农业经营中国内劳动力供给的弹性如何？为何全年运营的畜牧和乳制品企业被排除在H-2A签证框架之外？
AI.motivation: 联邦移民政策与农业劳动力市场之间的结构性僵局已趋严重，亟需厘清政策调整的实际影响及劳动力供给的结构性瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场供给弹性理论、移民政策与劳动力市场制度经济学、技术采纳的政治经济学。
AI.method: 基于美国劳工部、农业部国家农业统计局、联邦公报等主要联邦公开数据，以及经济政策研究所的独立建模，进行实证分析和结构拆解。
AI.findings: （1）新规将使全国雇主劳动力支出每年减少约16亿美元，相对于约72亿美元的H-2A工资总额；（2）国内劳动力供给结构性缺乏弹性，2025财年41.5万个广告岗位仅有182名国内申请人；（3）H-2A的季节性架构成为需要全年劳动力的畜牧企业的关键政策盲点，加速了资本向自动化系统的重组。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了移民政策框架的季节性制度设计如何塑造农业劳动力市场的结构性失衡，并为技术采纳政治经济学提供了劳动力制度约束影响自动化决策的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业政策制定者提供H-2A法规调整的实际经济效应评估；揭示国内劳动力供给的极度缺乏弹性，为移民劳动力政策改革提供实证依据；指出畜牧和乳制品行业的政策盲区及其对资本结构转型的驱动作用。

detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization in Africa has intensified a mobility crisis, with traffic congestion contributing to economic losses, public safety challenges, and environmental degradation. Many adaptive traffic control systems are designed for regulated, lane-based environments and homogeneous traffic patterns, limiting their applicability in heterogeneous urban contexts. This paper examines the Sydney Coordinated Adaptive Traffic System (SCATS) as a reference model to assess its suitability for Sub-Saharan African contexts. While SCATS demonstrates reductions in travel time, stops, fuel consumption, and emissions through real-time signal optimization, its vehicle-centric design and reliance on fixed infrastructure risk worsening existing inequalities when directly deployed. Drawing on these insights, the paper proposes a mobility justice framework to inform an AI-driven traffic control standard for heterogeneous and resource-constrained urban environments. The framework outlines standardization-relevant design principles, including multi-source AI-based detection to replace inductive loops, priority-based algorithms for public and informal transport, and modular, solar-powered infrastructure. By reframing traffic control standardization from vehicle throughput to multimodal equity, this paper contributes a policy-oriented perspective on how adaptive traffic technologies can be responsibly deployed, ethically governed, and integrated into future international standards for sustainable and inclusive urban mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了SCATS在撒哈拉以南非洲的适用性，指出其车辆中心设计和固定基础设施依赖可能加剧不平等，并提出了以移动正义为核心的AI驱动交通控制标准框架，强调多模式公平、非正式交通包容及太阳能模块化基础设施。
AI.research_question: SCATS（悉尼协调自适应交通系统）在撒哈拉以南非洲异构城市环境中的适用性如何？如何设计适合资源受限、交通异构环境的AI驱动交通控制标准？
AI.motivation: 非洲快速城市化加剧了交通危机，而现有自适应交通系统多针对规整的车道环境和同质交通流设计，无法适用于非洲异质、非正规交通占比高的现实。直接部署SCATS等系统可能加剧社会不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动正义（Mobility Justice）框架，用于重构交通控制标准从车辆通行效率转向多模式公平。
AI.method: 以SCATS为参考模型进行案例评估与批判性分析，提出规范性设计框架。
AI.findings: SCATS虽能减少旅行时间、停车次数、油耗和排放，但其车辆中心设计和对固定基础设施（如感应线圈）的依赖，在直接部署于非洲时可能恶化现有不平等；据此提出包含多源AI检测、优先级算法（服务公交与非正式交通）、太阳能模块化基础设施等设计原则的移动正义框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将移动正义理论引入交通控制标准化领域，重新定义自适应交通技术的设计目标——从车辆吞吐量转向多模式公平与包容性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源受限的非洲城市提供可操作的AI交通控制标准设计原则（多源检测替代感应线圈、非正式交通优先级、太阳能模块化设施），并推动国际标准向可持续包容性城市移动性转型。

title: International Experience in Legal Support of Counterintelligence Activities and its Application

detail.title: International Experience in Legal Support of Counterintelligence Activities and its Application
detail.abstract: This article thoroughly analyses international experiences in the legal support of counterintelligence activities, focusing on the approaches of the UKUSA agreement member countries, European Union states and those in Asia. The main aspects of the legal regulation of special services are discussed, including their organisational structure, mechanisms of democratic control, human rights protection and integration into the international legal system. This article also addresses how counterintelligence agencies respond to modern challenges such as cyber threats and transnational crime. Specific recommendations are offered for adapting leading global practices to Ukrainian realities to enhance the effectiveness of counterintelligence activities, ensure national security and comply with international standards.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国-美国-加拿大-澳大利亚-新西兰（UKUSA）协议成员国、欧盟国家和亚洲国家在反间谍活动法律支持方面的国际经验，重点讨论了特种部队的法律规制、民主监督机制、人权保护及国际法律体系融入，并针对乌克兰现实提出了提升反间谍效能的建议。
AI.research_question: 各国反间谍活动的法律支持机制有何异同？如何将国际最佳实践适应于乌克兰国情以提升其反间谍效能？
AI.motivation: 现代安全挑战（如网络威胁、跨国犯罪）日益复杂，各国反间谍机构需要完善的法律框架来应对，而乌克兰作为一个处于安全转型期的国家，亟需借鉴国际经验改进自身反间谍法律体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法学、国家安全法律理论、国际法律体系整合理论、民主监督理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法，对UKUSA国家、欧盟国家和亚洲国家的法律实践进行横向对比分析。
AI.findings: 不同国家在反间谍活动的法律规制、组织架构、民主监督及人权保护方面存在显著差异；乌克兰可通过借鉴这些国际经验，在立法完善、机构改革和国际标准对接等方面提升反间谍效能。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了比较法视角下反间谍法律支持体系的理论研究，拓展了国家安全法律与国际标准接轨的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰及其他法律转型国家提供了反间谍活动法律改革的具体政策建议，包括如何平衡国家安全与公民权利保护。

affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as Monism: Ontological, Organisational, and Methodological Implications
detail.abstract: This paper argues that Artificial Intelligence should be understood as a form of monism: a unified substance that cannot be decomposed into separate elements such as data, algorithms, or technical architectures. Drawing from philosophical traditions of monism, dualism, and holism, the paper contends that AI is not merely a collection of components but a single, indivisible essence reflecting the phenomena it replicates. Treating AI as monism has deep implications across multiple dimensions. Epistemologically, it positions AI as the central interpretive force across technological, organisational, and societal domains, while raising ethical and existential concerns regarding singularity, the homogenisation of innovation, and the concentration of decision-making power. At the organisational level, a monistic approach challenges traditional siloed structures, advocating instead for transversal, problem-centric teams whose mandate derives from the integrity of the problem rather than from departmental hierarchy. In project management, it implies a unified vision and an integrated evaluation of complexity in which no single stakeholder perspective dominates the assessment of outcomes. In data and information management, it calls for architectures that reflect the irreducible unity of the phenomena being modelled. Ultimately, this paper calls for a paradigm shift in how AI is conceptualised, governed, and integrated, suggesting that only by embracing AI as monism can organisations achieve genuine agility and avoid the structural inefficiencies inherent to reductionist approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文主张应将人工智能理解为一元论：一种不可分割的统一实体，而非数据、算法或技术架构等独立要素的集合，并探讨了这一观点在认识论、组织管理、项目管理和数据管理等方面的深远影响。
AI.research_question: 人工智能应被如何概念化？将其视为一元论而非还原论（分解为数据、算法等独立要素）会带来哪些认识论、组织和管理层面的影响？
AI.motivation: 当前对AI的主流理解偏向还原论（将其拆解为数据、算法、架构等独立组件），导致组织僵化、创新同质化与结构性低效。本文试图从一元论哲学视角重新审视AI的本质，提出一种整体性的概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一元论（Monism）、二元论（Dualism）、整体论（Holism）等哲学传统。
AI.method: 理论分析/哲学论证，基于一元论哲学传统对AI概念进行重新审视，并推演其在组织管理各维度上的含义。
AI.findings: 将AI视为一元论，在认识论上将其定位为技术、组织和社会领域的核心解释力量；在组织层面挑战传统部门制，倡导横向的、以问题为中心的团队；在项目管理中要求统一愿景和综合复杂性评估；在数据管理上要求反映现象不可还原的统一性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI研究引入一元论哲学视角，挑战主流的还原论范式，提出AI应被视为不可分割的统一本质而非组件集合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理、项目管理和数据管理提供基于一元论的具体实践启示，倡导打破部门壁垒的横向团队结构、统一的项目评估体系以及整体性的数据架构。

title: Traveling Salesman Tardiness
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School and Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Traveling Salesman Tardiness
detail.abstract: How fragile is the routing time window of delivery systems against spatial distributional uncertainty? We study the tardiness risk of Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) solutions with respect to a service deadline (target) over the routing time. Using the robust satisficing model, we introduce the TSP tardiness index to quantify the target's fragility under distributional uncertainty in customer locations. Assuming there are m potential customer locations from historical samples on a service region D (of area |D|), we prove that the TSP tardiness index is Θ(n * sqrt(|D|m) / τ) for n realized locations with respect to the routing time target τ, under non-boundary conditions. This result establishes a new scaling law that extends beyond the existing deterministic and probabilistic TSP bounds. We further extend it to a multi-vehicle case and derive simple partition rules for managing delivery systems. Our numerical experiments using synthetic and real-world routing data validate the value of the TSP tardiness index in characterizing and managing the overtime risk of routing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSP延误指数来量化配送系统在客户位置分布不确定下对服务时限的脆弱性，证明了该指数在非边界条件下为Θ(n * sqrt(|D|m) / τ)，并将其扩展到多车辆情形，为配送系统管理提供了新的标度律和分区规则。
AI.research_question: 面对客户位置的空间分布不确定性，配送系统的路由时间窗口（服务时限）有多脆弱？如何量化这种脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 现实配送系统中客户位置存在分布不确定性，这可能导致配送时间超过预定服务时限（加班风险）。现有TSP研究多关注确定性或概率性边界，缺乏对这种分布不确定性下时限脆弱性的系统量化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 鲁棒满意模型（Robust Satisficing Model）；TSP渐近理论；标度律（Scaling Law）
AI.method: 提出TSP延误指数（TSP tardiness index）作为量化指标；通过理论推导证明该指数在非边界条件下为Θ(n * sqrt(|D|m) / τ)；扩展到多车辆情形推导分区规则；使用合成数据和真实路由数据进行数值实验验证。
AI.findings: TSP延误指数为Θ(n * sqrt(|D|m) / τ)，建立了新的标度律；该指数可有效量化配送系统在客户位置分布不确定性下的加班风险；多车辆情形下的简单分区规则有助于管理配送系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从分布鲁棒视角量化TSP路由时间对服务时限的脆弱性；建立了超越现有确定性和概率性TSP边界的新标度律；将结果扩展到多车辆情形并推导出分区规则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为配送系统管理者提供了量化和管理加班风险的理论工具；提出了简单的分区规则来优化多车辆配送系统的设计；通过数值实验验证了该方法在合成数据和真实数据中的有效性。

title: Topological Pricing: Why Fixed-Supply Digital Assets are Bounded by Logistic S-Curves
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Topological Pricing: Why Fixed-Supply Digital Assets are Bounded by Logistic S-Curves

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study. This research was conducted entirely independently, utilizing publicly available data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study utilized publicly available financial datasets sourced via the Yahoo Finance API. No human subjects, patients, or proprietary private data were involved in this research; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: In this paper, we model fixed-supply decentralized digital networks as a biological population on a finite set. Given that network growth must ultimately be bounded by the total number of addressable human beings and finite amounts of world capital, we hypothesize that digital asset adoption follows a bounded Logistic S-Curve (the Verhulst population growth curve), rather than unlimited exponential growth. We test this hypothesis using a daily multi-asset price series from Sep 2014 to May 2026. We utilize non-linear least squares optimization via the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, measure model selection using the informationtheoretic Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), and use Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) to test for stationarity. Bitcoin (AIC = 81,324.2), Ethereum (AIC = 41,141.5), and Solana (AIC = 18,086.9) all exhibit a clear preference for bounded logistic S-curve models. Their asymptotes approach stable thermodynamic limits ($190, 737 for Bitcoin, $2, 570 for Ethereum), which we confirm using Monte Carlo bootstrap tests. The S&P 500 index, which serves as our mathematical control, does not show a preference for the bounded model, suggesting it grows with unbound exponential compounding. Finally, independent 365-day rolling cumulative return analytics show that Bitcoin's compounding return steadily decays through time. This slope is significantly negative (-6.49e-4 per day, p = 2.61e-67), providing direct, stationary mathematical support for saturated Verhulst adoption dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将固定供应的去中心化数字网络建模为有限集合上的生物种群，提出数字资产采用遵循有界Logistic S曲线（Verhulst人口增长曲线）而非无限指数增长。利用2014年9月至2026年5月的日度多资产价格数据，采用非线性最小二乘法优化（Levenberg-Marquardt算法）和AIC模型选择，发现比特币、以太坊和Solana均偏好有界Logistic S曲线模型，而S&P 500作为对照组未表现出此偏好。比特币的累计回报随时间稳定衰减，支持饱和的Verhulst采用动力学。
AI.research_question: 去中心化数字资产的采用是否遵循有界的Logistic S曲线（Verhulst人口增长曲线），而非无限指数增长？
AI.motivation: 数字网络增长最终必然受限于可寻址人类总数和全球资本总量，因此假设采用曲线是有界的。
AI.theoretical_framework: Verhulst人口增长模型（有界Logistic S曲线）、热力学极限类比、平稳性检验（ADF）、信息准则模型选择（AIC）。
AI.method: 非线性最小二乘优化（Levenberg-Marquardt算法）、AIC模型选择、Augmented Dickey-Fuller（ADF）平稳性检验、Monte Carlo自助法检验、365天滚动累计回报分析。
AI.findings: 比特币、以太坊和Solana均表现出对有界Logistic S曲线模型的偏好；其渐近线趋近于稳定的热力学极限（比特币约190,737美元，以太坊约2,570美元）；S&P 500指数未表现出对有界模型的偏好，呈无界指数增长；比特币累计回报斜率显著为负（-6.49e-4/天，p=2.61e-67），支持饱和的Verhulst采用动力学。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物种群增长模型（Verhulst曲线）应用于数字资产采用动力学，提出了数字资产采用有界性假说，并提供了基于信息准则和统计检验的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了数字资产价格增长趋于饱和的量化信号（如比特币热力学极限约19万美元），提示长期回报衰减趋势，有助于投资决策和风险管理。

title: Intra-ASEAN Bilateral FDI and Demographic Gravity: A Sub-Regional Replication

detail.title: Intra-ASEAN Bilateral FDI and Demographic Gravity: A Sub-Regional Replication
detail.abstract: Does bilateral FDI within ASEAN follow the demographic gravity gradient-older source countries investing more in younger destinations-consistent with the income-conditional demographic gravity framework (Peters 2026a)? Using the IMF Coordinated Direct Investment Survey (CDIS) for all ten ASEAN economies, 2009-2024 (706 positive bilateral FDI pairs), I find that the unconditional demographic gravity effect is positive but statistically insignificant (dZ₁ = +0.40, p = 0.44). Conditioning on destination income activates the signal: dZ₁ = +2.55 (p < 0.05) with a negative income interaction (dZ₁ × log GDP/cap destination =-0.21, p < 0.05), implying that demographic divergence predicts more FDI toward lower-income ASEAN destinations but is near-zero toward high-income ones. The post-2020 external shock (US tariffs, China export surge) did not amplify the demographic gradient-if anything, it weakened it (dZ₁ × Post-2020 =-0.21, p < 0.05). Singapore dominates intra-ASEAN FDI at 75% of source volume; results persist qualitatively but lose significance when SGP is excluded. The findings partially replicate the income-conditional demographic gravity mechanism for FDI flows at the sub-regional level but qualify the extension: demographic gravity in FDI is income-conditional and was not reinforced by the 2020-2024 external shock.

title: An Empirical & Comparative Analysis on Job Satisfaction of Workforce at Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex.
affiliations: and NIILM University

detail.title: An Empirical & Comparative Analysis on Job Satisfaction of Workforce at Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex.
detail.abstract: The concept of Job satisfaction has drawn the attention of researchers globally and various researches revealed that the job satisfaction directly affected the workforce presence, accidents, turnover, productivity etc. Often a highly satisfied and happy employee has better mental as well as physical well-being and proves more productive. This study is an attempt to evaluate workforce job satisfaction level at the Panipat Refinery & Petrochemical Complex (PRPC), a public sector unit of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL). This research adopted a quantitative approach and structured survey questionnaire are utilized to collect the data via simple random sampling technique among 320 workforces (including workmen and officers). Key factors considered for assessment of workforce job satisfaction are employee"s welfare, compensation & benefits, safety & occupational health, financial & social security, HR policies, training & development, grievance handling etc. The collected data was analyzed through rank correlation and statistically significant and strong positive correlation (0.82) is found between job satisfaction level of PRPC workmen & officers with overall percentage satisfaction level (71.55 % for workmen & 71.91 for officers). The factor transport facilities scoring highest and canteen services scoring the lowest satisfaction level. No significant difference is identified between satisfaction level of workmen & officers, reported (t value = 0.86, p value=0.396). Recommendations include improvement in canteen services, children education, review of promotion policy and enhancement in training & developmental programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究以印度石油公司旗下帕尼帕特炼油与石化联合企业（PRPC）的320名员工（包括工人与管理人员）为样本，采用定量问卷调查法，评估了员工福利、薪酬福利、安全与职业健康、培训发展等关键因素对工作满意度的影响。研究发现工人与管理层的总体满意度分别为71.55%和71.91%，两者呈强正相关（相关系数0.82），且无显著差异；交通设施满意度最高，餐饮服务最低。研究建议改善餐饮、子女教育、晋升政策及培训项目。
AI.research_question: 如何评估PRPC这家印度国有石油企业的员工工作满意度水平？不同职级（工人与管理层）的满意度是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 工作满意度直接影响员工的出勤率、事故率、离职率和生产力，但针对印度国有石油企业基层员工与管理人员满意度的系统比较研究较少，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作满意度理论；员工福利与满意度关系理论；组织行为学中满意度与绩效关系理论。
AI.method: 定量研究方法：采用结构化问卷调查，通过简单随机抽样对PRPC的320名员工（包括工人和管理人员）进行数据收集。数据分析采用等级相关分析（Spearman rank correlation）和t检验。
AI.findings: ①工人与管理层总体满意度分别为71.55%和71.91%，两者呈显著强正相关（相关系数0.82）；②交通设施满意度最高，餐饮服务满意度最低；③工人与管理层满意度无显著差异（t=0.86, p=0.396）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了工作满意度在国有石油企业不同职级员工间的一致性，丰富了发展中国家属地工业情境下的工作满意度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PRPC及同类国有石油企业提供了具体的满意度改善方向：重点改进餐饮服务、子女教育支持、晋升政策的审查以及培训发展项目的强化。

title: Ecological Certainty and Mindset Strength: How Social Learning Environments Produce, Sustain, and Undermine Belief-Behavior Consistency in Mindset Research

detail.title: Ecological Certainty and Mindset Strength: How Social Learning Environments Produce, Sustain, and Undermine Belief-Behavior Consistency in Mindset Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the theoretical arguments, hypothesis development, or interpretive conclusions presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a purely theoretical contribution and does not report empirical data collected from human participants. No ethics approval was required. The five hypotheses and associated research designs proposed are intended for future empirical investigation by the research community; ethics approval will be required at that stage by the respective investigators.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in his capacity as Professor of Practice at Luiss Business School, Rome, Italy.

detail.abstract: Recent empirical work by Wallace et al. (2026) demonstrated that growth mindsets predict interest in growth-oriented organizations primarily when held with high certainty (mindset strength), and that social validation amplifies certainty. The present paper develops an ecological extension of active environmental instruction rather than passive self-selection: fixed-mindset organizational contexts teach a competing epistemology through the cumulative micro-interactions of performance management, attribution norms, and recognition practices. Third, the values-asidentity mechanism proposed by Wallace et al. (2026) is more precisely characterized as deeplevel belief integration-the process by which a mindset becomes organized into the automatic, identity-constitutive schemas that govern interpretation of achievement-relevant experience-and this integration is distinguished from declarative certainty by its resistance to contextual challenge. Five testable hypotheses are derived, each with specific operationalizations and research designs. Implications are developed for the design of mindset interventions, organizational culture change, and the measurement of belief robustness across social contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文在Wallace等人(2026)研究基础上，提出思维模式的生态扩展：固定思维组织通过微观互动施加认知压力，并将"价值观-身份认同"机制精确化为深层信念整合，提出五个可检验假设。
AI.research_question: 成长型思维与组织偏好的关系如何受情境影响？固定思维组织环境如何通过微观互动塑造个体的认知信念？
AI.motivation: Wallace等人(2026)发现思维模式需结合确定性（思维强度）才能预测组织偏好，但该研究侧重被动自我选择。本文试图从生态视角补充：组织环境如何主动"教导"个体特定认知框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态化的主动环境教导理论；深层信念整合理论（区别于外显确定性）；价值观-身份认同机制的精确化。
AI.method: 理论推演与概念化，提出五个可检验假设及具体操作化与研究设计。
AI.findings: 固定思维组织通过绩效管理、归因规范和认可实践的微观互动，传授竞争性认识论；深层信念整合比外显确定性更抵抗情境挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将思维模式研究从个体差异视角扩展至组织生态视角；区分了"信念确定性"与"深层信念整合"两个不同构念；为价值观-身份认同机制提供了更精确的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为思维模式干预设计、组织文化变革、以及在跨社会情境中测量信念稳健性提供了实践指导。

title: Truly Terrible Ten? Notes on Territorial Supply Constraints
affiliations: Pforzheim University of Applied Sciences and

detail.title: Truly Terrible Ten? Notes on Territorial Supply Constraints
detail.abstract: The European Commission's classification of Territorial Supply Constraints (TSC) as inherently harmful Single Market barriers ("Terrible Ten") relies on a rigid legal binary that overlooks complex vertical market dynamics. Recent economic literature demonstrates that a per se prohibition of TSC risks harming longterm consumer welfare by dismantling vertical restraints that may successfully resolve freerider problems, stimulate non-price competition, or secure product availability in thin markets. Moreover, existing empirical evidence is heavily constrained by data limitations and relies primarily on descriptive price-dispersion tracking, making it inherently incapable of isolating causal effects of 'true' TSC or net consumer welfare effects. Rather than prematurely closing perceived gaps in competition law with rigid ex-ante bans, European competition policy should adopt an effects-based framework (Rule of Reason) capable of differentiating between harmful market foreclosure and welfare-enhancing vertical coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑欧盟将"领土供应限制"（TSC）归类为固有有害的单一市场壁垒，主张应摒弃刚性法律二分法，转而采用基于效果分析的合理原则框架，以避免损害长期消费者福利。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会对领土供应限制（TSC）的"本身违法"分类是否合理？竞争政策应如何对待垂直市场中的供应限制？
AI.motivation: 欧盟委员会将TSC列为固有有害的单一市场壁垒（"可怕的十项"），但这一刚性法律框架忽视了垂直市场动态的复杂性，可能错误地禁止了具有促进竞争效果的垂直限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直市场限制理论、搭便车问题、非价格竞争理论、消费者福利经济学、合理原则（Rule of Reason）vs. 本身违法原则（Per se Rule）
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，结合现有实证证据的批判性评估
AI.findings: (1) 对TSC的本身违法禁止可能损害长期消费者福利；(2) 现有实证证据存在数据限制，主要依赖描述性价格离散追踪，无法隔离TSC的因果效应或净福利效应；(3) 应转向基于效果分析的合理原则框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了欧盟竞争政策中关于垂直限制的刚性法律二分法，提出应区分有害的市场封锁与促进福利的垂直协调，推动了竞争法理论中合理原则的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟竞争政策制定者提供政策建议：放弃过早的本身违法禁令，转向效果导向的个案分析框架，避免损害消费者长期福利。

title: Demographic Gravity Within ASEAN: Does China's Export Surge Disproportionately Reach Older Destinations?

detail.title: Demographic Gravity Within ASEAN: Does China's Export Surge Disproportionately Reach Older Destinations?
detail.abstract: China's 2020-2024 export surge, a $1.2 trillion global surplus record achieved despite a 20% decline in US-directed exports, provides a natural experiment for testing whether demographic aging of destination countries predicts higher import absorption. Within ASEAN, where the demographic spectrum runs from Thailand (Z₁ = +0.20, median age ~40) to Laos (Z₁ =-2.29, median age ~24), the China export shock is held approximately constant while destination demographics vary sharply. Using UN Comtrade China export data by HS2 chapter (2010-2024) for all ten ASEAN economies, I find that demographic aging strongly predicts the level of China exports in the cross-section (β = +1.88, p < 0.001, panel with year and chapter fixed effects), consistent with the income-conditional demographic demand-absorption mechanism of Peters (2026a). However, the incremental 2020-2024 shock did not disproportionately accrue to older ASEAN destinations (Z₁×Post =-0.17, se = 0.33, p = 0.60). The surplus deflected primarily to younger, production-chain-integrated economies-Vietnam (+135%) and Cambodia (+261%)-reflecting supply-side assembly hub logic rather than demographic demand absorption. This distinguishes two distinct channels: (1) a demographic demand baseline that aging countries sustain at elevated import levels, and (2) a shock-incidence channel driven by production-chain positioning that is orthogonal to demographic position. The data limitation-four HS2 chapters (29, 84, 87, 88), omitting electronics (HS85)-constrains interpretation.

AI.tldr: 利用中国2020-2024年出口激增作为自然实验，研究目的地国人口老龄化是否影响进口吸收能力。发现老龄化稳定提升进口基线水平，但短期出口冲击更多流向年轻的生产链整合经济体。
AI.research_question: 目的地国家的人口老龄化程度能否预测其对中国出口的吸收能力？短期出口冲击的分配是否遵循同样的逻辑？
AI.motivation: 中国在2020-2024年间对美出口下降20%的情况下，实现全球出口盈余1.2万亿美元，为检验老龄化与进口吸收的关系提供了自然实验。东盟十国从老挝（中位年龄~24）到泰国（中位年龄~40）的人口结构差异极大，而中国对东盟的出口冲击近似恒定，是理想的检验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: Peters (2026a) 提出的"收入条件性人口需求吸收机制"：老龄化国家因高收入水平和稳定的消费结构，对进口商品具有更高的需求基线。
AI.method: 使用UN Comtrade 2010-2024年中国对东盟十国出口的HS2章节层面数据，构建面板固定效应模型（年份和产品章节固定效应）。关键变量：人口老龄化指数（Z₁）、2020-2024冲击期哑变量（Post）及其交互项。
AI.findings: 老龄化显著正向预测中国出口的截面水平（β=+1.88, p<0.001），但2020-2024年的增量冲击并未显著偏向老龄化更严重的国家（交互项系数=-0.17, p=0.60）。出口转移主要流向年轻的生产链整合经济体：越南（+135%）和柬埔寨（+261%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了两种不同机制：（1）人口统计需求基线——老龄化国家维持较高的进口水平；（2）冲击归属渠道——由生产链位置决定，与人口老龄化正交。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示贸易政策制定者：人口老龄化对贸易的长期基线效应与短期冲击的分配逻辑不同，后者更受全球供应链布局影响。

detail.title:
Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets 
A 5-Year Backtest Study on SOL/USDT Perpetual Contracts

publicationDetails.detailsText: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets A 5-Year Backtest Study on SOL/USDT Perpetual Contracts

detail.abstract:
This study presents a quantitative analysis of an intraday mean reversion trading strategy applied to SOL/USDT perpetual futures on the Binance exchange. The strategy utilizes previous-day Volume Profile levels (Value Area High, Value Area Low, Point of Control) as context for trade entries, with current-day Point of Control as the profit target. Trade confirmation is provided by a novel "Tape Speed" indicator measuring volume-weighted price momentum. 
A comprehensive 5-year backtest (1,825 trading days, 525,600 five-minute candles) with realistic Binance Futures transaction costs (0.05% maker entry, 0.05% taker exit, 0.02% slippage per side) reveals that a 0.15% stop-loss configuration is mathematically unviable due to transaction costs consuming 93% of the risk allocation. Stop-loss levels of 1.0% to 2.0% demonstrate statistically significant profitability with Sharpe ratios exceeding 2.0 and profit factors above 2.5.

AI.tldr: 本文对SOL/USDT永续合约的日内均值回归交易策略进行了5年回测，发现0.15%止损因交易成本不合算，而1.0%-2.0%止损实现了显著盈利（夏普比率>2.0，盈亏比>2.5）。
AI.research_question: 日内均值回归交易策略在加密货币永续合约市场中是否有效？不同止损水平对策略盈利能力有何影响？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场的高波动性和24小时交易特性为日内交易策略提供了可能，但交易成本对策略可行性的影响尚未被充分量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均值回归理论、成交量分布（Volume Profile）分析、交易成本微观结构理论
AI.method: 基于Volume Profile（VAH、VAL、POC）构建入场信号，以当日POC为盈利目标，使用"Tape Speed"成交量加权动量指标确认入场，在Binance真实费率下进行525,600根5分钟K线的回测。
AI.findings: 0.15%止损水平因交易成本消耗93%的风险预算而不可行；1.0%-2.0%止损水平夏普比率超过2.0，盈亏比超过2.5，具有统计显著的正收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化揭示了交易成本对高频均值回归策略可行性的关键阈值效应，证明了在加密货币市场中宽止损均值回归策略的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币量化交易者提供了可操作的Volume Profile日内均值回归策略框架及止损参数校准指南。

title: When Legitimacy Becomes a Liability: How Economic Securitization Shapes Global Firms' Socio-Political Strategy

detail.title: When Legitimacy Becomes a Liability: How Economic Securitization Shapes Global Firms' Socio-Political Strategy
detail.abstract: Why do governments increasingly invoke national security to criticize foreign multinational enterprises (MNEs)? Additionally, how do affected MNEs respond? I argue that economic securitization (ES)-the framing of foreign investment as a national security threat-is a salient and extreme political risk that follows a distinct life cycle. It is activated when host country legislators face competitive elections in constituencies exposed to foreign economic competition. Under emergent ES risk exposure, firms substitute away from elite-targeted lobbying toward society engagement to establish broader legitimacy. Once ES risk consolidates, however, high-profile social engagement becomes a liability, as local embeddedness now reads as suspicious foreign influence, so MNEs scale back both political and social channels. Using a staggered difference-indifferences design with an original dataset of 5,484 U.S. legislator-session observations (2005-2024) and 634 foreign MNEs operating in the United States (2013-2024), I find empirical support for these propositions. Twenty-one interviews with senior corporate and policy professionals further reveal how MNEs choose among different strategies in response to different risk levels. Overall, this paper theorizes economic securitization as a novel political risk, showing that the trade-off between corporate political and social strategy follows a stage-dependent life cycle. It offers managerial guidance for global firms operating in increasingly politicized contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"经济安全化"（ES）是一种独特且极端的政治风险，遵循阶段性生命周期：在竞争性选举驱动下，东道国立法者将外资框定为国家安全威胁；受影响的跨国企业（MNEs）在不同风险阶段采取不同应对策略——风险初现时从精英游说转向社会参与以建立合法性，风险固化后则收缩政治和社会渠道。作者基于美国2005-2024年立法者数据和2013-2024年在美运营的634家外资MNEs数据，结合21次高管访谈，通过交错双重差分法验证了上述命题。
AI.research_question: （1）为什么政府越来越多地援引国家安全来批评外国跨国企业？（2）受影响的跨国企业如何回应这种经济安全化风险？
AI.motivation: 现实中政府频繁以国家安全为由批评外资企业，但现有政治风险文献对此缺乏理论化。作者试图填补这一空白，将"经济安全化"概念化为一种独特的极端政治风险，并揭示其生命周期规律及企业应对策略的动态演化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济安全化（Economic Securitization, ES）的生命周期理论；企业政治战略（精英游说）与社会战略（社会参与）之间的权衡理论；基于竞争性选举的政治逻辑。
AI.method: 交错双重差分法（Staggered Difference-in-Differences）；原始数据集（5,484个美国立法者-会期观测值，2005-2024年；634家在美外资MNEs，2013-2024年）；21次高级企业及政策专业人士的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: （1）ES风险的激活与面临外资竞争选区的立法者在竞争性选举中的行为密切相关；（2）ES风险初现时，MNEs从精英游说转向社会参与以建立更广泛的合法性；（3）ES风险固化后，高调的社会参与反而成为负担（本地嵌入被解读为可疑的外国影响），MNEs同时收缩政治和社会渠道；（4）不同风险水平下，MNEs会选择不同的应对策略组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"经济安全化"理论化为一种独特的极端政治风险，超越了传统的非市场战略文献；揭示了企业政治战略与社会战略之间的权衡具有阶段依赖的生命周期特征，而非静态选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在日益政治化环境中运营的全球企业提供了分阶段的风险应对管理指南；提示管理者在ES风险不同阶段应动态调整战略重点——初期加大社会参与，后期则需谨慎收缩。

title: Inventory Buildup as an Early-Warning Signal: Working-Capital Overhang, Margin Compression, and the Limits of a Sector Signal

detail.title: Inventory Buildup as an Early-Warning Signal: Working-Capital Overhang, Margin Compression, and the Limits of a Sector Signal

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it uses secondary financial-statement and market data on publicly listed firms and does not involve human participants, animal subjects, clinical data, or personal identifiable data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organisation.

detail.abstract:
Inventory buildup is widely read as a warning of weaker profitability to come, yet the evidence is overwhelmingly American and one influential account holds that the signal lives in particular sectors. This thesis tests both claims on new ground, using an international panel of 279 inventory-intensive firms across the United States and thirteen European countries over fiscal years 2014-2026 (3,055 firm-years). It builds a peer-adjusted abnormal-inventory measure (AbnInvPeer) from already-filed statements and tests its predictive content through fixedeffects panel regressions with firm-clustered errors, placebo falsification, and a multiple-testing standard applied to its own results. 
Four hypotheses resolve into three economic channels, because the distress test is a binary recoding of the margin test, not independent evidence. H1 (margin): one standard deviation of the signal predicts a 0.24-percentage-point fall in next-year gross margin (β =-0.0152, p = 0.0135), robust in direction across seventeen specifications, yet marginal under multiple-testing correction, significant in no sub-period alone, and carried by the European, not the American, firms. H2 (cash): the same buildup coincides with same-year operating cash flow weaker by 1.87 margin points per standard deviation, the strongest association in the panel, but concurrent and partly mechanical, and so the weakest early warning. H3 (returns): high-buildup firms underperform peers by 4.7% annually equal-weighted (t =-3.03), a spread that vanishes valueweighted and rests on only eleven annual sorts, an association, not an anomaly. H4 (distress): high-stress firm-years face margin distress at 17.1% versus 12.6% (χ² = 8.04, p = 0.005). 
The sharpest result is a rejection. The sector-concentration claim of an exploratory phase of this study (semiconductors driving the signal at β =-0.179, estimated on six firms) collapses by a factor of nine on fifteen firms and survives none of thirteen specifications, turning the wrong sign in its home market; Fisher's (1997) taxonomy motivates the test and does not survive it. Documenting this self-correction is treated as a contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文使用美欧14国279家库存密集型公司数据（2014-2026年），构建同行调整的异常库存指标（AbnInvPeer），发现高库存信号预测了毛利率下降（欧洲驱动）、同期现金流恶化、股票收益跑输同行，但之前认为该信号集中于半导体行业的结论在扩大样本后不成立，作者将这种自我修正视为贡献。
AI.research_question: 异常库存积累是否预示着企业未来盈利能力下降？该信号是否集中于特定行业（如半导体）？
AI.motivation: 现有证据几乎全部来自美国，且有一种主流观点认为库存信号集中于特定行业（如半导体），本文旨在跨国背景下检验这两个主张。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fisher (1997) 的行业分类框架（用于检验行业集中性假说）；异常库存与盈利能力、现金流、股票收益、财务困境之间的经济关联。
AI.method: 固定效应面板回归（企业聚类标准误）、安慰剂检验、多重检验校正；构建同行调整的异常库存指标（AbnInvPeer），基于2014-2026年14个国家279家库存密集型企业的3,055个公司-年观测值。
AI.findings: (1) H1（边际）：异常库存每增1个标准差，下年毛利率下降0.24个百分点（β=-0.0152，p=0.0135），但该效应由欧洲公司驱动，美国公司不显著，且未通过多重检验校正；(2) H2（现金）：同期经营现金流弱1.87个百分点/标准差，但为同期效应且部分机械性，预警价值弱；(3) H3（收益）：高库存公司等权组合年化跑输4.7%（t=-3.03），但价值加权后消失；(4) H4（困境）：高库存年份困境率17.1% vs 12.6%；(5) 关键拒绝：半导体行业集中假说（原β=-0.179，6家公司）在扩大至15家公司后系数缩小9倍，在13种规格下均不显著，甚至在美国样本中符号反转。
AI.theory_contributions: 跨国检验了异常库存信号的普遍性，发现其预测能力远弱于美国文献所暗示的；明确拒绝了"库存信号集中于半导体行业"的理论主张（Fisher, 1997），通过自我修正展示了科学复现的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒分析师和投资者：异常库存信号在美国之外表现不佳，且行业集中假说并不可靠；库存信号的预测能力有限，不宜过度解读；展示了科学自我修正作为学术贡献的价值。

title: Language, Knowing, and the Architecture of Organisational Blindness: Declarative and Enacted Knowing, Inverse Difference, and Umbra Cones in Learnable Theory

detail.title: Language, Knowing, and the Architecture of Organisational Blindness: Declarative and Enacted Knowing, Inverse Difference, and Umbra Cones in Learnable Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the theoretical arguments, hypothesis development, or interpretive conclusions presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a purely theoretical contribution and does not report empirical data collected from human participants. No ethics approval was required. The five hypotheses and associated research designs proposed are intended for future empirical investigation by the research community; ethics approval will be required at that stage by the respective investigators.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in his capacity as Professor of Practice at Luiss Business School, Rome, Italy.

detail.abstract: Why do organisations systematically reproduce the blind spots they most urgently need to overcome? This article proposes that the answer lies not in information deficits or motivational failures but in the semantic architecture of the communicative fields through which organisations constitute their collective perception. Drawing on Learnable Theory (Magni, Marchetti & Alharbi, 2023, 2024, 2025), the article develops a theoretical integration between the epistemological distinction between declarative and enacted knowing and the linguisticcognitive constructs of the Umbra Cone (Cono d'Ombra) and the Inverse Difference (Differenza Inversa). The article situates these constructs within the theoretical traditions of organisational learning - specifically the literatures on sensemaking, double-loop learning, and the espoused/enacted gap - before arguing that Learnable Theory advances those traditions by providing a precise linguistic mechanism for the production and maintenance of the gap between what organisations say they do and what they actually do. The Umbra Cone is the structural zone of non-pertinence constitutively produced by a dominant frame; the Inverse Difference is the formal mechanism that generates it. Together they explain not merely that enacted knowing exists and resists revision - what the prior literature has established - but why it has the specific architecture it does: why certain domains are constitutively unavailable to deliberate revision while others remain accessible. The article makes the epistemological argument for why standard diagnostic tools, including 360-degree feedback instruments, are structurally incapable of accessing enacted knowing, and directly addresses the counterargument that subordinate observers can and do see leadership contradictions that leaders cannot: the observer is not blind, but the instrument's linguistic architecture forecloses their capacity to express what they perceive. A single theoretical illustration applies all five steps of the Inverse Difference procedure to an archetypal pattern of corporate communication, demonstrating the analytical sequence from frame identification to regeneration. Five theoretical propositions close the article. The central theoretical contribution is a structural account of the mechanism by which organisations learn not to see, and a theoretically grounded procedure for identifying the architecture of that unseeing in the language organisations use to describe themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Learnable Theory，提出了“伞锥”（Umbra Cone）和“逆差”（Inverse Difference）两个语言学-认知构念，解释组织为何系统性复制其最需要克服的盲点：不是因为信息不足或动机缺陷，而是因为组织沟通场域的语义架构本身生产并维持了“说”与“做”之间的结构性鸿沟。文章论证了标准诊断工具（如360度反馈）在结构上无法触及“ enacted knowing”，并提供了一个五步分析程序来识别组织语言中“不看见”的架构。
AI.research_question: 组织为何系统性地复制其最迫切需要克服的盲点？这一盲点的结构性机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献（如sensemaking、双环学习、espoused/enacted gap）已指出“enacted knowing”的存在及其抗拒修订的特性，但未能解释其为何具有特定的架构——即某些领域为何在构成上无法进行审慎修订，而其他领域却可以。本文旨在提供这一结构性机理解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: Learnable Theory (Magni, Marchetti & Alharbi, 2023, 2024, 2025)；声明性知识与 enacted knowing 的认识论区分；伞锥（Umbra Cone）；逆差（Inverse Difference）；组织学习文献中的sensemaking、双环学习、espoused/enacted gap。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念演绎；通过一个理论性例证展示逆差程序五步骤（从框架识别到再生）的应用；提出五项理论命题。
AI.findings: (1) 伞锥是主导框架在构成上产生的“非相关性”结构区；(2) 逆差是生成伞锥的形式机制；(3) 标准诊断工具（含360度反馈）在语言架构上无法触及enacted knowing；(4) 观察者并非盲视，而是工具的语言架构预先关闭了他们表达所感知内容的能力；(5) 提供了一个五步逆差分析程序，用以识别组织自我描述语言中“不看见”的架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个结构性（而非心理性或动机性）的机理解释，说明组织如何学习“不看见”；提出了精确的语言学机制来解释espoused/enacted gap的生产与维持；将伞锥和逆差概念系统整合进组织学习理论传统，推进了sensemaking和双环学习的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 诊断当前标准评估工具（如360度反馈）的结构性局限；为实践者提供了一套可操作的五步分析程序，用以识别组织语言中盲点的架构，从而有望突破组织学习中的结构性障碍。

title: Disrupting the Undisruptable: Agentic AI Innovations in Construction

detail.title: Disrupting the Undisruptable: Agentic AI Innovations in Construction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors have no conflict of interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research received ethics approval from the University of Cambridge - Department of Engineering Ethics Approval Committee.
declarations.funderStatement: Dorsett Scholarship funds the research project on the investigation of digital technologies and sustainability in the built environment.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This is a preprint/working paper. The manuscript is currently undergoing peer review. Content may change prior to final publication.

detail.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) refers to systems capable of semi-autonomous planning to achieve pre-defined goals. It is reshaping innovation processes across industries; yet socially impactful industries such as construction, healthcare, and education remain resistant to technological changes. Grounded in disruptive innovation theory (DIT), this study explores how agentic AI challenges and reshapes innovation dynamics in the construction industry: a sector characterised by slow technological adoption, complex institutional constraints, and fragmented project structures. A qualitative approach is employed to conduct semi-structured interviews with 34 construction professionals across seven regions. Together with five categories of archival data, our findings reveal three dimensions: (1) triggers of innovation, comprising institutional pressure, project delivery crises and data fragmentation; (2) resistance to disruption, comprising institutional professional legitimacy and project liability; and (3) institution-enabled innovation, comprising agent governance, risk allocation and knowledge embeddedness. The results show that the construction industry occupies a contested space between sustaining and disruptive innovation trajectories. Heavily regulated, socially impactful, and liability-intensive industries are both reliant and constrained by institutional mediators to shape their pace of technological disruption. This study introduces the concept of institution-enabled innovation as the third pathway beyond existing DIT emphasis on either market competition or technological performance. It contributes by empirically extending DIT application in a sector-specific analysis, while highlighting its societal implications as shaped by institutions. Practical recommendations are offered for construction practitioners and policymakers seeking to navigate advanced AI adoption in highly institutionalised settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于颠覆性创新理论（DIT），通过对34位建筑行业专业人士的访谈和五类档案数据的定性分析，探讨了代理型人工智能如何挑战并重塑建筑行业的创新动态。研究发现三个维度：创新触发因素、对颠覆的抵制以及制度赋能创新，并提出了"制度赋能创新"作为DIT框架下的第三条路径。
AI.research_question: 代理型人工智能如何挑战并重塑建筑行业这一高度制度化、技术采纳缓慢的行业的创新动态？
AI.motivation: 建筑、医疗、教育等社会影响力大的行业对技术变革存在抵触，而代理型AI正在重塑各行业的创新过程。理解这些"顽固"行业中AI驱动的创新机制具有重要的学术和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 颠覆性创新理论（Disruptive Innovation Theory, DIT）
AI.method: 定性研究方法：对来自七个地区的34位建筑行业专业人士进行半结构化访谈，并结合五类档案数据进行三角验证。
AI.findings: 识别出三个关键维度：1) 创新触发因素（制度压力、项目交付危机、数据碎片化）；2) 对颠覆的抵制（制度专业合法性、项目责任归属）；3) 制度赋能创新（代理治理、风险分配、知识嵌入性）。建筑行业处于持续性创新与颠覆性创新轨迹之间的争议空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度赋能创新"作为DIT框架下超越市场竞争和技术性能的第三条路径，将DIT的应用拓展到高度监管、社会责任重大且责任密集的行业情境中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑行业从业者和政策制定者在高度制度化的环境中推进先进AI应用提供了实用建议。

title: Demographics and Chinese Sovereign Debt: Testing the Macro Channel

detail.title: Demographics and Chinese Sovereign Debt: Testing the Macro Channel
detail.abstract: Benguria, Rojas & Saffie (2026) formalize how yuan revenue exposure and low restructuring costs make dollar-to-yuan debt conversion optimal for developing sovereigns, with demographic aging endogenizing restructuring costs through fiscal deterioration. This note tests whether the demographic-Chinese debt interaction implied by the BRS mechanism is detectable in aggregate current account outcomes across 102 developing and emerging-market economies. It is not: the Z₁ × Chinese public and publicly guaranteed (PPG) debt interaction is statistically zero (β = 0.099, SE = 0.625, p = 0.87) and economically negligible across all specifications. The income-conditional demographic baseline is fully intact (Z₁ = 6.987, SE = 3.282, p < 0.05; Z₁ × log GDP/cap =-0.728, SE = 0.371, p < 0.05; N = 102). The null finding is informative: the BRS mechanism operates through a microeconomic sovereign restructuring channel rather than a macroeconomic savings-investment channel. The aggregate current account is not the right diagnostic for the BRS mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了Benguria, Rojas & Saffie (2026)提出的发展中国家债务转换机制（人民币收入敞口与低重组成本导致美元债转人民币债），发现其宏观预测（人口老龄化×中国公共债务对经常账户的影响）在102个发展中国家的数据中不显著，表明该机制通过微观主权重组渠道而非宏观储蓄-投资渠道运作。
AI.research_question: BRS机制所隐含的人口老龄化与中国债务的交互作用，是否能在发展中国家和新兴经济体的经常账户总结果中被检测到？
AI.motivation: 检验BRS理论框架的宏观可验证性，区分该机制是通过微观主权债务重组渠道还是宏观储蓄-投资渠道运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: BRS机制：人民币收入敞口与低重组成本使美元转人民币债务对发展中主权国家最优，人口老龄化通过财政恶化内生重组成本。宏观预测：人口老龄化×中国公共债务应影响经常账户。
AI.method: 跨国回归分析，使用102个发展中国家和新兴经济体数据，检验人口老龄化（Z₁）与中国公共担保债务（PPG）的交互项对经常账户的影响。
AI.findings: Z₁ × 中国PPG债务交互项统计上为零（β=0.099, SE=0.625, p=0.87），经济上可忽略；而收入条件的人口基线效应完整（Z₁和Z₁×log GDP/cap均显著）。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了BRS机制的运作渠道：零结果支持BRS通过微观主权重组渠道运作，而非宏观储蓄-投资渠道；明确了经常账户总结果不是检验BRS机制的恰当诊断指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者不应使用经常账户数据来验证或反驳BRS机制，为未来研究提供了正确的实证策略方向（应关注主权债务层面的微观数据）。

title: Does iXBRL Reporting of Pay-versus-Performance Affect Say-on-Pay Voting?
affiliations: California State University at Fullerton, Fudan University - School of Management and

detail.title: Does iXBRL Reporting of Pay-versus-Performance Affect Say-on-Pay Voting?
detail.abstract: This study examines the economic consequences of the SEC’s mandated inline XBRL (iXBRL) pay-versus-performance (PvP) disclosures. We investigate whether this structured reporting framework alters the information environment surrounding Company-Selected Measures (CSMs) and Compensation Actually Paid (CAP), thereby influencing shareholder voting on executive compensation. We document three primary findings. First, concerning the faithful representation in CSM choices, firms with greater reliance on non-GAAP metrics in executive contracts are significantly more likely to designate a non-GAAP metric as their CSM. Second, regarding compensation relevance, changes in the designated CSM exhibit an incremental and positive association with changes in CAP, after controlling for total shareholder return. Third, as evidence of the shareholder use of PvP disclosure, we find that post-iXBRL mandate shareholder dissent ratios become significantly more sensitive to excess executive compensation. Furthermore, we find that the increased say-on-pay vote sensitivity to excess pay is driven by the iXBRL format of information rather than new information per se. Collectively, our findings provide early evidence on corporate reporting choices under the iXBRL-based PvP disclosure rule and demonstrate that machine-readable data mandates mitigate information processing costs, thereby enhancing the efficacy of shareholder say-on-pay governance.

AI.tldr: 研究SEC强制要求的iXBRL格式薪酬与绩效披露的经济后果，发现机器可读数据格式增强了股东对高管薪酬投票的有效性。
AI.research_question: SEC强制要求的iXBRL格式薪酬与绩效（PvP）披露如何影响信息环境、公司CSM选择以及股东薪酬投票行为？
AI.motivation: SEC于2022年强制要求以iXBRL格式披露薪酬与绩效信息，这一结构化报告框架可能改变信息处理成本，进而影响公司披露选择与股东治理效能，但目前缺乏相关实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理成本理论；信息披露的格式效应（format effect）；股东积极主义与薪酬投票治理。
AI.method: 运用双重差分（DID）等实证方法，分析iXBRL强制采用前后公司CSM选择变化、CAP与CSM的关联性，以及股东异议投票对超额薪酬敏感度的变化。
AI.findings: （1）高管薪酬合同中依赖非GAAP指标的公司更可能将非GAAP指标设为CSM；（2）CSM变化与CAP变化呈正相关；（3）iXBRL强制采用后，股东异议投票对超额薪酬的敏感度显著提高，且该效应由iXBRL格式驱动，而非新信息本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息格式（而非内容）如何影响信息使用者的决策提供了因果证据；拓展了机器可读信息披露对资本市场治理作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SEC推动结构化数据披露的政策效果提供了早期实证支持；提示监管机构信息披露的格式设计对投资者决策具有独立于内容的重要影响。

title: Robust Dynamic Programming for Inventory Control: Joint Supply and Demand Uncertainty
affiliations: , Durham Business School and

detail.title: Robust Dynamic Programming for Inventory Control: Joint Supply and Demand Uncertainty
detail.abstract: We study a multiperiod robust inventory problem with joint demand and supply uncertainty, in which the quantity received is an uncertain fraction of the quantity ordered, and an adversary selects demand and yield after the order is placed. Existing robust inventory methods gain tractability either from static reformulations, which discard the sequential order--adversary interaction and so protect against shocks that cannot co-occur, or from affine decision rules, which lose exactness once yield enters multiplicatively. We instead solve the exact sequential min--max dynamic program. The difficulty is that, unlike additive demand, the order quantity itself determines the decision maker's exposure to the worst-case yield, a decision-dependent uncertainty in which a larger order widens the range of adverse outcomes, so which realization is adverse depends jointly on the order and the inventory state. Preserving this decision-first timing lets us characterize the optimal policy exactly: the optimal order combines multiple linear inflation rules (order-up-to targets scaled by a factor that compensates for yield loss), selected according to the inventory state, and collapses to a single base-stock rule only when yield is deterministic. This characterization yields closed-form short-horizon policies, a fixed-point terminal valuation under which a myopic inflation rule remains optimal over a certified state region at every horizon, and worst-case representation bounds showing that the number of affine pieces can be exponential under yield uncertainty but grows only linearly when yield is deterministic. Exploiting the same geometry, we develop a decomposition algorithm in the spirit of robust dual dynamic programming whose stage subproblems are solved by exact algebraic oracles rather than linear programs. In experiments, the exact robust DP policy achieves lower cost than static and affine-rule robust benchmarks, with the largest gains when demand or supply is extreme.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多周期鲁棒库存问题，同时面临需求和供应不确定性（产量为订单的不确定比例）。作者通过求解精确的序贯最小-最大动态规划，刻画了最优策略：最优订货量结合多个线性通货膨胀规则（按库存状态选择），并开发了基于鲁棒对偶动态规划的分解算法。实验表明，该策略在供需极端情况下优于静态和仿射决策规则方法。
AI.research_question: 在需求和供应同时不确定（产量为订单的不确定比例）的多周期库存问题中，如何求解精确的序贯最小-最大动态规划并刻画最优策略？
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒库存方法要么使用静态重构（丢弃序贯交互，导致保护过度），要么使用仿射决策规则（产量乘性进入时失去精确性），无法精确求解此类问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 鲁棒优化、最小-最大动态规划、决策依赖的不确定性（订单量决定了决策者对最坏情况产量的暴露程度）、线性通货膨胀规则、鲁棒对偶动态规划。
AI.method: 精确求解序贯最小-最大动态规划；通过几何特征刻画最优策略为分段线性通货膨胀规则；开发基于鲁棒对偶动态规划的分解算法，阶段子问题由精确代数预言求解而非线性规划。
AI.findings: 最优策略由多个线性通货膨胀规则（按库存状态选择）组合而成，仅在产量确定性时退化为单个基库存策略；给出了短视策略的闭式解、固定点终期估值以及最坏情况表示界限；算法在供需极端情况下优于静态和仿射决策规则基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在乘性产量不确定性下精确求解序贯鲁棒动态规划，刻画了决策依赖不确定性的最优策略结构，证明了在产量不确定性下仿射分段数量可能指数增长。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可实际部署的鲁棒库存算法，在供需极端波动时显著降低库存成本，为企业应对供应链中断提供了更稳健的订货策略。

title: AI–Human Capital Complementarity in Workplace Decision-Making
affiliations: University of Manchester and Faculty of Economics, Chulalongkorn University

detail.title: AI–Human Capital Complementarity in Workplace Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is diffusing rapidly into workplaces, but its benefits are unevenly distributed across workers. Many workers report performance gains from AI use, but a smaller share report that AI assists them with decision-making. The worker- and job-level characteristics that distinguish these two patterns of AI integration remain poorly understood. This paper investigates which worker characteristics are associated with AI-enhanced performance versus AI-assisted decision-making, applying an AI–human capital complementarity framework. It additionally distinguishes the speed and quality dimensions of AI-assisted decision-making, examining whether complementarity patterns differ between the two. Probit models with marginal effects are estimated for 2,134 AI-using workers in the manufacturing and financial services sectors across seven OECD countries (OECD, 2023). Four outcomes are examined: improved performance, AI-assisted decision-making, faster decisions, and better decisions. Logistic regressions are reported as a robustness check. Motivational predictors (AI enthusiasm and being born after 1980) are positively associated with AI-enhanced performance, but human-capital and authority-based predictors (higher education and supervisor or managerial status) become statistically significant only for the decision-making outcomes, consistent with AI–human capital complementarity. Formal AI training predicts both outcomes but more strongly decision-making. The generational effect on performance disappears for decision-making. A gender difference emerges only for decision quality, not decision speed. AI’s benefits in worker decision-making are conditional on human capital and organisational authority. Motivation drives broad performance gains, but decision-level AI integration requires structured human-capital inputs. These findings imply that policies seeking inclusive AI-driven decision-making should prioritise training and educational investment alongside motivational engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文基于OECD七国制造业和金融服务业2,134名AI使用者的调查数据，运用AI-人力资本互补框架，区分了AI提升绩效与AI辅助决策两种整合模式。发现动机因素（AI热情、80后）与绩效提升正相关，而人力资本（高等教育）和组织权威（主管身份）仅对决策结果显著；AI培训对两种结果均有预测作用，但对决策更强。性别差异仅出现在决策质量而非速度上。表明AI的决策效益有条件于人力资本和组织权威。
AI.research_question: 哪些工人特征与AI提升绩效（AI-enhanced performance）及AI辅助决策（AI-assisted decision-making）相关？AI辅助决策的速度与质量维度的互补模式是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: AI正在快速渗透职场，但其收益在工人间分布不均：多数工人报告AI带来绩效提升，但较少工人报告AI辅助其决策。区分这两种AI整合模式的工人和岗位特征尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI-人力资本互补框架（AI–human capital complementarity framework），区分AI提升绩效与AI辅助决策两种整合模式，并进一步区分决策的速度与质量维度。
AI.method: Probit模型（边际效应），对2,134名AI使用者（OECD七国制造业和金融服务业）进行分析。稳健性检验使用Logistic回归。四个结果变量：绩效提升、AI辅助决策、更快决策、更好决策。
AI.findings: 1. 动机预测因子（AI热情、80后）与AI提升绩效正相关；2. 人力资本（高等教育）和组织权威（主管/管理身份）仅对决策结果显著；3. 正式AI培训预测两种结果，但对决策更强；4. 代际效应在决策结果上消失；5. 性别差异仅出现在决策质量（而非速度）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI整合细分为绩效提升与决策辅助两个层次，并进一步区分决策的速度与质量维度，揭示了人力资本和组织权威在AI辅助决策中的关键互补作用，拓展了AI-人力资本互补理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者和企业的启示：推动包容性AI驱动决策的政策应优先考虑培训和教育的投入，同时兼顾动机层面的激励。管理者若希望AI真正赋能决策，需关注员工的人力资本水平和组织授权。

reference: Journal of Industrial Relations, volume 66, issue 5, 2024[10.1177/00221856241290625]
title: Australia’s Right to Disconnect from Work: Beyond Rhetoric and Towards Implementation
affiliations: Centre for Business and Social Innovation and

detail.title: Australia’s Right to Disconnect from Work: Beyond Rhetoric and Towards Implementation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Industrial Relations, volume 66, issue 5, 2024[10.1177/00221856241290625]

detail.abstract:
Amendments to the Fair Work Act now allow workers in Australia a right to disconnect. The implementation of this right precipitated a polarised public debate that was not consistently evidence-based, encompassing the oftencontradictory perspectives of unions, employers, business lobbies and politicians. This study offers a more nuanced and evidence-based understanding of the right to disconnect, its benefits and challenges and the possible impact on Australian employment practices and relations.
