detail.title: Alcohol Consumption and Intimate Partner Violence: Long-Term Effects of a Temporary Alcohol Ban
detail.abstract: We study the effects of temporary restrictions on alcohol availability on alcohol consumption and intimate partner violence. We exploit a policy in Kerala, India, that sharply restricted hard liquor sales in bars in 2014 and was fully reversed in 2017. We estimate difference-in-differences and event-study models exploiting cross-district variation in pre-policy exposure to hard liquor consumption. We find that bar-based alcohol consumption declined sharply following the policy but returned to pre-policy levels within roughly ten months, consistent with consumers substituting toward lower-alcohol fermented drinks, such as beer and wine, sold through permitted outlets. We find no evidence of substitution toward hard alcohol consumption at home during the policy period. Domestic violence declined among higher-exposure, higher-wealth households during the policy period and increased following the policy's repeal, with effects concentrated in less frequent forms of violence. Overall, our findings suggest that temporary alcohol restrictions reduce alcohol consumption and intimate partner violence in the short run, but these gains dissipate once the restrictions are lifted.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度喀拉拉邦2014年实施、2017年完全撤销的烈酒销售临时禁令，研究发现该政策短期内显著降低了酒吧酒精消费和亲密伴侣暴力，但效果在政策撤销后迅速消失，消费者转向啤酒等低度酒替代消费。
AI.research_question: 临时性酒精供应限制对酒精消费和亲密伴侣暴力有何影响？政策撤销后这些效应是否持续？
AI.motivation: 酒精消费与家庭暴力的关系是重要公共政策议题，但以往研究多关注永久性限制政策，对临时性政策及其撤销后的动态效应缺乏证据。喀拉拉邦的独特政策实验为识别因果关系提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者替代行为理论和家庭暴力经济学模型，分析酒精限制政策通过降低可及性影响消费，以及消费者在烈酒与低度酒、家庭饮酒与外部饮酒之间的替代效应。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DID）和事件研究法，利用政策前各区域烈酒消费量的截面差异作为处理强度变量，比较高暴露区与低暴露区在政策实施前后的变化。
AI.findings: （1）酒吧烈酒消费在政策后急剧下降，但约10个月内恢复至政策前水平；（2）消费者转向啤酒等低度酒，未发现家庭烈酒消费替代；（3）高暴露富裕家庭中家庭暴力在政策期间下降，政策撤销后上升，效应集中于非频繁暴力形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了临时性酒精限制政策的动态效应机制：短期有效但存在消费替代，政策撤销后效果逆转为临时性限制政策的局限性提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定酒精管控政策提供实证依据：临时性禁令虽能短期减少暴力，但需配合长期综合治理措施才能维持效果，政策设计需考虑消费者替代行为和反弹效应。

title: Budget 2025 And 2026: An Analysis of Key Impacts and Responses within the Hospitality Sector

detail.title: Budget 2025 And 2026: An Analysis of Key Impacts and Responses within the Hospitality Sector

declarations.ethicsApproval: Informed written consent was obtained from the participating individuals for the collection, analysis, and publication of the data presented in this study.

detail.abstract: This research outlines the key budgetary measures recently introduced by the Chancellor of the Exchequer and the subsequent impact on the Hospitality sector and the wider implications on the Events and Tourism sector from the perspective of leading sector bodies, institutions and sector responses. The paper focuses on four key budgetary measures introduced including Business Rates, Green Levy, National Living Wage and Apprenticeship Funding as outlined in Budget 2025. This forms the basis of this research paper and the key areas of analysis that will focus on the nature of the measures introduced and the response made by leadership teams and business owners. The paper outlines the findings from a mixed methods qualitative and quantitative approach, utilising an opened and closed ended questionnaire to managers, senior leaders and business owners analysing their operational reactions to the budgetary measures in those four areas. Furthermore, triangulation based on the document analysis will be undertaken further understand budget measures, impacts and consequences. The study includes 95 valid participants and this is the first in a two-part research paper with the second research paper post Budget 2026. The primary theoretical lens for this research is an Institutional Theory examining how hospitality organisations respond to regulatory changes based on three isomorphic processes of change: coercive, mimetic, and normative. The purpose of this paper is to conduct ongoing live research of contemporary issues in the hospitality sector where the data and findings can be shared and disseminated amongst faculty staff for module updates, student workshops and as part of a wider research project.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2025年英国预算案中的四项关键财政措施（商业税率、绿色税、国家最低工资和学徒资助），通过混合研究方法（95份有效问卷+文件分析），以制度理论为视角，分析酒店业领导者对这些监管变化的运营反应，并探讨其对更广泛的会展旅游业的潜在影响。这是两阶段研究的第一部分。
AI.research_question: 2025年英国预算案中四项关键财政措施（商业税率、绿色税、国家最低工资、学徒资助）如何影响酒店业及其领导团队的运营决策？这些影响对更广泛的会展和旅游业有何溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 英国2025年预算案引入了多项影响深远的财政措施，酒店业作为劳动密集型和成本敏感型行业首当其冲。然而，现有研究缺乏对行业领导者实际运营反应的及时捕捉与分析。本研究旨在进行"活态"（live）研究，实时追踪当代问题，为教学更新和学生研讨提供一手数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（Institutional Theory），重点考察三种同构变迁过程：强制性同构（coercive）、模仿性同构（mimetic）和规范性同构（normative），用以解释酒店组织如何应对外部监管变化。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：①开放与封闭式问卷——面向经理、高级领导和企业主，收集其对四项预算措施的运营反应（95份有效样本）；②文件分析——对预算案文件进行三角验证，深入理解措施内容、影响与后果。本研究为两阶段系列论文的第一部分，第二阶段将在2026年预算案后开展。
AI.findings: 摘要未提供具体数据结论，仅说明本研究将呈现行业领导团队和企业在商业税率、绿色税、最低工资和学徒资助四项措施下的运营反应和应对策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论的三种同构机制（强制性、模仿性、规范性）应用于英国最新财政政策背景下的酒店业研究，检验该理论在解释行业对即时监管变化的组织响应中的适用性和解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为酒店和会展旅游业的管理者及企业主提供应对2025年预算政策变化的实操参考；②研究成果可直接用于高校教学模块更新和学生工作坊，连接学术研究与产业实践；③作为持续追踪研究，为行业和政策制定者提供动态证据支持。

title: Psychological Empowerment as a Mediator in Virtual Teams: A Critical Review of Transformational Leadership and Employee Engagement
affiliations: University of Vocational Technology and University of Colombo

detail.title: Psychological Empowerment as a Mediator in Virtual Teams: A Critical Review of Transformational Leadership and Employee Engagement
detail.abstract: Rapid expansion of remote and virtual work has reshaped how leadership influences employee motivation and engagement. While transformational leadership proven to be associated with higher employee engagement, lesser attention is given towards psychological mechanism through which this relationship operates in a digital environment. This conceptual review proposes psychological empowerment-comprising meaning, competence. Self-determination and impact as the key mediating mechanism linking transformational leadership to employee engagement in virtual teams. Focusing on Job Demands-Resources model, Social Exchange Theory, and Self-Determination Theory, this paper argues that in virtual contexts characterized by autonomy, reduced visibility and increased self-regulation demands, leadership influence is perceived through empowerment rather than direct behavioural mechanisms. The framework further identifies contextual boundary conditions, including communication quality, technostress, team maturity and cultural context. Hence by integrating leadership and motivational perspectives, this paper provides a context-sensitive conceptual model and provides directions for future empirical research in virtual settings

AI.tldr: 本文提出心理赋能（意义感、胜任感、自主感、影响力）是虚拟团队中变革型领导提升员工敬业度的关键中介机制，并整合JD-R模型、社会交换理论与自我决定理论，识别了沟通质量、技术压力、团队成熟度与文化背景等边界条件。
AI.research_question: 在虚拟工作环境中，变革型领导如何通过心理赋能影响员工敬业度？其作用机制和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 远程与虚拟工作快速发展，但现有研究对变革型领导与员工敬业度之间关系的心理机制关注不足，尤其缺乏针对虚拟情境的理论模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作需求-资源模型（JD-R）、社会交换理论（SET）、自我决定理论（SDT）
AI.method: 概念性综述（Conceptual Review），通过理论整合与逻辑推演构建理论框架。
AI.findings: 虚拟情境中，领导力通过心理赋能（意义、胜任、自主、影响）而非直接行为机制影响员工敬业度；沟通质量、技术压力、团队成熟度、文化背景是重要的边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合领导力与动机理论，提出虚拟情境下"变革型领导→心理赋能→员工敬业度"的中介路径模型，并识别了关键调节变量，拓展了虚拟团队情境下的领导力理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为虚拟团队管理者提供实践启示：应通过赋能手段（而非直接监督）提升员工敬业度，同时需关注技术压力与沟通质量等情境因素。

title: DB-KAUNet: An Adaptive Dual Branch Kolmogorov-Arnold UNet for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) - Institute of High Performance Computing, affiliation not provided to SSRN, South China University of Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DB-KAUNet: An Adaptive Dual Branch Kolmogorov-Arnold UNet for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
detail.abstract: Accurate segmentation of retinal vessels is crucial for the clinical diagnosis of numerous ophthalmic and systemic diseases. However, traditional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) methods exhibit inherent limitations, struggling to capture long-range dependencies and complex nonlinear relationships. To address the above limitations, an Adaptive Dual Branch Kolmogorov-Arnold UNet (DB-KAUNet) is proposed for retinal vessel segmentation. In DB-KAUNet, we design a Heterogeneous Dual-Branch Encoder (HDBE) that features parallel CNN and Transformer pathways. The HDBE strategically interleaves standard CNN and Transformer blocks with novel KANConv and KAT blocks, enabling the model to form a comprehensive feature representation. To optimize feature processing, we integrate several critical components into the HDBE. First, a Cross-Branch Channel Interaction (CCI) module is embedded to facilitate efficient interaction of channel features between the parallel pathways. Second, an attention-based Spatial Feature Enhancement (SFE) module is employed to enhance spatial features and fuse the outputs from both branches. Building upon the SFE module, an advanced Spatial Feature Enhancement with Geometrically Adaptive Fusion (SFE-GAF) module is subsequently developed. In the SFE-GAF module, adaptive sampling is utilized to focus on true vessel morphology precisely. The adaptive process strengthens salient vascular features while significantly reducing background noise and computational overhead. Extensive experiments on the DRIVE, STARE, and CHASE_DB1 datasets validate that DB-KAUNet achieves leading segmentation performance and demonstrates exceptional robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应双分支Kolmogorov-Arnold UNet（DB-KAUNet）用于视网膜血管分割，通过融合CNN和Transformer的异构双分支编码器，并集成跨分支通道交互、空间特征增强及几何自适应融合模块，在多个数据集上取得了领先的分割性能。
AI.research_question: 如何克服传统CNN方法在视网膜血管分割中难以捕捉长距离依赖和复杂非线性关系的局限性？
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割对眼科及全身性疾病临床诊断至关重要，但传统CNN方法存在固有局限性，难以捕捉长距离依赖和复杂非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kolmogorov-Arnold Network理论；CNN与Transformer融合的异构双分支架构；注意力机制与自适应采样理论。
AI.method: 提出自适应双分支Kolmogorov-Arnold UNet（DB-KAUNet），包含异构双分支编码器（HDBE），并行CNN与Transformer通路，交错使用KANConv和KAT模块；集成跨分支通道交互（CCI）模块、空间特征增强（SFE）模块及几何自适应融合（SFE-GAF）模块。
AI.findings: 在DRIVE、STARE和CHASE_DB1三个数据集上验证，DB-KAUNet实现了领先的分割性能，并展现出卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kolmogorov-Arnold Network引入医学图像分割领域，提出KANConv和KAT模块，丰富了CNN-Transformer融合架构的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为视网膜血管分割提供了一种高性能、高鲁棒性的实用方法，有助于提升眼科疾病临床诊断的准确性和效率。

title:
Orgmastr Working Papers in Organization Capability Working Paper No. 1 
Has HR been Chasing the Wrong Prize? From Performance to Organization Capability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Orgmastr Working Papers in Organization Capability Working Paper No. 1 
Has HR been Chasing the Wrong Prize? From Performance to Organization Capability

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, it has not appeared, or been accepted to appear in any Paper Series, Journal or Book as of this date.

detail.abstract:
For more than four decades, research in strategic human resource management (SHRM) has at­tempted to establish systematic relationships between human resource practices and organizational performance. Despite extensive empirical effort, findings remain inconsistent, context dependent, and frequently characterized as a “black box” problem. This paper argues that the persistence of this difficulty reflects a deeper conceptual issue: the mis-specification of the dependent variable. Organizational performance is an emergent system-level outcome influenced by multiple interact­ing organizational subsystems, making it an implausible direct target for HRM theory.

This paper proposes a reframing in which organization capability, rather than performance, becomes the appropriate focal outcome for HRM’s strategic contribution. Organization capability is defined as the evidenced ability of an organization, as designed, to achieve specified outcomes under defined conditions through the integrated functioning of its human and structural elements. By repositioning HRM’s role within capability formation and readiness, the paper offers a clearer theoretical pathway linking human resource systems to organizational outcomes. The argument contributes to ongoing debates regarding the explanatory limits of SHRM research and provides a conceptual foundation for more coherent empirical investigation of HRM’s strategic value.

The paper contributes to debates in strategic human resource management, organization theory, and the resource-based view of the firm by clarifying the role of HR systems in capability formation and organizational effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑战略人力资源管理（SHRM）长期将"组织绩效"作为因变量的合理性，认为绩效是多个子系统交互涌现的系统层面结果，不适合作为HRM理论的直接目标。作者提出应将"组织能力"（organization capability）作为HRM战略贡献的适当焦点结果变量，并重新定位HRM在能力形成与准备度中的角色。
AI.research_question: SHRM研究中因变量（组织绩效）的设定是否存在根本性概念错误？如果存在，应该如何重新设定HRM理论适当的结果变量？
AI.motivation: SHRM研究四十多年来试图建立人力资源实践与组织绩效之间的系统关系，但实证结果始终不一致、依赖情境，常被称为"黑箱"问题。作者认为这反映了一个更深层次的概念问题——因变量的错误设定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织能力理论、资源基础观（RBV）、系统理论（组织绩效作为涌现性系统层面结果）
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，通过逻辑论证和理论推演提出概念重构
AI.findings: 组织绩效是多子系统交互作用的涌现性结果，不适合作为HRM理论的直接因变量；应代之以"组织能力"——即组织在设计上通过人力与结构要素的整合运作，在特定条件下实现特定结果的被证能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为SHRM研究提供了更清晰的理论路径，将HRM的角色重新定位于能力形成与准备度；澄清了HR系统在能力形成和组织有效性中的作用，推进了关于SHRM解释边界的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR实践与组织绩效之间更连贯的实证研究提供概念基础，帮助管理者和学者更准确地理解HRM的战略价值来源。

title: Automation Threat and Labor Market Power

detail.title: Automation Threat and Labor Market Power
detail.abstract: This paper studies the role of automation threat in firms' labor market power. Employing the production approach, I show that workers in an average German manufacturer receive 79 cents on the marginal euro. Using automation threats proxied by local labor market regions' exposure to industrial robots, instrumented by plausibly exogenous shift-share factors, I find that robot exposure increases employer power over routine workers in East German districts with weaker unions, where spatial frictions are more pronounced. The empirical findings are consistent with the wage bargaining model in which employers retain the "right-to-manage" their workforce composition and unions representing different worker groups bargain separately with the firm.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了自动化威胁对企业在劳动力市场垄断势力的影响。研究发现，在德国制造业中，工人平均只能获得边际产出的79%。在工会力量较弱、空间摩擦较大的东德地区，机器人暴露显著增加了雇主对常规工人的垄断势力。这一发现与"权变管理"下的工资谈判模型一致。
AI.research_question: 自动化威胁如何影响企业在劳动力市场的垄断势力（雇主力量）？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对劳动力市场垄断势力的研究较多，但较少关注技术变革（特别是自动化）如何影响企业的议价能力。理解自动化对雇主力量的影响对劳动政策制定具有重要含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"权变管理"（right-to-manage）工资谈判模型，其中企业保留调整劳动力组成的权利，不同工人群体分别与雇主进行谈判。
AI.method: 采用生产法估计劳动力市场垄断势力（雇主力量）；使用地区工业机器人暴露度作为自动化威胁的代理变量，并采用工具变量法（shift-share IV）处理内生性问题。
AI.findings: （1）德国制造业工人平均仅获得边际产出的79%（即雇主有21%的垄断租）；（2）机器人暴露增加了东德地区（工会力量弱、空间摩擦大）常规工人的雇主力量；（3）这一效应在工会力量薄弱的地区更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术变革（自动化/机器人）纳入劳动力市场垄断势力的分析框架，揭示了自动化如何通过削弱工人议价能力来增强雇主力量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解自动化对劳动力市场不平等的影响提供了新视角；对工会政策、区域发展政策和自动化补偿机制设计具有启示意义。

title: Embedding Biodiversity in Business Strategy: Challenging Control Systems to Achieve Nature Positive Goals
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management, Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management and Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management

detail.title: Embedding Biodiversity in Business Strategy: Challenging Control Systems to Achieve Nature Positive Goals
detail.abstract: Nature Positive (NP) is a global ambition to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030. Despite the growing popularity and adoption of NP-related objectives, the implementation of such commitments is far from effective and difficult to control. This study examines the extent to which management control systems (MCSs) for halting biodiversity loss can facilitate the achievement of NP goals. Drawing on a multi-case study of four Italian organizations operating in the agri-food sector, we observe that MCSs are primarily used to build environmental capabilities and strategy implementation. Moreover, our study shows that organizations resort to collaboration and stakeholder engagement to leverage external technical knowledge, overcome the ambiguity of NP targets, and project control beyond organizational boundaries to influence suppliers' behavior. Based on these insights, we develop a conceptual framework to draw the relationship between MCSs, key capabilities, organizational strategy, and NP commitments. The framework highlights the iterative and relational nature of control in addressing complex ecological goals, extending the understanding of how MCSs operate in contexts of sustainability and biodiversity management.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多案例研究，探讨了管理控制系统（MCSs）如何帮助农业食品企业实现"自然向好"（NP）目标，发现MCS主要用于构建环境能力和实施战略，并通过合作与利益相关者参与来克服NP目标的模糊性、拓展控制边界，最终提出了一个连接MCS、关键能力、组织战略与NP承诺的概念框架。
AI.research_question: 管理控制系统（MCSs）在多大程度上能够促进组织实现"自然向好"（NP）目标？MCSs如何帮助组织应对生物多样性丧失问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管"自然向好"（NP）已成为全球共识，许多组织也制定了相关目标，但实际执行效果远不理想且难以控制。因此，需要探索管理控制系统在其中能发挥什么作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理控制系统理论（MCSs）；可持续发展与生物多样性管理视角；能力构建与战略实施理论；组织间控制与利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 多案例研究法，以意大利农业食品行业的四家组织为研究对象。
AI.findings: （1）MCSs主要用于构建环境能力和推动战略实施；（2）组织通过合作与利益相关者参与来获取外部技术知识、克服NP目标的模糊性；（3）组织将控制延伸到边界之外，影响供应商行为；（4）MCS在应对复杂生态目标时具有迭代性和关系性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个连接MCS、关键能力、组织战略与NP承诺的概念框架，拓展了MCS在可持续发展和生物多样性管理语境下的理解，揭示了控制应对复杂生态目标的迭代性和关系性本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织实施NP目标提供了管理控制系统的具体使用路径（能力构建、战略实施、跨组织协作），帮助企业更有效地将NP承诺转化为实际行动，并为政策制定者和管理者提供了如何通过MCS推动生物多样性保护的实践启示。

title: Gold Preference in Asian Households: A Comparative Analysis of Investment Behavior Across Six Asian Economies

detail.title: Gold Preference in Asian Households: A Comparative Analysis of Investment Behavior Across Six Asian Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval: Not required, as the study is based on secondary data and does not involve human participants or patient records
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural and behavioural determinants of gold preference over equity investment in six Asian economies — India, China, Japan, Indonesia, Thailand, and South Korea — over the period 1997 to 2025. Drawing on data from the World Gold Council, the Bank of Korea, the Reserve Bank of India, the International Monetary Fund, and peer-reviewed behavioural finance literature, the paper argues that gold demand in these markets reflects a combination of rational portfolio responses to recurring currency depreciation and institutional distrust, culturally embedded savings traditions, and well-documented behavioural biases including loss aversion and the certainty effect (Kahneman and Tversky, 1979). The paper identifies a consistent empirical pattern: episodes of currency depreciation are followed by measurable surges in household gold demand across all six markets studied. This pattern holds regardless of cultural differences, suggesting that macroeconomic vulnerability — rather than culture alone — is the primary driver of gold preference. However, cultural factors are shown to influence the baseline level and form of gold demand (jewellery versus investment), reinforcing the core preference established through economic experience. The paper also identifies a policy paradox specific to gold-importing economies, particularly India, where household gold demand — individually rational as a hedge — creates aggregate current account pressure and foreign exchange vulnerability. The paper concludes with a limitations section acknowledging the boundaries of the analysis and directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1997-2025年六个亚洲经济体（印度、中国、日本、印度尼西亚、泰国、韩国）中黄金偏好优于股票投资的结构性和行为性决定因素，发现货币贬值、制度不信任、文化传统和损失厌恶等行为偏误共同驱动了黄金需求，且宏观经济脆弱性是黄金偏好的主要驱动因素而非文化因素。
AI.research_question: 在六个亚洲经济体中，黄金偏好优于股票投资的结构性和行为性决定因素是什么？货币贬值与文化因素在驱动黄金需求中各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 亚洲经济体长期存在对黄金的显著偏好，但对其背后驱动因素的系统性跨文化比较研究不足，尤其是宏观经济因素与文化因素的相对重要性尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的前景理论（损失厌恶与确定性效应，Kahneman & Tversky, 1979）；投资组合理论；制度信任理论；文化经济学。
AI.method: 基于世界黄金协会、韩国银行、印度储备银行、国际货币基金组织等来源的数据，结合同行评审的行为金融学文献，进行跨国的实证模式识别与分析。
AI.findings: （1）货币贬值事件后，所有六个市场的家庭黄金需求均出现可测量的激增，这一模式超越文化差异；（2）宏观经济脆弱性是黄金偏好的主要驱动因素；（3）文化因素影响黄金需求的基准水平和形式（珠宝vs投资），但仅强化了经济经验建立的核心偏好；（4）在黄金进口经济体（尤其是印度）存在政策悖论：个体理性的黄金对冲行为在宏观层面造成经常账户压力和外汇脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了宏观经济因素与文化因素在黄金偏好中的相对作用，揭示了行为偏误（损失厌恶、确定性效应）与宏观脆弱性在驱动资产选择中的交互机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解黄金进口经济体的宏观-微观矛盾提供分析框架；为投资者理解亚洲市场的黄金偏好结构提供实证依据。

title: Reconciling Development Partner Procurement Guidelines With Uganda’s Ppda Framework

detail.title: Reconciling Development Partner Procurement Guidelines With Uganda’s Ppda Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the official position or policy of the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, the Government of Uganda, or any affiliated institution.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research is based exclusively on the analysis of publicly available legislation, regulations, policy documents, institutional reports, and published literature. No human participants, personal data, surveys, interviews, or experiments were involved in the conduct of this research
declarations.funderStatement: No specific funding was received for this research. The study was conducted independently by the author as part of ongoing professional and academic research in the fields of public finance, procurement law, and development policy.

keywords: Public Procurement Development Partner Procurement PPDA Framework Procurement Harmonization Donor-Funded Projects Procurement Law Public Financial Management Value for Money Development Finance International Procurement Standards Procurement Governance E-Government Procurement (e-GP) Procurement Compliance World Bank Procurement Regulations African Development Bank Procurement Procurement Reform Sustainable Public Procurement Institutional Capacity Building

detail.abstract:
Public procurement plays a critical role in the implementation of externally financed development projects in Uganda. However, the increasing reliance on development partner financing has created operational challenges arising from the coexistence of Uganda’s Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets (PPDA) framework and the procurement rules of international development partners such as the World Bank, African Development Bank, and United Nations agencies. This paper examines the legal, institutional, and operational mechanisms through which Uganda can reconcile development partner procurement requirements with the PPDA framework while maintaining compliance with both domestic law and financing agreements.

The study analyses the legal provisions contained in the PPDA Act, particularly the provisions recognizing the supremacy of international agreements and donor funding conditions where conflicts arise, and assesses the extent to which these provisions facilitate harmonization. The paper identifies key areas of convergence and divergence between the PPDA framework and development partner procurement systems, including eligibility requirements, local content preferences, procurement thresholds, procurement methods, standard bidding documents, complaints mechanisms, review processes, and approval procedures. It further evaluates the implementation challenges associated with managing dual procurement regimes, including legal uncertainty, procurement delays, audit risks, duplication of oversight mechanisms, and capacity constraints within procuring and disposing entities.

The paper finds that Uganda already possesses a sufficient legal foundation for harmonization and does not require fundamental legislative reform. Rather, the principal challenge lies in establishing clear operational mechanisms to manage conflicts between procurement regimes and reduce implementation risks. To address these challenges, the paper proposes a structured hybrid procurement model that retains the PPDA framework as the primary system for planning, accountability, records management, ethics, oversight, and contract management, while allowing project-specific application of development partner rules where legally required. The study recommends the adoption of government-wide harmonization guidelines, standardized project procurement annexes, conflict matrices, enhanced e-GP integration, targeted capacity building, and a unified complaints and review framework.

The paper concludes that effective reconciliation of development partner procurement guidelines with Uganda’s PPDA framework is both legally feasible and institutionally desirable. By adopting a predictable and transparent harmonization approach, Uganda can reduce procurement delays, strengthen accountability, improve project implementation performance, and maximize the developmental impact of externally financed investments while safeguarding national procurement objectives and value for money.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨乌干达如何在维持国内PPDA采购框架合规的同时，调和国际发展伙伴（如世界银行、非洲开发银行等）的采购要求，提出结构化混合采购模式及一系列操作机制，以实现法律可行、制度可取的协调方案。
AI.research_question: 乌干达如何通过法律、制度和操作机制，在发展伙伴采购要求与国内PPDA框架之间实现调和，同时保持对国内法和资助协议的合规性？
AI.motivation: 乌干达外部融资发展项目日益依赖发展伙伴资金，但国内PPDA框架与国际发展伙伴采购规则并存导致法律不确定性、采购延误、审计风险、监督重叠和能力限制等操作挑战，亟需找到有效的协调机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律调和（Legal Harmonization）理论；制度冲突与协调理论；公共采购治理框架；双重采购体制（Dual Procurement Regimes）下的合规管理理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（PPDA法案条款分析）；比较制度分析（PPDA框架与发展伙伴采购体系的趋同与分歧点识别）；实施挑战评估（对采购延误、审计风险、监督重叠等问题的实证评估）。
AI.findings: 乌干达已具备充分的法律调和基础，无需根本性立法改革；核心挑战在于建立清晰的操作机制来管理采购体制间的冲突；可行的解决方案是结构化混合采购模型，以PPDA框架为主系统，同时允许项目层面的发展伙伴规则适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"结构化混合采购模型"作为调和国内法与国际资助协议冲突的理论框架；系统识别了双重采购体制下合规管理的理论维度（法律冲突、制度重叠、操作风险）。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用政府层面统一调和指南、标准化项目采购附件、冲突矩阵、增强的电子政府采购（e-GP）整合、针对性能力建设以及统一投诉审查框架，以减少采购延误、加强问责、提升项目执行绩效。

title: Rethinking Management Control Systems for Biodiversity: A Critical Review and Research Agenda
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management, Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management and Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management

detail.title: Rethinking Management Control Systems for Biodiversity: A Critical Review and Research Agenda

declarations.funderStatement: Funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU - PNRR - MISSION 4 COMPONENT 2 INVESTMENT 1.4 - AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGIES - D.D. 3138 OF 16.12.2021 - NBFC - National Center for the Future of Biodiversity (CN 00000033) CUP: J53C21000290006. However, the views and opinions expressed are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Commission. Neither the European Union nor the European Commission can be held responsible for them. Funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU - PNRR - MISSION 4 COMPONENT 2, as part of the GRINS - Growing Resilient, INclusive and Sustainable project (GRINS PE00000018 – CUP J53C22003140001). However, the views and opinions expressed are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Commission. Neither the European Union nor the European Commission can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract: This paper undertakes a critical literature review of management control systems (MCS) research addressing the question of how organizational control mechanisms conceptualize and respond to biodiversity challenges. Using a structured Scopus-based search, 127 relevant studies were analysed across diverse organizational disciplines. The review finds that research is fragmented, predominantly performance-and reporting-oriented, and highlights organizational practices shaped by legitimacy and impression management logics. While biodiversity is widely acknowledged as a critical concern, most studies treat it in vague or generalized terms, with limited theoretical grounding and a tendency to reproduce neoliberal narratives of ranking, competition, and commodification. We argue that these approaches risk reinforcing the very dynamics that drive biodiversity loss. The paper concludes by advocating for ecologically grounded reorientations of MCS research that moves beyond reporting analysis, towards defining the role of organizational figures and non-financial measurement systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对管理控制系统（MCS）中关于生物多样性挑战的研究进行了批判性文献综述，发现现有研究碎片化、以绩效和报告为导向，受合法性和印象管理逻辑驱动，缺乏理论深度，并呼吁MCS研究向生态导向转型。
AI.research_question: 组织控制机制如何概念化并回应生物多样性挑战？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性危机日益严峻，但管理控制系统（MCS）研究对其关注不足且碎片化，需要系统梳理现有研究并指出其理论缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性理论、印象管理逻辑、新自由主义叙事（排名、竞争、商品化）
AI.method: 基于Scopus的结构化文献检索，对127篇相关研究进行跨学科批判性综述
AI.findings: 1. 研究碎片化，以绩效和报告导向为主；2. 受合法性和印象管理逻辑驱动；3. 对生物多样性的处理模糊笼统，理论根基薄弱；4. 倾向于复制新自由主义的排名、竞争和商品化逻辑，可能加剧生物多样性丧失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了MCS研究在处理生态议题时的新自由主义偏见，指出了现有研究框架在应对生物多样性危机时的根本性局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁MCS研究超越报告分析，重新定义组织角色和非财务测量系统，推动向生态导向的转型。

title: Life Cycle Management Implementation as Information Processing: The Role of Conscious and Unconscious Reflection
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa, Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management and Ivey Business School

detail.title: Life Cycle Management Implementation as Information Processing: The Role of Conscious and Unconscious Reflection
detail.abstract: Formally similar sustainability management practices are often implemented in different ways, yielding heterogeneous environmental outcomes. As these practices typically rely on a key diagnostic phase, examining how organizations interpret and engage with the information generated is crucial to understanding variation in their implementation. This paper investigates how companies process environmental information when implementing Life Cycle Management (LCM). We draw on a longitudinal qualitative analysis of eleven Italian companies participating in a project based on Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) assessment, a life-cycle-based computational method. Our findings show that the depth of reflection on life-cycle results shapes distinct LCM implementation trajectories. When reflection remains unconscious, life-cycle information is used instrumentally, leading to a business-case-oriented form of LCM implementation. By contrast, conscious reflection on life-cycle information prompts a critical rethinking of established practices, leading companies to implement LCM according to a holistic life-cycle thinking. The study contributes to sustainability management literature by highlighting information processing as a pivotal mechanism shaping environmental practices implementation pathways.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对11家意大利公司参与产品环境足迹（PEF）评估项目的纵向定性分析，探讨企业在实施生命周期管理（LCM）时如何处理环境信息。研究发现，对生命周期结果反思的深度决定了不同的LCM实施轨迹：无意识反思导致工具性使用信息，产生以商业案例为导向的LCM；有意识反思则促使企业批判性重新思考既有实践，走向 holistic 生命周期思维。研究揭示了信息处理是塑造环境实践实施路径的关键机制。
AI.research_question: 企业在实施生命周期管理（LCM）时如何处理环境信息，以及信息处理方式如何影响LCM的差异化实施路径？
AI.motivation: 形式上相似的可持续管理实践往往以不同方式实施，产生异质性的环境绩效。由于这些实践通常依赖于关键诊断阶段，考察组织如何解读和参与所生成的信息，对于理解其实施的差异至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理视角（信息反思深度：无意识反思 vs. 有意识反思）；工具性使用 vs. 批判性反思
AI.method: 纵向定性分析；对11家参与PEF（产品环境足迹）评估项目的意大利公司进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 1) 对生命周期结果反思的深度塑造了不同的LCM实施轨迹；2) 无意识反思导致信息被工具性使用，产生以商业案例为导向的LCM实施；3) 有意识反思促使企业批判性重新思考既有实践，导向 holistic 生命周期思维的整体性LCM实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息处理作为塑造环境实践实施路径的关键机制，揭示了反思深度对可持续管理实践差异化的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了理解如何通过促进深度反思来推动更有效的环境管理实践实施的洞见。

title: Resource Dependence And Organisational Change In Ngos: A Systematic Literature Review
affiliations: Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa and Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management

detail.title: Resource Dependence And Organisational Change In Ngos: A Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: Non-governmental organisations (NGOs) face increasing pressure to adapt and reposition themselves within competitive and rapidly changing environments. In response, many NGOs alter their organisational structures and operational practices. This study draws on an established framework of pressure (re-creation). NGO responses vary substantially: some organisations comply with donor demands, while others negotiate, resist, or selectively adapt to funding requirements.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于压力（重塑）框架，分析了非政府组织（NGO）在竞争和快速变化的环境中所面临的压力及其应对策略。研究发现，NGO的应对方式差异显著：有的组织完全顺从捐助者要求，有的则进行谈判、抵制或选择性适应资助条件。
AI.research_question: 非政府组织在竞争和快速变化的环境中面临哪些压力？它们如何通过改变组织结构和运营实践来应对这些压力？
AI.motivation: 非政府组织在日益竞争和快速变化的环境中面临适应和重新定位的压力，但现有研究对其应对策略的多样性缺乏系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 压力（重塑）框架（pressure (re-creation) framework）
AI.method: 基于已建立的框架（压力重塑框架）进行的理论分析或实证研究。
AI.findings: NGO的应对策略具有显著异质性：有的完全顺从捐助者要求，有的进行谈判、抵制或选择性适应资助条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将压力（重塑）框架应用于NGO领域，揭示了NGO应对策略的多样性，丰富了组织应对环境压力的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NGO管理者提供了应对捐助者压力的策略选择参考，帮助理解不同应对方式的潜在后果。

title: Can Corporate Governance Reforms Reshape Supply-Chain Contracting? Evidence from Gender Quotas
affiliations: Business School, National University of Singapore, Alberta School of Business, University of Alberta and University of Navarra, IESE Business School

detail.title: Can Corporate Governance Reforms Reshape Supply-Chain Contracting? Evidence from Gender Quotas
detail.abstract: We study whether corporate governance reforms reshape contracting in global supply chains. Exploiting staggered board gender diversity (BGD) interventions in 37 customer countries as plausibly exogenous shocks, we examine their effects on the contracting outcomes of U.S. suppliers, which are not subject to comparable national policies. We find that U.S. suppliers with greater female board representation are more likely to obtain new contracts from customers in countries that adopt BGD reforms. These effects are stronger when the interventions are more likely to alter customer board composition and when customers possess greater bargaining power over suppliers, consistent with a customer-driven changes in governance preferences following the reforms. Mechanism tests indicate that the effects are more pronounced when customer firms have weaker pre-intervention ESG profiles, where board changes have greater scope to shift supplier-selection criteria toward board gender diversity, and when customer-supplier country pairs are more institutionally and culturally distant, where governance alignment may be more valuable in mitigating cross-border contracting frictions. Finally, U.S. suppliers more exposed to BGD-intervened customers subsequently increase female board representation, particularly when they have greater access to female director networks, and these increases are followed by improvements in operating performance. Overall, our findings highlight global supply chains as a channel through which governance reforms can have cross-border effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了客户国家公司治理改革（董事会性别多样性强制要求）如何通过全球供应链影响美国供应商的合同获取、董事会构成及经营绩效，揭示了治理改革的跨境溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 客户国家推行的董事会性别多样性（BGD）改革是否会影响美国供应商的合同签订、董事会构成及经营绩效？
AI.motivation: 公司治理改革是否具有跨境溢出效应？全球供应链是否充当治理改革扩散的渠道？现有研究对治理改革的跨境影响关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理改革、供应链关系、跨境合同摩擦、董事会多样性、制度距离理论
AI.method: 利用37个客户国家交错推行董事会性别多样性改革作为准外生冲击，使用双重差分等实证方法分析美国供应商的合同获取、董事会构成变化及经营绩效。
AI.findings: 1) 美国供应商中女性董事比例更高的企业更容易从推行BGD改革国家的客户获得新合同；2) 当改革更可能改变客户董事会构成、客户议价能力更强时效果更显著；3) 机制上，客户ESG状况弱、制度文化距离大时效果更强；4) 受影响的美国供应商随后增加了女性董事比例，并改善了经营绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了治理改革的跨境溢出效应，将公司治理与全球供应链研究相结合，拓展了制度理论在跨境合同摩擦中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了治理改革具有全球影响的证据；为企业理解供应链中治理标准传递提供了启示。

title: When Does Customization Work? Service Authenticity, Mission-Relevant Personalization, and Data Sharing in AI-Enabled Smart Mobility Applications
affiliations: and Sant’Anna School of Advanced Studies - Institute of Management

detail.title: When Does Customization Work? Service Authenticity, Mission-Relevant Personalization, and Data Sharing in AI-Enabled Smart Mobility Applications

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge financial support under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP), Mission 4, Component 2, Investment 1.1, Call for tender No. 1409 published on 14.9.2022 by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR), funded by the European Union – NextGenerationEU– Project Title “D-SMART - Digitalization for Sustainable Mobility Accelerating a Right Transition (interdisciplinary contributions from social sciences to a sustainable evolution of smart mobility)” – CUP J53D23016710 001 - Grant Assignment Decree No. 1378 adopted on 01/09/2023 by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR).

detail.abstract: AI-enabled mobility services create value through personalization, but data intensity can undermine consumer openness. This study examines whether stronger customization cues increase acceptance or backfire by reducing perceived service authenticity. Using a 2 × 2 scenario experiment with an AIenabled multimodal urban smart assistant (MUSA) and 1,946 Italian respondents, we test how customization intensity and benefit framing shape authenticity, use/share intention, and data-sharing decisions. Results show that higher customization intensity is associated with lower perceived authenticity, whereas authenticity increases use/share intention. Mediation analyses show that this negative effect operates through authenticity. Within high-customization conditions, utilitarian customization outperforms hedonic or prosocial customization. Collective-purpose cues played a more limited and context-dependent role. Item-level evidence shows highly selective disclosure willingness, with mobility-relevant data more acceptable than intimate or weakly mission-related data. The findings extend privacy-calculus and personalization research by identifying authenticity as a key evaluative mechanism in responses to AI-enabled personalization.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过一项2×2情景实验（1946名意大利受访者，AI多模态城市智能助手MUSA），发现AI个性化服务中，更高的定制化强度会降低用户感知的服务真实性，进而降低使用/分享意愿；功利性定制优于享乐性或亲社会性定制；用户对移动相关数据分享意愿较高，对私密数据则较保守。
AI.research_question: 更强的定制化线索是否能提升用户对AI移动服务的接受度，还是会因降低感知服务真实性而产生反效果？
AI.motivation: AI驱动的移动服务通过个性化创造价值，但数据密集性可能削弱用户开放性。现有研究对定制化强度如何影响用户接受度存在矛盾观点，本研究引入感知真实性这一机制来解答这一悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私计算理论（privacy-calculus）、个性化研究（personalization research）、感知真实性（perceived authenticity）
AI.method: 2×2情景实验（定制化强度 × 利益框架），以AI驱动的多模态城市智能助手（MUSA）为研究场景，收集1946名意大利受访者数据，采用中介分析等方法进行检验。
AI.findings: （1）更高定制化强度与更低感知真实性相关；（2）感知真实性正向影响使用/分享意愿；（3）真实性在定制化强度与使用/分享意愿之间起中介作用；（4）在高定制化条件下，功利性定制优于享乐性或亲社会性定制；（5）集体利益线索作用有限且依赖情境；（6）用户对移动相关数据分享意愿更高，对私密或弱任务关联数据更保守。
AI.theory_contributions: 将感知真实性识别为AI个性化服务中用户反应的关键评价机制，拓展了隐私计算和个性化研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI移动服务设计提供指导：高定制化需谨慎实施以避免真实性折扣，功利性价值框架更有效，数据收集应聚焦于任务紧密相关的数据类型。

title: Practice-Specific Drivers Shape how Smallholder Tea Farmers Manage Diverse Nature-Related Risks in Northern Vietnam
affiliations: Deakin University

detail.title: Practice-Specific Drivers Shape how Smallholder Tea Farmers Manage Diverse Nature-Related Risks in Northern Vietnam
detail.abstract: Agriculture, and tea production in particular, depends on nature while contributing to its degradation, exposing farming communities to interacting nature-related risks. Sustainable farm management practices (SFMPs) can mitigate these risks, yet uptake in smallholder systems depends on how farmers perceive threats, evaluate options, and intend to act. Drawing on Protection Motivation Theory and the nature-related risk lens of the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD), we examine smallholder tea farmers' intentions to adopt or continue five SFMPs: irrigation, soil mulching, organic fertilizer application, intercropping, and integrated pest management (IPM), across four risk domains: climate variability, pest and disease pressure, water scarcity, and soil degradation. We surveyed 312 smallholder tea farmers in Vietnam to identify practice-specific predictors and compare their contributions across domains. Current adoption was widespread but uneven: organic fertilizer had the highest rate (82.4%), while irrigation, soil mulching, and IPM each exceeded 50%, and intercropping had the lowest (28.8%). Future adoption intention was highest for irrigation (74.0%) and organic fertilizer (70.5%), moderate for IPM (62.2%) and soil mulching (51.9%), and consistently low for intercropping (34.9%), despite its multifunctional role. Adoption efficacy was the most consistent predictor of adoption intention, although practice-specific drivers were evident. Institutional support and climate knowledge were most prominent for water-related practices; education, and self-efficacy in the more knowledge-intensive IPM, whereas risk perception and experience were most prominent for intercropping and soil mulching. This is the first study to link smallholder tea farmers' risk and coping appraisals across multiple nature-related risk domains to practice-specific adoption intentions. We show that while adoption efficacy is a consistent driver, the remaining predictors differ systematically across risk domains and practices. This practice-by-risk-domain framework is transferable to other smallholder and perennial-crop systems, providing a basis for more targeted extension and policy strategies to strengthen the sustainability of smallholder farming systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于保护动机理论和TNFD自然相关风险框架，调查了312名越南小农茶农对五种可持续农场管理实践（灌溉、土壤覆盖、有机肥施用、间作、综合虫害管理）的采纳意愿，发现采纳效能是最一致的预测因子，但不同实践和风险领域的驱动因素存在系统性差异。
AI.research_question: 小农茶农对不同可持续农场管理实践的采纳意愿受哪些因素驱动？这些驱动因素在不同自然相关风险领域和实践类型中如何变化？
AI.motivation: 茶业依赖自然但加剧自然退化，使农户面临相互关联的自然风险。可持续实践可缓解风险，但小农体系的采纳率取决于农户的威胁感知、方案评估和行为意向，现有研究缺乏对多风险领域、多实践类型的系统性比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保护动机理论（Protection Motivation Theory, PMT）和自然相关财务披露工作组（TNFD）的自然相关风险框架。
AI.method: 对越南312名小农茶农进行问卷调查，覆盖五个实践（灌溉、土壤覆盖、有机肥、间作、IPM）和四个风险领域（气候变异性、病虫害、水资源短缺、土壤退化），采用实践特定预测因子分析并进行跨领域比较。
AI.findings: 当前采用率不均（有机肥82.4%最高，间作28.8%最低）；未来采纳意愿灌溉（74.0%）和有机肥（70.5%）最高，间作持续最低（34.9%）；采纳效能是最一致的预测因子，但不同实践有特定驱动因素（如机构支持和气候知识对水相关实践重要，教育和自我效能对IPM重要，风险感知和经验对间作和土壤覆盖重要）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将小农茶农的风险评估和应对评估与多自然相关风险领域联系起来，构建了实践-风险领域分析框架，证明采纳效能是一致驱动因素而其他预测因子存在系统性差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小农和多年生作物系统提供可转移的分析框架，支持更具针对性的推广和政策策略，以加强小农农业系统的可持续性。

title: The Unfinished Neoliberal City: Karachi's Governance from MQM's Boosterism to PPP's Hollow Mandate, 2005–2026 - A Longitudinal Analysis Through Urban Governance Theory

detail.title: The Unfinished Neoliberal City: Karachi's Governance from MQM's Boosterism to PPP's Hollow Mandate, 2005–2026 - A Longitudinal Analysis Through Urban Governance Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has previously undertaken professional consulting work on Pakistan's SME Competitiveness Strategy, which involved direct engagement with the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry, the Karachi Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and the Pakistan Business Council — organisations referenced in this paper's practitioner's perspective section. This engagement has concluded, and the author holds no current contractual, advisory, or financial relationship with any of these organisations, nor with any political party, government body, or private developer discussed in this paper (including the Muttahida Qaumi Movement, the Pakistan Peoples Party, or Bahria Town). The author has no financial stake in Karachi real estate or in any entity whose interests could be affected by this paper's findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patients, or original interview data. It is based entirely on secondary sources — published academic literature, journalism, government legislative texts, and publicly available court records — supplemented by the author's general professional background described in the Methods section. No ethics approval or participant consent was therefore required
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was conducted independently by the author as part of his ongoing professional and policy writing.

detail.abstract: This paper examines Karachi-Pakistan's largest city, financial capital, and home to over 20 million people-as a case study in what urban governance scholarship terms the "neoliberal city": a mode of urban governance in which economic and institutional elites shape city development in close alliance with private capital, while formal democratic institutions remain fragmented and comparatively weak. Drawing on Pierre's typology of urban governance modes, Stoker's account of networked governance, Blanco's network governance theory, and Saunders' theory of the local state, the paper's original 2017 analysis examined Karachi under the Muttahida Qaumi Movement's (MQM) post-2005 rule, when the party paired "city of the future" boosterism-signal-free corridors, Port Grand's Singapore-style waterfront redevelopment, extensive public-private surveillance infrastructure-with large-scale private capture of urban space, exemplified by the Bahria Town real estate empire and a landmark Supreme Court case in which the civil society organisation Shehri successfully challenged the Pakistan Army's seizure of a public recreational ground for private commercial development. This paper extends that analysis through a subsequent structural rupture: the 2013 Pakistan Rangers security operation that dismantled MQM's decades-long dominance, followed by MQM's 2023 electoral boycott and the Pakistan Peoples Party's (PPP) unexpected capture of the Karachi mayoralty-the first time in the city's history PPP has held that office. The paper's central finding is that Karachi's core governance dysfunction-a fragmented local government structure in which the elected mayor directly controls barely a quarter of the city's geographic area, with functional authority narrower still once fragmented service silos are accounted for, no city-wide master plan, and no constitutional protection for local government-has persisted essentially unchanged across this complete transfer of political power, suggesting that Karachi's "neoliberal city" condition reflects durable institutional and constitutional design choices rather than any single party's specific ideological project.

AI.tldr: 本文以卡拉奇为案例，研究"新自由主义城市"治理模式。通过分析从MQM执政到PPP掌权的权力更迭，发现卡拉奇的核心治理 dysfunction——碎片化的地方政府结构、市长直接管辖面积不足四分之一、缺乏全市总体规划、地方政府无宪法保护——在政治权力完全转移后基本未变，表明这一"新自由主义城市"状态源于持久的制度和宪法设计选择，而非某一政党的特定意识形态项目。
AI.research_question: 卡拉奇作为"新自由主义城市"的治理 dysfunction 在经历政治权力结构性更迭（从MQM到PPP）后是否发生变化？
AI.motivation: 卡拉奇作为巴基斯坦最大城市和金融中心，经历了从MQM主导到PPP掌权的重大政治转变，为检验"新自由主义城市"治理模式的制度韧性提供了独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pierre的城市治理模式类型学、Stoker的网络化治理理论、Blanco的网络治理理论、Saunders的地方国家理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，纵向比较分析：2017年原始分析（MQM后2005年统治时期）与后续结构性断裂（2013年安全行动、2023年选举抵制、PPP夺取市长职位）后的对比分析。
AI.findings: 卡拉奇的核心治理 dysfunction——碎片化地方政府结构（市长直接管辖面积不足四分之一）、无全市总体规划、地方政府无宪法保护——在政治权力完全从MQM转移到PPP后基本保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示"新自由主义城市"状态不仅取决于执政党的意识形态，更取决于持久的制度和宪法设计选择；丰富了城市治理理论关于制度韧性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解城市治理改革提供重要启示：单纯的政治权力更迭无法解决根深蒂固的治理 dysfunction，需要关注宪法保护和制度设计的根本性变革。

title: A Critical Assessment of the Opportunities for Human Resource Professionals to Maintain Humanised Workplaces in the Face of Increasingly Prevalent Artificial Intelligence Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Critical Assessment of the Opportunities for Human Resource Professionals to Maintain Humanised Workplaces in the Face of Increasingly Prevalent Artificial Intelligence Systems
detail.abstract:
This research explores humanisation (through employee engagement) and artificial intelligence, with some additional factors, within the workplace. The reason for this focus was due to this research built upon previous research and the increasingly prominent influence of artificial intelligence within the workplace. 

The aim of this research was to “Analyse humanisation at work, particularly engagement and autonomy, and the opportunities for what HR professionals can do to maintain humanisation within the workplace through those techniques”. However, firstly research gaps and techniques to come to this conclusion were gathered. 

The research employs a qualitative approach, underpinned by critical frameworks, including nominalism, social constructivism and the critical theory approach. These methodological choices align with the aim of the study, the area of research and the critical focus of the research, where imbalances are explored. Expert interviews are the form of primary data, which was acquired through semi-structured interviews, to get expertise and depth in the complicated area and questions set. 

Through analysis of the collected data, the research develops a set of actionable recommendations (the aim of this research) for HR professionals to maintain humanisation within the workplace, as well as targeting recommendations for external parties, policymakers, and researchers. The recommendations are focused on the development of ethical and inclusive techniques, to balance perspectives of AI systems and address possible negatives, while improving engagement and humanisation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨工作场所中通过员工敬业度实现人性化与人工智能之间的平衡，为HR专业人员提供建议以维持工作场所的人性化。
AI.research_question: 分析工作中的人性化（尤其是敬业度和自主性），以及HR专业人员可以通过哪些技术手段来维持工作场所的人性化。
AI.motivation: 基于先前研究，以及人工智能在工作场所中日益显著的影响，探讨如何维持人性化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质性方法，以批判性框架为基础，包括唯名论、社会建构主义和批判理论。
AI.method: 质性研究方法，采用半结构化专家访谈收集一手数据。
AI.findings: 提出了一套可操作的建议，帮助HR专业人员维持工作场所的人性化，并为外部利益相关者、政策制定者和研究者提供了针对性建议。建议聚焦于发展道德和包容性技术，平衡AI系统视角并解决可能的负面影响，同时提升敬业度和人性化。
AI.theory_contributions: 采用批判性框架（唯名论、社会建构主义、批判理论）研究AI与人性化之间的张力，丰富了工作场所人性化研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR专业人员提供维持工作场所人性化的可操作建议，并为政策制定者和研究者提供针对性建议，帮助平衡AI应用与人性化需求。

title: The TOPLDDF Architecture: Trusted Open-Interoperable Permissioned Legal Deterministic Digital Finance. Establishing Sovereign Trust in Institutional Digital Finance Using AITS Standard and 2Q-H-C-T-L-I Framework — Demonstrated on MAS GL1

detail.title: The TOPLDDF Architecture: Trusted Open-Interoperable Permissioned Legal Deterministic Digital Finance. Establishing Sovereign Trust in Institutional Digital Finance Using AITS Standard and 2Q-H-C-T-L-I Framework — Demonstrated on MAS GL1

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest, financial relationship, or personal affiliation with any organization that could be perceived to have influenced the design, analysis, or conclusions of this study. This research was conducted independently. No data was received from, and no results were shared with, any commercial entity prior to submission.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical framework and This study does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, animal experiments or personally identifiable information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by the author without institutional, governmental, or private financial support.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the TOPLDDF Architecture - Trusted x Open-Interoperable x Permissioned x Legal x Deterministic x Digital Finance - a complete constitutional working process for establishing Sovereign Trust in institutional digital finance. TOPLDDF fills the structural gap that no prior infrastructure, standard, or framework has resolved: the simultaneous constitutional verification of trust (T), legal enforceability (L), open-interoperability (O), permissioned identity (P), deterministic settlement (D), and digital finance grounding (DF) before value moves on institutional digital infrastructure. Without TOPLDDF, trust in institutional digital finance is self-asserted, legal enforceability is assumed, enforcement is manual, and trust signals fragment across jurisdictions. With TOPLDDF, trust is a constitutional fact. Note on Human Supervision: TOPLDDF is a machine-executed constitutional architecture. Human supervision monitors the machine and the institutional framework - not the TOPLDDF process transactions themselves. Where automation is incomplete, human action is required under Conformance Authority mandate: oracle source certification, scoring model certification, and post-enforcement legal review. Human override of threshold-triggered events is constitutionally prohibited. This paper completes a three-paper constitutional architecture that together constitute an independent, standalone, trust-based digital finance execution ecosystem: 2Q-H-C-T-L-I (scoring engine, SSRN 6601100/6739600), AITS v1.0 (constitutional standard, SSRN 6813082), and TOPLDDF (complete working architecture - this paper).

TOPLDDF is an independent, universal architecture. It is not a GL1 application, not a VARA application, not any specific environment's application. It is a constitutional architecture specification that any institutional digital finance infrastructure can host, provided it satisfies the AITS Ten Implementation Conditions. The implementation environment is the constitutional ground - GL1 (MAS Global Layer One) is the ground in which this paper demonstrates TOPLDDF; VARA, BIS Innovation Hub, and any AITS-compliant infrastructure are equally valid grounds. For cross-border institutional settlement, two implementation environments may operate simultaneously under one TOPLDDF constitutional framework - the O (Open-Interoperable) and D (Deterministic) dimensions provide the constitutional bridge across environments. The G-Grade travels with the asset. The circuit breaker fires on both environments. Regulatory notifications reach both jurisdictions.


TOPLDDF has one mandatory component and flexible components. Mandatory: AITS v1.0 (Naser, 2026c; SSRN 6813082) - the constitutional standard governing every design decision. AITS is not a tool. It is the constitutional authority. Without AITS, there is no constitutional standard and trust becomes self-asserted. Flexible: the scoring model (2Q-H-C-T-L-I v1.1, SSRN 6601100/6739600, in this paper; or any AITS-certified model), the operational layer architecture (six-layer GL1-environment reference in this paper; or any environment-appropriate architecture satisfying all AITS Ten Conditions), and the implementation environment (GL1 in this paper; any AITS-compliant infrastructure). The six-step working process is constitutional minimum: Admissibility Screening (all five AITS Pillars) -> Eligibility Scoring (2Q-H-C-T-L-I) -> AITS Trust Verification -> Decision with Full Explanation -> Settlement or Enforcement -> Continuous Monitoring. Additional steps may be added by any implementation. The sequence cannot be reordered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOPLDDF架构，为机构级数字金融建立基于宪法的信任验证工作流程，填补了现有基础设施在信任、法律可执行性、开放互操作性、许可身份、确定性结算和数字金融基础六维同步验证的结构性空白。
AI.research_question: 如何在机构级数字金融基础设施中实现同时涵盖信任、法律可执行性、开放互操作性、许可身份、确定性结算和数字金融基础的宪法性验证？
AI.motivation: 现有机构数字金融基础设施中，信任是自我宣称的、法律可执行性是假设的、执法是手动的、信任信号跨辖区碎片化，缺乏一个完整的宪法性工作架构来解决这些结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: TOPLDFF宪法架构、AITS v1.0宪法标准、2Q-H-C-T-L-I评分模型、六步工作流程（可接纳性筛查→资格评分→信任验证→带完整解释的决策→结算或执行→持续监控）
AI.method: 宪法性架构规范设计：一个强制组件（AITS v1.0宪法标准）+ 三个灵活组件（评分模型、操作层架构、实施环境），六步不可重排序的宪法最小工作流程。
AI.findings: TOPLDDF使信任成为宪法事实而非自我宣称；提供跨辖区/跨环境的宪法桥梁（通过O和D维度）；机器执行+人工监督（但宪法禁止人工推翻阈值触发事件）；可在任何满足AITS十项条件的机构数字金融基础设施上托管。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字金融领域的"宪法性信任"概念，区分了自我宣称的信任与宪法事实的信任；建立了信任验证的六维同步验证理论框架；完善了三篇论文组成的独立数字金融执行生态系统（2Q-H-C-T-L-I + AITS v1.0 + TOPLDDF）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境机构结算提供可操作的双环境同时运行的宪法框架；G级资产随资产移动、断路器双环境触发、监管通知双辖区送达；可用于MAS GL1、VARA、BIS创新中心等任何符合AITS的基础设施。

title: Decentralized Equilibrium Search Under Central Governance Primal-Dual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Inventory Coordination
affiliations: and College of William and Mary, Students

detail.title: Decentralized Equilibrium Search Under Central Governance Primal-Dual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Inventory Coordination
detail.abstract: We study the problem of coordinating inventory replenishment decisions across thousands of retail stores sharing a common warehouse, under binding capacity constraints and contractual service-level commitments. Classical inventory theory-from the Newsvendor model to multi-echelon base-stock policies-assumes known demand distributions, optimizes each store independently or sequentially, and produces static ordering rules calibrated to historical statistics. These assumptions break down in largescale practice: demand is non-stationary, stores compete for scarce warehouse capacity, and service commitments must be honored dynamically. We propose a primal-dual multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework in which store-level PPO agents optimize local replenishment policies while a central planner enforces system-level constraints through Lagrangian dual variables. The dual variables admit direct economic interpretations as shadow prices: prices warehouse capacity scarcity, and prices the cost of the service-level commitment. Together with a bullwhip penalty coefficient , they constitute a three-lever governance system with provably orthogonal controls over fill rate, capacity feasibility, and order volatility. We validate the framework on 143 weeks of the Walmart public sales panel (store-department pairs). The system achieves an 89.9% demand fill rate under standard conditions. Under a 50% demand surge-a structural non-stationarity that no calibrated static policy can anticipate-PPO achieves 86.5% fill rate while the Newsvendor oracle falls to 39-47% regardless of whether its parameters are correctly recalibrated, a 1.83 performance gap. This result reveals that the adaptability advantage of MARL is structural rather than empirical: state-conditional ordering solves a real-time capacity allocation problem that static ordering rules cannot solve in principle.

title: Unlocking Workplace Safety Intelligence: A Strategic Approach to CSV-First EHS Analytics for Maximizing Safety ROI SafeWatch AI Engineering Team Workplace Safety Intelligence Division

detail.title: Unlocking Workplace Safety Intelligence: A Strategic Approach to CSV-First EHS Analytics for Maximizing Safety ROI SafeWatch AI Engineering Team Workplace Safety Intelligence Division

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The work is a technical whitepaper describing the architecture, deployment methodology, and analytical capabilities of a workplace safety intelligence platform and does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This work did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This whitepaper presents a strategic framework for deploying SafeWatch AI (marketed as Safe2Watch), a workplace safety intelligence platform that transforms fragmented environmental, health, and safety (EHS) data into actionable executive dashboards, hazard monitoring views, and compliance readiness indicators. The platform addresses a persistent industry gap: organizations collect rich safety records incidents, near misses, inspections, training logs, and hazard readings but lack a unified analytical layer that leadership can trust without months of integration work. SafeWatch AI introduces a CSV-first ingestion model paired with a modern single-page application (SPA) built on React, TypeScript, and Vite. Eleven structured data categories map directly to operational reality, enabling safety teams to upload spreadsheet exports from existing systems and immediately populate dashboards for risk analytics, OSHA-aligned compliance tracking, and site-level operations views. Unlike legacy EHS suites that require enterprise middleware before any value is visible, SafeWatch AI delivers demonstrable insight within a single browser session. Performance of Decision-Making: Executive dashboards compute KPIs directly from uploaded records, eliminating weeks of slide-deck preparation. Enhanced Transparency: Empty states explicitly communicate when no data is loaded, preventing the silent presentation of placeholder metrics, a common failure mode in safety software demos. Structured Data Ingestion: Eleven validated CSV templates cover core safety events, compliance artifacts, and operational entities (sites, departments, employees, equipment, training, corrective actions). Improved Stability of Reporting: Consistent column schemas and ingest-time validation reduce schema drift and reporting inconsistencies across sites. Extended Analytical Reach: Risk analytics, hazard monitoring, and compliance views share a single inmemory data store, enabling cross-module correlation without duplicate data entry. Optimized Resource Utilization: A lightweight client-side architecture (Vite + React) minimizes infrastructure overhead during pilots and proof-of-concept deployments. These benefits collectively contribute to a higher safety ROI by reducing reporting labor, accelerating hazard response, and enabling evidence-based capital allocation for corrective actions.

AI.tldr: 本白皮书提出了SafeWatch AI（Safe2Watch）工作场所安全智能平台，该平台通过CSV优先的数据摄取模型和轻量级单页应用架构，将碎片化的EHS数据转化为可操作的执行仪表板，解决了组织安全数据缺乏统一分析层的行业痛点。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够将碎片化EHS（环境、健康与安全）数据快速转化为可执行洞察的轻量级工作场所安全智能平台？
AI.motivation: 组织收集了丰富但分散的安全数据（事故、未遂事件、检查、培训日志、危险读数等），却缺乏统一的分析层，且传统EHS套件需要数月集成工作和企业级中间件才能产生价值，造成安全决策滞后和资源浪费。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全智能分析理论、数据驱动决策理论、轻量级软件架构（CSV-first数据摄取、单页应用架构、客户端侧数据处理）、EHS合规管理框架（OSHA对齐）
AI.method: 设计并构建了一个基于CSV优先摄取模型的Web应用平台，采用React、TypeScript、Vite构建单页应用，定义11种结构化CSV模板覆盖核心安全数据类别，通过客户端内存数据存储实现跨模块关联分析。
AI.findings: 该平台能够在单一浏览器会话内生成可操作的洞察：执行仪表板直接从上传记录计算KPI；空状态显式沟通避免占位指标误导；11种验证模板减少模式漂移和报告不一致性；轻量级架构降低了试点和概念验证阶段的基础设施开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个CSV-first的数据摄取方法论，展示了如何通过结构化模板和客户端处理架构来解决EHS领域的数据集成难题，为安全信息系统的轻量化部署提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可立即部署的安全数据分析工具，减少了报告劳动力和幻灯片准备时间，加速了危险响应，实现了基于证据的纠正行动资本分配，从而提高了安全投资回报率。

title: Exploring Future Circularity Scenarios of Lithium-Ion Batteries in the European Union: A System Dynamics Approach
affiliations: , University of Twente, Università degli studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia (UNIMORE) and University of Twente

detail.title: Exploring Future Circularity Scenarios of Lithium-Ion Batteries in the European Union: A System Dynamics Approach
detail.abstract: The European Union's transition toward climate neutrality is accelerating demand for lithium-ion batteries to electrify the automotive and household sectors. This makes the European region susceptible to vulnerabilities in material supply, end-of-life management, and recycling capacity. Despite growing research on battery circularity, existing models typically address single countries or isolated end-of-life pathways, lacking a comprehensive EU-wide, multi-pathway perspective. This study develops a system dynamics model to assess the long-term evolution of the vehicle and stationary battery market, end-of-life flows, and material recovery across all EU-27 countries up to 2050, integrating country-level heterogeneity and cathode chemistry transitions. The analysis quantifies how the interplay of extended use, remanufacturing, repurposing, and recycling shapes future battery demand, material dependency, and self-sufficiency. Results show that electric vehicles will dominate battery demand by 2050. Phase-out policies and high repurposing rates lower stationary demand, but increase reliance on imports for electric vehicle batteries. Collection and recycling capacity must expand substantially to meet regulatory targets, although recycling infrastructure remains concentrated in a few countries. Under coordinated expansion efforts, recovery of critical raw materials such as lithium, nickel, and cobalt could partially meet European self-sufficiency targets. The findings of this study highlight that excessive second-life deployment delays material recovery, whereas balanced integration of remanufacturing and recycling improves circularity and resource resilience. To meet European sustainability objectives, it is essential to implement flexible, chemistry-specific, and regionally integrated strategies. These strategies should connect battery design, collection, and recycling infrastructure to balance circular economy goals with resource security.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建系统动力学模型，评估欧盟27国至2050年汽车和固定式电池市场、报废流向及材料回收的长期演变，发现电动汽车将主导电池需求，回收能力需大幅扩张，过度二次寿命部署会延迟材料回收，而平衡整合再制造与回收可提升循环性与资源韧性。
AI.research_question: 欧盟在向气候中和转型过程中，锂离子电池的供需、报废管理和材料回收将如何长期演变？不同循环路径（延长使用、再制造、再利用、回收）的互动如何影响电池需求、材料依赖和自给自足？
AI.motivation: 现有电池循环性模型通常只针对单一国家或孤立的报废路径，缺乏涵盖欧盟全境、多路径的综合视角，无法有效评估欧盟层面的材料供应脆弱性和循环经济目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学理论、循环经济理论、材料流分析、电池阴极化学转型理论
AI.method: 系统动力学模型，覆盖欧盟27国至2050年，整合国家异质性、阴极化学转型、多种报废路径（延长使用、再制造、再利用、回收）。
AI.findings: 1. 电动汽车将主导2050年电池需求；2. 淘汰政策和高再利用率降低固定式需求但增加电动汽车电池进口依赖；3. 收集和回收能力需大幅扩展才能满足监管目标，但回收基础设施集中于少数国家；4. 在协调扩展下，锂、镍、钴等关键原材料回收可部分实现欧洲自给自足；5. 过度二次寿命部署会延迟材料回收，平衡整合再制造与回收能改善循环性和资源韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个覆盖欧盟全境、多路径整合的系统动力学评估框架，揭示了不同循环路径（特别是二次寿命与回收之间）的权衡关系，丰富了电池循环经济与材料流分析的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了具体建议：需实施灵活的、针对特定化学体系的、区域整合的策略，将电池设计、收集和回收基础设施相连接，以平衡循环经济目标与资源安全。

title: The Scissors Effect of Tax Reform: How GST 2.0 Enhanced the Purchasing Power of the Agricultural Sector
affiliations: Central university of Karnataka and Central University Of Karnataka

detail.title: The Scissors Effect of Tax Reform: How GST 2.0 Enhanced the Purchasing Power of the Agricultural Sector
detail.abstract: Background: Agricultural Terms of Trade (ToT) used as index of measuring farm-sector welfare, depicting the skewed burden pulled by variations in input costs and related finished goods prices. This study will be exploring whether India's Goods and Services Tax (GST 2.0) reform generated an advantageous scissors effect. Methodology: In this study used a weighted average price index (WPI data, Laspeyres 1871) methodology from the period of January 2025 to February 2026 borrowed from official website of the office of economic adviser, under the ministry of statistics and programme implementation, India. And categorised the study period into three phases as pre-GST 2.0, Transition phase, and post implementation phase respectively. Findings: Study found statistically and economically positive improvements in agricultural ToT Phases, 127.13 from pre-reform, 132.19 during post reform phase disseminating a net gain of 5.1 percentage. Structural decomposition analysis demonstrates that the Index of Price Paid (IPP) remained widely stationary across phases i.e. 153.97 to 153.34, whereas Index of Price Received (IPR) depicted sharply surging i.e. 195.75 to 202.70, resulted that indirect tax cut led to margin on farm inputs while pushing demand side market. Conclusions: These observations in ToT carry significant policy implications for agricultural taxation, input subsidy rationalization, and inclusive rural development in emerging economies. This study contributes to empirical literature on tax incidence in agriculture and offers an understanding of how indirect tax architecture constructs sectoral competitiveness and farmer welfare.

AI.tldr: 基于印度2025-2026年WPI数据，研究发现GST 2.0改革通过降低农业投入品税负（IPP基本平稳）并推高农产品价格（IPR显著上升），使农业贸易条件指数从127.13升至132.19，净增5.1个百分点，改善了农民福利。
AI.research_question: 印度GST 2.0税制改革是否对农业贸易条件（ToT）产生了有利的"剪刀差效应"？
AI.motivation: 农业贸易条件是衡量农业部门福利的关键指标，而间接税制改革如何影响农业投入成本与产出价格之间的相对关系（即剪刀差）在实证层面尚缺乏充分研究。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业贸易条件（ToT）剪刀差理论；税负转嫁与税收归宿理论；拉斯佩雷斯价格指数法。
AI.method: 采用加权平均价格指数方法（Laspeyres, 1871），基于印度经济顾问办公室的WPI数据（2025年1月至2026年2月），将研究期划分为三个阶段：GST 2.0改革前、过渡期和改革后，并进行结构分解分析。
AI.findings: （1）农业ToT从改革前127.13升至改革后132.19，净增5.1个百分点；（2）价格支付指数（IPP）基本保持稳定（153.97→153.34），而价格接收指数（IPR）从195.75大幅上升至202.70；（3）间接税削减降低了农业投入品成本，同时推动了需求侧市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业税负归宿的实证文献；揭示了间接税架构通过影响投入成本与产出价格相对变动来塑造部门竞争力的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体的农业税收政策、投入品补贴合理化及包容性农村发展提供了政策参考；验证了GST 2.0改革对农民福利的积极效应。

title: The Trust Premium: Institutional Credibility as a Productive Asset in an Era of Global Resource Mobility

detail.title: The Trust Premium: Institutional Credibility as a Productive Asset in an Era of Global Resource Mobility
detail.abstract: This paper argues that institutional trust has become a productive economic asset in its own right, and that its scarcity relative to increasingly mobile capital, talent, and technology represents one of the defining features of twenty-first-century economic competition. As globalization has reduced barriers to the movement of productive resources, the factors traditionally generating durable competitive advantages have become more replicable and less capable of sustaining long-term differentiation. What cannot be easily replicated is institutional credibility: confidence that contracts will be enforced, property rights protected, and regulatory frameworks maintained with sufficient predictability to support long-term investment decisions. Drawing on verifiable data from Argentina, Estonia, and Brazil, and using sovereign bond spreads, World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators, and skilled migration research as observational proxies, the paper develops the concept of the Trust Premium: the economic advantage enjoyed by societies perceived as institutionally credible. The Trust Premium is distinguished from adjacent constructs, including institutional quality, social capital, and country risk premium, by its emphasis on perceived credibility in a context of high resource mobility. The central proposition is that as capital, talent, technology, and information become increasingly mobile, institutional credibility becomes the scarcest productive asset in the global economy. The paper proposes three research propositions for systematic empirical investigation and identifies implications for policymakers, investors, and individuals navigating an era of rising institutional competition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，当资本、人才和技术日益全球化流动时，机构信誉（institutional credibility）成为最稀缺的生产性资产，并定义了"信任溢价"（Trust Premium）概念，即社会因被认为具备机构可信度而获得的经济优势。通过阿根廷、爱沙尼亚和巴西的数据，论文论证了这一命题，并提出三个可供实证检验的研究命题。
AI.research_question: 在资本、人才和技术高度流动的21世纪，机构信誉（institutional trust）如何成为一种稀缺的生产性经济资产，以及它如何决定国家间的经济竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 全球化降低了生产要素流动的壁垒，传统竞争优势（如低成本劳动力、自然资源、技术）变得易于复制，难以维持长期差异化。需要识别一种新的、不可复制的竞争优势来源，即机构信誉。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任溢价（Trust Premium）理论，区分于机构质量、社会资本和国家风险溢价等相邻概念，强调在高资源流动性背景下感知可信度（perceived credibility）的经济价值。
AI.method: 理论概念构建+多国案例观察（阿根廷、爱沙尼亚、巴西），使用主权债券利差、世界银行全球治理指标、技术移民研究作为观测代理变量。
AI.findings: 随着资本、人才、技术和信息的流动性增强，机构可信度成为全球经济中最稀缺的生产性资产；相较于传统优势，机构信誉难以复制且能持续创造差异化优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式提出并界定了"信任溢价"（Trust Premium）这一新概念，将其与机构质量、社会资本、国家风险溢价等既有概念进行了清晰区分，为制度经济学和国际商业研究提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者（如何构建机构信誉以吸引流动资源）、投资者（将机构可信度纳入资产定价考量）以及个人（在机构竞争时代选择发展环境）提供了可操作的战略启示。

title: Strategic Leadership at Mercedes-Benz
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Strategic Leadership at Mercedes-Benz
detail.abstract: This paper examines the strategic leadership challenge faced by Mercedes-Benz Group AG as it transitions from traditional premium automotive manufacturing toward electric and software-defined mobility.The challenge is not only technological; it is strategic,organizational, financial, and sustainability-related.Mercedes-Benz must respond to regulatory pressure, uneven electric vehicle demand, stronger competition from Tesla, BYD,BMW, Audi, Porsche,and Chinese EV manufacturers, changing luxury customer expectations, and increasing ESG requirements, while protecting its luxury brand identity and profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了梅赛德斯-奔驰集团在从传统豪华汽车制造向电动化与软件定义出行转型过程中面临的战略领导力挑战，涵盖技术、战略、组织、财务和可持续发展等多维度问题。
AI.research_question: 梅赛德斯-奔驰集团在向电动化和软件定义出行转型过程中面临哪些战略领导力挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统豪华汽车制造商在电动化转型中面临技术变革、监管压力、竞争格局重塑等多重挑战，需要系统分析其战略领导力困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略领导力理论、企业转型理论、动态能力理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以梅赛德斯-奔驰集团为研究对象进行深入分析
AI.findings: 梅赛德斯-奔驰面临监管压力、EV需求不均衡、来自特斯拉/比亚迪/宝马/奥迪/保时捷及中国EV制造商的激烈竞争、豪华客户期望变化以及日益增长的ESG要求，同时需保护其豪华品牌形象和盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了传统豪华汽车品牌战略转型的理论框架，为战略领导力在产业变革中的应用提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为梅赛德斯-奔驰及其他传统豪华汽车制造商的电动化转型提供战略决策参考，帮助企业在技术变革中平衡品牌定位与创新需求。

title: Industrial Systems Governance in Automotive Transformation: Governance Architecture, Topological Dependency Structures, and Executive Assessment Across Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Ferrari, Rivian-Volkswagen, and Software-Defined Platform Models

detail.title: Industrial Systems Governance in Automotive Transformation: Governance Architecture, Topological Dependency Structures, and Executive Assessment Across Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Ferrari, Rivian-Volkswagen, and Software-Defined Platform Models

detail.abstract: The transition towards electrified, software-defined, and increasingly autonomous mobility systems represents more than a technological shift in propulsion systems. It reflects a broader reconfiguration of industrial systems in which competitive advantage increasingly depends upon how capabilities, software architectures, supply chains, capital, and ecosystem relationships are governed across interconnected networks. Beyond its comparative analysis of automotive manufacturers, this study makes a twofold contribution. First, it identifies governance architecture as an emerging determinant of industrial competitiveness under conditions of technological and industrial transformation. Second, it develops a practical governance assessment and decision architecture through which governance structures may be evaluated, monitored, and adapted in response to changing industrial conditions. In doing so, the paper moves beyond descriptive case-study analysis towards an applied governance-science methodology capable of supporting strategic planning, capital allocation, industrial policy evaluation, and long-term competitive positioning. The paper argues that contemporary automotive transformation is best understood as a contest between alternative governance architectures rather than a purely technological race. To examine this transition, the study develops a Governance Architecture Framework (GAF) and Governance Domain Index (GDI) for evaluating how governance authority, capability ownership, dependency structures, capital allocation mechanisms, and value-creation pathways are organised across industrial systems. The framework is structured around four governance domains: Platform Architecture Strategy, Vertical Integration, Legacy Manufacturing Inertia, and Global Market Orientation. The framework is applied through a comparative assessment of multiple OEM governance architectures, including Tesla, BYD, Volkswagen, Rivian–Volkswagen, Ferrari, XPeng, Huawei, BMW Group, SAIC-GM-Wuling, and Chery Automobile. Rather than treating manufacturers solely as firms, the analysis interprets them as alternative governance configurations through which authority, dependency management, coordination mechanisms, and value creation are organised and sustained. The findings identify a growing tension between architectural continuity and architectural adaptation as organisations respond to emerging sources of value creation associated with software platforms, artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, data ecosystems, and advanced manufacturing networks. Whilst some firms pursue competitive advantage through extensive vertical integration, others increasingly compete through platform ecosystems, software-defined architectures, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem-based governance models. The study concludes that long-term industrial competitiveness is determined less by the selection of a single technological pathway and more by the ability to position governance authority, capability ownership, and strategic control around future sources of value creation. By reframing automotive transformation as a problem of industrial systems governance, the paper contributes an integrated governance-science framework for evaluating industrial resilience, adaptability, strategic sovereignty, capital deployment, and long-term competitive positioning under conditions of technological, geopolitical, and industrial uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个治理架构框架（GAF）和治理域指数（GDI），将汽车行业的电气化、软件化转型重新定义为不同治理架构之间的竞争，而非单纯的技术竞赛。通过对特斯拉、比亚迪、大众等多家OEM的对比分析，发现长期竞争力取决于企业如何围绕未来价值创造源配置治理权力、能力所有权和战略控制，而非选择单一技术路径。
AI.research_question: 在汽车行业向电动化、软件定义和自动驾驶转型的过程中，不同企业的治理架构如何影响其工业竞争力和长期战略定位？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将汽车转型视为技术竞赛，但忽视了更深层次的工业系统重新配置——即能力、软件架构、供应链、资本和生态系统关系如何在不同网络间被治理。作者认为治理架构正在成为工业竞争力的新兴决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理架构框架（GAF）和治理域指数（GDI），围绕四个治理域：平台架构战略、垂直整合、传统制造惯性、全球市场导向。将企业视为不同的治理配置，而非单纯的公司实体。
AI.method: 比较案例研究，对特斯拉、比亚迪、大众、Rivian–大众联盟、法拉利、小鹏、华为、宝马集团、上汽通用五菱、奇瑞汽车等多家OEM的治理架构进行对比评估。
AI.findings: （1）存在架构连续性与架构适应性之间的张力；（2）不同企业采取不同的治理策略：有的追求深度垂直整合，有的通过平台生态系统、软件定义架构、战略伙伴关系和基于生态的治理模式竞争；（3）长期竞争力取决于围绕未来价值创造源（软件平台、AI、自动驾驶、数据生态、先进制造网络）配置治理权力、能力所有权和战略控制的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将汽车转型重新定义为工业系统治理问题，提出了一个集成的治理科学框架，用于评估技术、地缘政治和工业不确定性条件下的工业韧性、适应性、战略主权、资本部署和长期竞争定位。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的治理评估与决策架构，可支持战略规划、资本配置、产业政策评估和长期竞争定位，帮助企业和政策制定者监控和调整治理结构以适应变化的工业条件。
